As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 The Ingestion team within GDI (Get Data In) group is responsible to develop and maintain a multi petabyte ingestion platform for 3rd party data powering fast growing next generation SIEM. The platform is already handling over 1 PB of daily ingestion and looking forward to evolving the platform to handle more than 2 PB per day in the next 12\-18 months while maintaining high availability, low latency and reasonable COGS.
   

  

 As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to provide significant technical direction and produce a system that can support high throughput low latency data ingestion deployed across multiple regions. Your work will directly impact our ability to deliver fast, resilient, and scalable systems to support multiple petabyte data ingestion.
   

  

***This role is targeting candidates located in Bangalore and willing to work in a hybrid environment.***
****What You’ll Do:****
* Lead and own the scoping, design, and development of major features and platform\-level initiatives within the ingestion team to solve open\-ended, complex distributed systems problems.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members through rigorous code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and documentation.
* Drive hands\-on operational excellence by monitoring and following up on features released to customers and troubleshooting critical customer issues.
* Collaborate with your peers across teams on defining and delivering new solutions, design documents, technical talks and improving our internal documentation.
* We are a remote first company so you must bring your excellent verbal and written communication skills to bear when you are working with teams across the globe.


****What You’ll Need:****
* A passion or personal interest in distributed systems and curiosity of how our running systems are doing.
* 7\+ years experience in software development in general and the ability to juggle making pragmatic tradeoffs between short\-time delivery needs vs long\-term product goals.
* Experience in contributing to broad technical leadership in products or services
* Fluency in both functional and object oriented programming and the ability to pick up new languages on the go
* A can\-do attitude, and that you thrive collaborating in a team and are not afraid of taking on responsibilities
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence with complex distributed services
* Ability to communicate and articulate technical concepts crisply to individual contributors and management.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


****Bonus Points:****
* Experience programming in Golang or Scala
* Experience with commercial clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Hands\-on experience architecting and optimizing massive\-scale systems handling over 100s of billion requests per day or more than 1 PB of data per day.
* Exposure to or experience with Log Management or cybersecurity products

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Software Development Advisor to join our team in bengaluru, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

Role Summary
  
We are looking for an experienced Guidewire PolicyCenter Developer with 7\+ years of overall IT experience and strong hands\-on expertise in PolicyCenter configuration, customization, and integrations. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting PolicyCenter solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Configure and customize Guidewire PolicyCenter based on business requirements.
  
Develop and enhance PolicyCenter components including product model, PCF screens, data model extensions, typelists, rules, workflows, and underwriting\-related configurations.
  
Design, develop, and maintain integrations between PolicyCenter and external applications using Guidewire integration frameworks.
  
Work with messaging, web services, REST/SOAP APIs, plugins, batch processes, and event\-based integrations.
  
Develop and maintain Gosu code, including business rules, enhancements, plugins, batch jobs, and integration logic.
  
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and external system teams to clarify requirements and deliver solutions.
  
Perform unit testing, support system/integration testing, and resolve defects within agreed timelines.
  
Support deployment, release validation, production issue analysis, and incident resolution.
  
Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  
Ensure code quality through adherence to Guidewire development standards, code reviews, and technical documentation.
  
Required Skills and Qualifications
  
7\+ years of IT experience, with significant hands\-on experience in Guidewire PolicyCenter development.
  
Strong knowledge of Guidewire PolicyCenter configuration and customization.
  
Strong hands\-on experience in Guidewire PolicyCenter configuration and development, including Gosu programming, PCF screens, Product Model, data model extensions, typelists, business rules, workflows, and validations.
  
Experience developing and enhancing PolicyCenter plugins and batch processes to support business functionality, system integrations, and operational requirements.
  
Strong integration experience using Guidewire messaging framework, web services, REST APIs, SOAP services, XML, JSON, and messaging technologies.
  
Experience in integrating PolicyCenter with downstream/upstream systems such as billing, claims, document management, payment, customer, and third\-party vendor applications.
  
Knowledge of Guidewire Studio, TeamCity/Jenkins or other CI/CD tools, Git/SVN, and deployment processes.
  
Good understanding of PC insurance domain concepts, including policy lifecycle, quote, submission, issuance, renewal, cancellation, endorsements, and underwriting.
  
Experience with SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2\.
  
Strong problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Guidewire PolicyCenter certification.
  
Experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform or Guidewire Cloud implementation.
  
Exposure to BillingCenter and/or ClaimCenter.
  
Experience with Java, Spring, or other integration technologies.
  
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and production support processes.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future.  For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

**About Us**
------------



Endor Labs is building the Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency\-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster.



Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40\-year old C\+\+ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures.



Sound interesting? Let's talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation!


**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* You will play a pivotal role in architecting and building the core backend infrastructure for our SaaS products.
* You will lead and contribute to large\-scale technical projects, ensuring the scalability, reliability, and performance of our systems.
* Design, architect, and build features end\-to\-end while working closely with Product Management, and our distributed Engineering team
* Play a significant role in driving innovation, making critical architectural decisions, and leading the implementation of cutting\-edge technologies.
* We encourage and support active participation in external technical forums, conferences, and open\-source communities, allowing you to contribute to the broader tech community and stay at the forefront of industry trends.
* Mentor and coach team members by sharing your expertise, and promoting best practices within the team to foster a culture of continuous learning and growth.
* Use best practices of observability to ensure that the product and the platform have the best reliability and availability for our customers.

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in engineering with 6\-8 years of experience building scalable backends for product/SaaS companies.
* At least 3\-years experience in Golang programming with a focus on microservices/distributed architecture
* Practical experience in designing APIs with one or more frameworks (gRPC \[preferred], ReST, GraphQL, Thrift, etc.).
* Ability to build and design technical solutions from scratch and your code and documentation can be used as an example for coding best practices at Endor.
* Scalable Distributed System Experience \- understand micro\-services and domain\-driven design, load balancing, horizontal/vertical scaling, and stateless architectures.
* Architecture \- knowledge of data structures and a keen eye for building architectures that scale and extend easily for longevity. Apply data\-driven techniques to evaluate and propose architectural choices.
* Ability to discuss tradeoffs between architecture's choice to influence groups to move in the right direction.
* Able to enjoy working in a fast\-moving environment with evolving requirements.
* Ability to solve problems creatively and independently when in uncharted or unfamiliar territory.
* Practical experience in troubleshooting distributed systems and ability to solve root causes.

**Why Endor Labs**
------------------



We're building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest\-growing spaces in software. Our dev\-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right.



At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer's success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win.

  


**Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one\-size\-fits\-all here.

**Company Introduction** 




 We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
 



  





 We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
 



  





 Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world.
 



  





**Role Overview :** 




 As a Senior Staff Backend Engineer you will partner with leaders of multiple platform teams. You will work closely with the product team to define and implement simple solutions of complex infrastructure problems while ensuring to build a highly scalable, reliable and efficient platform for our customers.
 



  





 You will technically guide teams working on full stack development teams using Java, AWS, Kafka, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Argo CD and gRPC. You will be accountable for hiring and developing technical leaders and top talent, raising the bar on engineering and operational excellence.
 



  





**What You Will Do :** 



* Architect workload and service management infrastructure.
* Hands\-on develop critical infrastructure components.
* Decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions, providing mechanisms for the teams to prioritize ruthlessly and "move with urgency".
* Envision roadmaps for the scalable and robust growth of Coupang's growing application infrastructure.
* Align with stakeholders, develop strong developers, and provide technical guidance to engineers on critical projects to resolve complex business problems.
* Demonstrate excellence resulting in scalable systems and services with the highest quality architecture and design.
* Dive deep into critical system issues, proactively address similar root causes, and raise the bar on Operational Excellence.
* Collaborate with other Coupang tech leaders to make the service extensible and unlock opportunities for innovation.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 12\+ years of professional software development experience.
* Hands\-on experience designing and developing large\-scale distributed systems within the last 3 years.
* Fluent in one or more of Java, Go or Python.
* Experience with Amazon EKS
* Proven track record of delivering mission\-critical systems.
* Experience developing and growing senior individual contributors globally.
* Experience with cloud computing using AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with machine learning job deployment infrastructure such as Argo CD workflows.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Hands on experience with Kubernetes and gRPC.
* Deep understanding of operating system kernels and distributed systems such as Kafka, Cassandra, and MongoDB.
* Proficiency with ML infrastructure and deployment frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, TensorRT, and Triton Backend.



  





**Type of work model** 



* Hybrid / Onsite / Remote working



  





 Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.
 



  





**Details to consider** 



* Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.



**Privacy Notice** 



* Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/l and/jobs/

description:
Engineering Manager (Python/Django)
 



 MishiPay \- Global POS / Checkout Technology
 



 Competitive basic salary and bonus
 



 Bangalore (office based plus 36 WFH days a year)
 



 Unlimited Holidays
 



  





 About Us
 



 MishiPay is a global leader in next\-generation checkout technology, enabling seamless in\-store purchases via shoppers’ own smartphones or our minimalist, low capex kiosks.
 



 We provide a complete checkout ecosystem — spanning self\-checkout, Mobile POS, Click \& Collect and traditional tills — allowing retailers to run their entire store checkout operation on MishiPay.
 



 Our technology reduces operating costs, increases basket size and visit frequency, lowers abandonment, and unlocks rich, real\-time customer data — delivering both immediate commercial impact and deeper insight into the in\-store customer journey.
 



 We now have major international retail customers in the UK, Europe, Middle East and the USA, and we’re expanding!
 



  





 About The Role
 



 We are growing rapidly and are looking for a hands\-on Engineering Manager to lead a critical engineering team from our tech hub in Bangalore. This team is at the heart of our business, responsible for both our core product engineering and the strategic customization and integration of our platform for major global clients.
 



 This is a technical leadership role where you will split your time between managing the team and contributing as a senior developer. We expect you to spend roughly 30\-40% of your time on hands\-on coding, technical design, and solving complex client integration challenges.
 



  





 We'd like to speak to you if you have strong Python and Django skills, you've been a Founding or early stage member of a startup and you are happy to code and lead. These requirements are essential.
 



 This is not a super senior Director of Engineering role, although it is one of our Delivery Leads.
 



  





 Roles and Responsibilities:
 



  





 Technical Leadership \& Architecture:
 


* Lead system design and technical architecture for both product features and client customizations, creating Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD), system architecture diagrams, and API specifications.
* Develop comprehensive Technical Specification Documents and Solution Design Documents based on Statement of Work (SoW) requirements.
* Act as a hands\-on technical authority; conduct code reviews, contribute to critical path development, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Architect, design, and guide the implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure services using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
* Lead our cloud infrastructure strategy on Microsoft Azure, with deep hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes (AKS) for container orchestration, scaling, and management.



 Hands\-On Execution \& Delivery:
 


* As a contributing developer, you will design, write, test, and deploy code for critical services, client\-specific features, and integration endpoints.
* Explore and integrate modern technologies, including generative AI and machine learning services, to build smarter, more adaptive retail solutions.
* Estimate effort, define project timelines, and manage technical delivery from conception through completion.
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects, from core platform features to high\-priority client customizations.
* Drive the adoption of best practices in software engineering, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and SRE principles.



 Client Solutions \& Customization:
 


* Architect and implement scalable solutions for client\-specific requirements, creating detailed technical documentation for both internal and client stakeholders.
* Lead the technical delivery of client integrations, working directly with client technical teams when necessary.
* Design and build robust, configurable systems that can be tailored for different retail environments without requiring one\-off code forks.



 Team Leadership \& Process Excellence:
 


* Lead, mentor, and grow a high\-performing team of software engineers.
* Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging the experimentation with and adoption of AI\-powered development tools to improve code quality, testing, and system reliability.
* Utilize a data\-driven approach to improve team performance and system reliability through DORA metrics and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage team capacity and allocation across the dual streams of product roadmap and client commitments.
* Manage project priorities, track risks and blockers, and ensure transparent communication with all stakeholders.



  





 About You
 



 As well as your startup/co\-Founding experience and your ability to inspire, lead, mentor and code, you'll also have:
 


* Minimum of 3 years of people management experience in a start\-up.
* Minimum of 5 years of recent experience launching \& maintaining software products.
* Minimum of 5 years of recent software development experience (in last 8 years).
* Prior experience as a Founder in growth\-stage startups.
* Prior experience in managing a P\&L, budgeting, trade\-offs, headcount, cash burn, etc.
* Excellent communication skills \- oral and written \- meaning that you are able to speak with clarity to customers, succinctly with investors and with precision to engineers.
* Valid Passport and any other essentials to travel offshore.



  





 In return, you'll get to work in a fast\-paced, ever changing environment that's impacting retailers across the world.
 



  





 Why MishiPay?
 



 You’ll work with an ambitious and inspirational multi\-cultural team who are redefining the retail industry globally.
 



 We offer a tight\-knit, collaborative and exciting work environment, coupled with the opportunity to see the apps you develop put to use in some of the world’s largest retailers.
 



 We also offer:
 


* Bonuses
* Unlimited holidays
* Hybrid Working (36 days WFH a year)
* Monthly Employee Awards
* A small monthly training budget
* Company events
* Free lunch in Bangalore
* MacBook
* Career progression and a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in tech.
* Options depending on experience level

This team processes on average 371MM\+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.

Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We build scalable solutions that grow with Amazon’s business.  

  

BDT is growing, and the data processing landscape is shifting. Our data is consumed by thousands of teams across Amazon including Research Scientists, Machine Learning Specialists, Business Analysts and Data Engineers.  

  

We are developing innovative products including the next\-generation of data catalog, data discovery engine, data transformation, machine learning, and more with AWS technologies.  

  

We're looking for talented engineers to build them from the ground up.
  

  

This is a hands\-on position where you will design and build extremely scalable components and features for data processing at Amazon. You will work closely with senior engineers to solve challenging technical problems and collaborate with internal customers to help them get the best results. You should be a strong software developer with solid programming skills, an understanding of data structures and algorithms, and a passion for massive\-scale computing. A desire to learn, deliver results, and grow as an engineer is essential.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, develop, and deliver innovative products and services.
* Design and build software components in a large distributed computing environment.
* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software.
* Write clean, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across the software stack.

  

A day in the life  

The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Description**
 Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
   

  

 Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next\-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
   

  

 This role at Enphase requires required working onsite 3 days a week for 6 hours minimum at our Bengaluru office.
   

  

**About the role:**
 For our EV Charging business, we seek experienced IOT/ Cloud Engineer who will be able to work across multiple products to lead effective product architecture and development
   

  

 Hands\-on in various technologies, Mentor team of Engineers, on day\-to\-day duties as well as work with leadership team on strategic initiatives
   

  

 Provide hands\-on technical expertise to design, engineer, deploy, and deliver including driving improvements in technical architecture, standards, and processes.
   

  

 Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Program Management and Professional Services to ensure required technology upgrades/migrations/ and builds are well understood and planned into roadmaps.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Design, build, and maintain high\-throughput Java \+ Spring Boot microservices serving millions of devices
* Develop RESTful APIs (JSON/XML) secured with JWT and OAuth 2\.0
* Work with MongoDB as the primary data store, designing schemas and queries for scale
* Build and consume event\-driven architectures using Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, and Kinesis
* Containerize services with Docker and deploy on AWS EKS (Kubernetes) via CI/CD pipelines
* Collaborate on system design for high availability, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance
* Write clean, testable, well\-documented code with strong unit and integration test coverage
* Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and sprint planning
* Own features end\-to\-end — from design and implementation through deployment and production monitoring
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive reliability improvements
* Leverage AI\-powered development tools for code generation, automated code reviews, test creation, technical planning, and debugging — continuously improving team productivity and code quality


**Who you are and what you bring:**
* B.E./B.Tech or ME/M.Tech in Computer Science (or equivalent) from top 150 Nirf engineering colleges.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on back\-end development experience
* Strong proficiency in Java (8\+) and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security) Solid experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB preferred) — schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines
* Practical experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, EKS, CloudWatch, or similar)
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration
* Experience with Git, Bitbucket/GitHub, and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
* Understanding of RESTful API design principles, versioning, and security (OAuth 2\.0, JWT)
* Strong organizational skills — ability to define, track, and deliver work independently
* Excellent problem\-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication
* Experience with event streaming platforms — Kafka, AWS Kinesis
* Working knowledge of AWS Lambda and serverless architectures
* Understanding of WebSockets and persistent connection protocols (e.g., OCPP)
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, TLS, load balancing, connection keep\-alive, timeout tuning
* Experience with AWS ALB/NLB, target groups, health checks, and sticky sessions
* Exposure to Elasticsearch / OpenSearch for search and analytics workloads
* Familiarity with SQL databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) as a secondary skill
* Experience with front\-end technologies (React, JavaScript/TypeScript) — full\-stack capability is a plus
* Knowledge of caching layers (Redis, ElastiCache)
* Understanding of observability — structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics (Datadog, ELK, Prometheus)
* Familiarity with shell scripting (Bash) for automation, debugging, and operational tasks
* Exposure to OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) or EV/IoT domain
* Experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Windsurf/Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude) for development, code review, and technical planning
* Experience working in renewable energy, clean tech, or IoT companies
* You thrive in a fast\-paced environment with ambiguity and evolving priorities
* You take ownership — proposing solutions, not just implementing tickets

description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business challenges at scale. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain backend services and cloud\-based applications that support high\-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to reliable product experiences for customers and internal teams. This role is based in
 **Chennai, India** 
 and follows a
 **hybrid** 
 work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable, scalable solutions using modern software development practices. This position reports to the
 **Manager, Engineering** 
 .
   

  

**Team Summary**
 Our Collector R\&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex business problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology\-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency.
   

  

 These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.
   

  

 As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, experience working with service\-based systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves outcomes for customers and internal users. Source context: the Collector R\&D team summary provided in your prompt and athenahealth engineering JD guidance on MTS back\-end roles:
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Develop backend applications and services using Java to support business\-critical workflows and platform capabilities.
* Build and maintain scalable microservices that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems.
* Implement cloud\-based solutions on AWS with attention to reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Create and enhance APIs and service integrations that support high\-volume transactional workflows.
* Troubleshoot application and service issues, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that improve system stability.
* Contribute to code reviews, unit testing, and team engineering practices that improve software quality and consistency.
* Optimize application performance and service interactions to support scalability and operational efficiency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve productivity in day\-to\-day engineering work, such as understanding unfamiliar code, drafting test cases, summarizing technical information, or exploring implementation options, while reviewing outputs carefully before applying them.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Document technical designs, implementation details, and service dependencies for shared understanding across the team.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and estimation activities.
* Support deployment, release validation, and post\-release monitoring for assigned services or features.
* Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and development practices across the team.
* Contribute to monitoring and alerting improvements that help detect and resolve production issues.
* Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared dependencies.
* Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving sessions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual effort through service enhancements and automation.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or related application development work.
* Hands\-on experience with Java for building and maintaining production applications.
* Experience developing or supporting microservices and service\-based architectures.
* Working knowledge of AWS and cloud application deployment concepts.
* Experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with distributed systems.
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.


**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented* 
*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*
***Our DEI commitment:***
*Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*
**What We Can Do For You**
*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* 
*workspaces* 
 —
 *some offices even welcome dogs.*
*We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* 
*full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* 
*enables* 
*employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*
*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*
*Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers*

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


 An overview of this role
   

  

 The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.
   

  

 This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8\).
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.
* Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.
* Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.
* Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.
* Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.
* Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.


 What you’ll bring
   

  

* Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.
* Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.
* Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.
* Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

description:
**Description**
 Trintech is the leader in AI Financial Close Management, helping finance and accounting teams transform the way they work by eliminating manual burdens, strengthening controls, and empowering strategic decision\-making.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Software Architect** 
 to own the technical architecture of the
 **Platform Team** 
 at Trintech’s AI Platform. The Platform Team builds the foundational capabilities that all AI agents depend on — security and IAM infrastructure, multi\-tenant architecture, cross\-agent workflow orchestration, governance framework, billing and metering engine, and the agent marketplace. You report to the Director of Engineering and are the senior technical IC for the Platform Team. Your design decisions define the security posture, tenancy boundaries, API contracts, and event\-driven backbone of the entire platform. The right person reasons from first principles on security architecture, system design, and multi\-tenant SaaS patterns. Cloud\-native production experience required; Azure preferred. This is a
 **hands\-on delivery role, not an advisory one** 
 .
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Platform Architecture Ownership**
* Own the end\-to\-end technical architecture of the Platform Team — security and IAM layer, multi\-tenant data architecture, event\-driven backbone, API gateway design, and compliance framework.
* Design the security architecture — defence\-in\-depth, federated authentication, OAuth 2\.0 flows, token management, and identity propagation across the platform. Own the security posture of the platform layer.
* Own the multi\-tenant data architecture — tenant isolation strategy, data partitioning, shared vs. dedicated resource models, and cross\-tenant security boundaries.
* Design the event\-driven backbone — message ordering guarantees, delivery semantics, workflow orchestration patterns, and cross\-agent handover contracts. Own immutable data and append\-only event design as the engineering foundation for audit and compliance.
* Define the API gateway architecture — gateway policies, API\-first design principles, API maturity model, and how platform capabilities are exposed to agent consumers.


**Hands\-On Technical Delivery**
* Commit to code — build foundational platform components, review critical PRs, lead design sessions, and set the engineering quality bar through example.
* Collaborate with the Agent Stream Architect on boundaries — what the platform provides, what events agents must emit, and how platform capabilities are consumed.
* Ensure platform capabilities are designed for resilience — failure isolation, retry strategies, bulkhead patterns, and graceful degradation.


**Standards \& Quality**
* Define platform engineering standards — API contract design, event schema governance, security control implementation, and compliance\-grade system design.
* Define code quality standards for the Platform Team — what well\-structured, testable, and observable platform code looks like. Platform EM enforces; Architect defines.
* Identify architectural risks proactively — security gaps, scalability bottlenecks, and dependency failures that could affect agent squads.


**Who You Are**
**Security Architecture — Primary Gate**
* Security architecture from first principles — defence\-in\-depth design, OAuth 2\.0, federated authentication, token lifecycle, and identity propagation across a multi\-tenant platform. Understands attack surfaces and defence patterns from engineering fundamentals, not just tool configuration. Owns the security posture of the platform layer.


**Multi\-Tenant SaaS \& System Design — Primary Gate**
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture at production scale — tenant isolation strategy, data partitioning, shared vs. dedicated resource models, and cross\-tenant security boundaries. Has designed and operated multi\-tenant systems in production.
* System design at high and low level — owns all Platform Team architecture decisions. Component boundaries, data contracts, failure modes, resilience patterns, and scalability trade\-offs.


**Experience**
* Event\-driven architecture and workflow orchestration — production experience with at least one orchestration tool (Temporal, Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or equivalent). Message ordering guarantees, delivery semantics, and cross\-agent handover contract design.
* Immutable data design and append\-only event patterns — designing systems where every action is traceable, tamper\-evident, and queryable. The engineering foundation for audit and compliance.
* API gateway in depth — one tool in production. API\-first design, API maturity model, gateway policies, rate limiting, and how platform capabilities are exposed to agent consumers.
* Cloud\-native on at least one public cloud — Azure preferred: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD, and continuous release practices. SQL and NoSQL databases at production scale: data modelling, schema design, and query optimisation.


**Awareness**
* Agent orchestration patterns — Agent Stream Architect owns this layer; sufficient awareness to design platform capabilities that agents can consume correctly. Distributed systems at working depth: enough to design platform services that scale and fail gracefully.
* LLM tooling concepts — what the platform must support for agents to operate on it.


**Nice to Have**
* Azure certification — AZ\-305 or equivalent, given Azure is the preferred cloud. Prior experience building audit or billing capabilities — a differentiator, not a gate.
* AI\-native SDLC — familiarity with Human\-led Agentic SDLC practices. Production experience in Python — enables deeper code review and contribution. Not a gate for this role.
* Financial close or R2R domain experience to accelerate ramp\-up on the business context the platform serves.


**What You’ll Learn \& Gain**
* End\-to\-end ownership of the platform architecture layer on a live enterprise financial product — your design decisions define the security posture, tenancy model, and event\-driven backbone that every AI agent team builds on.
* Deep hands\-on experience applying security architecture and multi\-tenant SaaS design from first principles in a production context where correctness under adversarial conditions, compliance, and scalability are all non\-negotiable.
* Exposure to building governance, billing, and marketplace infrastructure for an enterprise AI platform — foundational engineering challenges with direct impact on product commercialisation and compliance.
* Close collaboration with the Agent Stream Architect, Engineering Manager, and Platform Tech Leads in a delivery model where your architectural choices are implemented rapidly, with direct visibility into how platform design decisions shape the product.


 If you are an architect who reasons from first principles on security and system design, has built multi\-tenant SaaS platforms at production scale, and is ready to own the architectural foundation that an enterprise AI product is built on — we encourage you to apply.
   

  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
 **fueling decisions with expert insights** 
 . We accelerate and enhance decision\-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
   

  

 For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in\-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
   

  

* Role Summary


 Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand\-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
   

  

**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**
* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client\-facing AI products — the next generation of AI\-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end\-to\-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt\-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data\-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade\-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high\-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end\-to\-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people\-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4\) or high\-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade\-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non\-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end\-to\-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross\-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path


 The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross\-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

**Why work for us?**
* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning \& Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job\-related qualifications.
* Health \& Well\-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks \& Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.


 The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

description:
**WHO WE ARE** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE:** 
 Senior Member of Technical Staff, Cloud Networking \& Network Security
 



 We're seeking a Senior Member of Technical Staff to own the design and delivery of cloud networking features that power enterprise multi\-cloud deployments. You'll tackle complex challenges spanning routing, NAT, IPSec/VPN tunneling, traffic engineering, firewall enforcement, and network observability across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. This role bridges strong individual contribution with growing technical influence, requiring 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in cloud networking, routing protocols, VPN technologies, or network security. You'll take technical ownership from design through production delivery, with increasing influence across the engineering team.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Design and implement cloud networking features across control plane and data plane systems, authoring design documents and driving features from conception through production delivery.
* Build and troubleshoot multi\-cloud network topologies including VPC/VNet segmentation, routing tables, cloud gateways, NAT gateways, security groups, and cloud\-native connectivity models across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
* Implement and troubleshoot routing protocols (BGP, policy\-based routing), IPSec/VPN configurations (site\-to\-site, route\-based, IKEv1/IKEv2\), and NAT systems (SNAT/DNAT).
* Write production\-grade code in Python and/or Go for networking services, agents, and tooling; develop comprehensive unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests for networking components.
* Debug complex networking issues using packet analysis tools (tcpdump, Wireshark), cloud\-native diagnostics, and IPSec tools; investigate and resolve issues across lab, staging, and production environments.
* Improve telemetry, logging, and alerting for networking and VPN systems to enhance operational visibility and reliability.
* Collaborate with senior engineers on architecture discussionsparticipate in code and design reviews, mentor junior team members on networking best practices, and document runbooks and designs.



  





**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of professional engineering experience building networking\-intensive systems at a networking company, cloud infrastructure provider, or equivalent organization.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of: cloud networking (AWS VPC, Azure VNet, GCP VPC, OCI VCN), routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, static routing), IPSec/VPN technologies, or network security product development.
* Strong understanding of IP networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, ARP, ICMP, DNS, subnetting, CIDR) and working knowledge of routing protocols, IPSec/IKEv2 tunneling, VPN architectures, NAT, and firewall concepts.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Go for writing clean, maintainable, production\-grade code; comfort with Linux networking tools (iptables, ip route, tcpdump, traceroute) and shell scripting.
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD workflows; demonstrated ability to debug complex networking issues methodically.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to independently own features from design through production delivery.



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Experience with advanced cloud networking services including transit gateways, peering, private link/endpoints, and load balancers across multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with Kubernetes networking including CNI plugins, service mesh technologies, and network policies in containerized environments.
* Experience with network automation frameworks such as Terraform or Ansible, or cloud\-native APIs for infrastructure\-as\-code provisioning.
* Familiarity with distributed systems concepts applied to networking, including consistency guarantees, fault tolerance, and replication strategies.

* *Security and compliance consciousness*

**Snapmint**

 Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

 Financial Services,IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 About Snapmint
   

  

 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni (Nalin Agrawal, Anil Gelra, Abhineet Sawa), Snapmint is building India’s most loved payment brand. We pioneered Pay in 3 through UPI and are also home to India’s leading 0% EMI ecommerce app — giving millions of Indians the freedom to shop now and pay in monthly instalments, with no extra cost and no credit card required.
   

  

 Today, Snapmint has crossed 50M\+ app downloads and is the preferred payment partner for 2,000\+ leading consumer brands, including Zepto, ixigo, Adani, District Store, Titan and many more. We’re on a mission to make fair, transparent credit accessible to Young India \- and make payments simple, enjoyable and worry\-free.
   

  

 Headquartered in Mumbai, with offices across major metros including Bengaluru, Gurugram, Delhi and Jaipur, we’re building at the intersection of commerce, credit, technology and culture. If you want to work on a product used by millions, build a brand people genuinely love, and help redefine how the next generation of India pays and spends you’ll fit right in.
   

  

 Come build Snapmint and help us change how India pays.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Engineer \- Search to lead the vision, architecture, and evolution of Snapmint's Search platform. This role is responsible for building industry\-leading search experiences that help millions of users discover relevant products quickly and efficiently across Snapmint's ecommerce ecosystem.
   

  

 As a Principal Engineer, you will drive technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, influence cross\-functional product decisions, and architect highly scalable, low\-latency search systems leveraging modern Information Retrieval, Machine Learning, and Generative AI technologies.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in shaping the future of Search, Personalization, and Discovery at Snapmint.
   

  

* Role Title: Principal Engineer \- Search
* Department: Technology
* Employment Type: Fulltime
* Experience: 10\-13 Yrs.
* Location: Bengaluru
* Working Model: Work from Office – 5 Days per Week


 What You Own
   

  

* Define and drive the vision, architecture, and roadmap for Snapmint's Search \& Discovery platform.
* Architect scalable, low\-latency, and highly available search systems serving millions of requests.
* Lead search relevance initiatives across query understanding, ranking, semantic retrieval, personalization,


 and GenAI\-powered search.
   

  

* Design and optimize indexing pipelines, search APIs, and core discovery capabilities including


 autocomplete, recommendations, filters, and zero\-result recovery.
   

  

* Establish best practices for scalability, performance, observability, and operational excellence.
* Define search quality metrics (CTR, Conversion, Recall, Precision, Latency) and drive continuous improvement through experimentation and A/B testing.
* Partner with Product, Data Science, Catalog, and Personalization teams to enhance product discoverability and customer experience.
* Mentor senior engineers and provide technical leadership across the organization.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience building large\-scale Search,


 Discovery, Recommendation, or Information Retrieval systems.
   

  

* Strong expertise in Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr, or similar search technologies.
* Deep understanding of Information Retrieval fundamentals including:
* Inverted indexes
* Tokenization
* Analyzers
* BM25
* Query parsing
* Faceting
* Relevance tuning
* Ranking models

 management, multilingual search, transliteration, and query expansion.
   

  

* Experience building scalable search APIs and search platforms serving high\-volume traffic.
* Expertise in search performance optimization, capacity planning, caching strategies, and low\-latency architecture.

 architectures.
   

  

* Experience implementing Learning\-to\-Rank frameworks and ML\-driven ranking systems in production environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large technical initiatives and influence cross\-functional engineering


 organizations.

 consumer internet products.

* Conversational search

* Query rewriting

* Strong track record of mentoring senior engineers and growing technical leadership within teams.
* Experience driving experimentation frameworks and relevance optimization through A/B testing at scale.

 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

 All our customers start their Wise journey by going through customer verification. We do this to keep our customers' money safe and to prevent criminals from using our products for illegal activities.
   

  

 We in Personal Onboarding Verification are building and running the global KYC (Know Your Customer) system that provides the functionality to verify our customers. This system needs to keep up with increasingly sophisticated methods of criminals, but do it in a way to keep our product convenient and cheap for customers.
   

  

 In addition to building global KYC features, our team also builds the framework for our Regional Teams to localize the verification experience. Our colleagues in Regional Teams extend the system with local verification vendors, collect documents specific to the country and implement any other checks that the local regulations mandate.
   

  

 To succeed, our team needs to implement a system that keeps up with state of the art technology, enables several teams to contribute while keeping complexity and load manageable and has the data and observability to analyse our flows and prove they work according to regulations.

 You'll join our Personal Onboarding Verification team – a diverse, cross\-functional group passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together engineering disciplines across the stack, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our team is responsible for the critical verification journey that consumers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high autonomy, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output.  Architecture \& technical direction

 AI\-first SDLC harness

* Set the quality gates that agent\-authored changes pass before a human reviews them, and improve them as failure modes show up.



  





 Mentoring \& raising the bar
 


* Mentor engineers and run design reviews; turn what works into standards, templates, and paved roads the whole team uses.
* Spread good agent practice across the team so its leverage compounds, not just your own.



  





 Product thinking
 


* Work with product to pin down the right problem before building — scope feasibility, surface trade\-offs, and push back when the cost isn't worth the outcome.
* Own outcomes, not tickets.



  





**Skills** 



* AI\-native engineering practice — Fluent in an agentic development workflow: spec\-driven delivery, running and steering coding agents, and building the harness (specs, skills, evals, guardrails) that makes agent output reliable at the team level
* Strong language \& runtime fundamentals — Deep proficiency in one or more of the languages we work in — Java, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go — including OOP and design, concurrency, memory management, and how your runtime behaves under load. Comfortable picking the right language for the job rather than defaulting to one.
* System internals — Working knowledge of processor, memory, network, and storage internals, and how to write code that exploits hardware well and avoids bottlenecks.

* I/O\-optimised algorithms — Asynchronous and non\-blocking I/O and DMA, for high throughput in performance\-critical paths.
* Hosting \& orchestration — Kubernetes and containerised deployment of cloud\-native applications.
* Low\-level network protocols — Familiarity with gRPC, HTTP/2, and QUIC.
* Troubleshooting \& performance — Diagnosing memory issues, GC tuning, and resource leaks to keep systems stable and efficient under load.
* Delivery engineering — Branching, build, deployment, and CI/CD practices that keep delivery fast and high\-quality.
* OOAD \& algorithms — Object\-oriented analysis and design and efficient data structures for well\-structured, maintainable, performant systems.
* Cloud — AWS / Google Cloud / Azure (OpenStack where relevant).

 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 We are the Global KYC and Onboarding squad in the Servicing department and we have a mission: to enable teams at Wise to expand and fine\-tune the business in a "config change" manner all across the globe, while remaining compliant and safe for the customers. There are three teams in the squad: Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification and Wise Platform Verification (our B2B platform).
   

  

 The scale we operate at: In FY2025, 15\.6 million people and businesses used Wise, we onboarded over 5\.9 million new customers (\~500k/month), and moved £145\.2bn across borders (\~£400m/day) across 160\+ countries and 40\+ currencies. Our verification systems aren't supporting tools — they're core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies, and evolving threat patterns.
   

  

 All of the teams are diverse, cross\-functional groups passionate about solving complex problems with elegant solutions. We bring together backend and frontend engineers, mobile developers, designers, data analysts, and product managers who collaborate closely to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our teams are responsible for the critical verification journeys that business and personal customers complete before using Wise's products. We own the entire verification lifecycle – from document collection flows and automated review systems to agent tooling and compliance monitoring. We operate with high ownership in a bottom\-up, transparent culture, make data\-driven decisions, and celebrate both technical excellence and customer impact. Right now we're focused on building KYC/FinCrime as a configuration\-driven product, refactoring and building new scalable microservice systems, and increasing automation using ML/AI where it genuinely improves decisioning, review quality, and operational efficiency — with safe fallbacks and clear observability. As a team that touches both regulatory requirements and customer experience, we have unique opportunities to innovate in a space traditionally resistant to change.
   

  

 By joining one of our teams, you'll directly impact these customers by transforming a traditionally frustrating experience into one that's fast, intuitive, and fair. Your code will help individuals and small businesses access global banking faster, enable entrepreneurs to pay international employees on time, and allow people like you and your teammates support their families across borders without friction. We're not just building verification systems – we're removing barriers that stand between our customers and their financial freedom.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own large\-sized, impactful projects within the domain. Your responsibilities span end\-to\-end:
   

  

 You will own the technical roadmap for your areas of ownership, ensuring they address important technical debt, reliability, scalability, and security concerns.
   

  

 You will be instrumental in designing and implementing robust backend systems that provide clean APIs and interfaces to hide the internal complexity.
   

  

 You will drive the integration with various risk and mitigation systems to ensure that Wise is compliant.
   

  

 You will take initiative to identify and solve impactful problems both within your team and beyond, contributing to high\-impact cross\-team initiatives.
   

  

**What We Expect From You**
 You have 6\+ years of experience working with Java 8\+, Spring framework, asynchronous message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and have architected and built highly scalable microservices.
   

  

 A strong product mindset and a deep passion for both customer experience and regulatory compliance.
   

  

 You will prioritize work with a holistic view of the customer and business impact, making data\-driven decisions to solve complex, ambiguous problems.
   

  

 Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and architectural concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including product managers, designers, and other engineering teams.
   

  

 You demonstrate a commitment to writing clean, testable, maintainable, and highly performant code, and you are a strong advocate for best coding practices and rigorous code reviews.
   

  

 Proven ability to identify and lead the technical delivery of large\-scale, organisationally\-complex projects, adept at anticipating and escalating organizational blockers.
   

  

 Extensive experience working with relational and non\-relational databases, including advanced query optimization, schema design, and data lifecycle management for sensitive information.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
