title: Engineering Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.**









 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 








**What does Access offer you?**









 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 








**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 







 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 







 The F\&B Software Company sits within Access Hospitality, with engineering teams distributed globally, and powers many millions of guest experiences every day. The portfolio includes ResDiary, Dish Cult, DesignMyNight, Collins, Tonic, Soda, Wireless Social, Paytronix, Paytronix Online Ordering, QikServe Digital Ordering, Kiosk, QikServe Connect, Access EPOS, Newbridge POS, GuestPOS, Acteol, Trail, Maintain, RotaReady and CPL.
 







 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 







**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.







**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.







**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.







**Key Performance Indicators** 




**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.







**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.







**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.







**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.







**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.







**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.
* Comfortable working asynchronously across distributed teams (UK and India).







**Technologies** 




 Access F\&B runs a broad and evolving tech stack. We care far more about solid fundamentals and the ability to learn than exact technology match.
 


* Java — present across several F\&B product areas.
* TypeScript / React — frontend and web\-based ordering and management interfaces.
* Azure — our primary cloud platform; experience with Azure\-native services (App Service, Service Bus, SQL, AKS, Key Vault) is valuable.
* AWS — also present across parts of the F\&B portfolio.







**Security \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of security fundamentals: auth and authorisation patterns, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and PII handling.
* Awareness of GDPR and UK GDPR as they apply to software systems handling guest and payment data.











**What are we all about?** 








 The Access Group is one of the largest UK\-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid\-sized organisations in commercial and non\-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
 







 With
 **over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence** 
 , we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access,
 **people are at the heart of everything we do** 
 . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role \- even if your experience doesn’t tick every box \- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
 







 We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
 







 Let’s make a difference together.
 



**Love Work. Love Life. Be You.**

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Java developer, you will work closely with Solutions Architect, Application/Technical Architect, Business Analysts to create effective solutions providing robust system. You will be a key member of the development team and assisting the team with developing the application services and integrating the same with the frontend. This position will also require you to follow and implement the best design and coding practices as a part of the development team.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* You will be working as a core Java backend developer with other team members. You would be required to participate in requirement discussions, team meetings, technical sessions and reviews.
* You would be working very closely with other development team members. Your responsibility will be to integrate your work with the frontend and ensure the functionality is working end\-to\-end.
* Ensure the software is thoroughly tested and is defect\-free
* You will be asked to perform activities such as research and POCs and conduct demos/presentations to team members about the same.


**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**
**Primary Technical Skills**
* Must have 4 to 6 years of relevant work experience in Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MVC, Design Patterns and J Unit
* Good experience in AWS / Azure DevOps
* Knowledge of developing microservices using SOAP and/or RESTful API’s, XML and JSON.
* Experience with NoSQL databases, preferably with MongoDB
* Good understanding of Relational Databases like Oracle/SQL Server or MySQL


**Secondary Technical Skills**
* Worked on AGILE methodology projects
* Knowledge / experience on Reactive programming
* Knowledge / experience on Spring Security
* Knowledge / experience on Spring Cloud
* Knowledge / experience on front End technologies like JavaScript, HTML/CSS and frameworks like Angular


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduation or above. BE / MSc preferred.
* Any professional certifications.


**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded** 
 I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
   

  

**Client Delight** 
 I own every client experience and its impact on results.
   

  

**Take Action** 
 I am empowered and empower others to act now.
   

  

**Grow Talent** 
 I own my development and invest in the development of others.
   

  

**Win Together** 
 I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
   

  

**Communication Matters** 
 I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
   

  

**Embrace Diversity** 
 I create an environment of awareness and respect.
   

  

**Always Innovate** 
 I am bold and creative in everything I do.
   

  

 Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e\-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
   

  

 From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn \| Twitter

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend (Voice AI / Telephony Platform)
description:
**Experience:** 4–6 Years  

**Location:** Bengaluru (Work from Office)  

**Team:** Blue Machines – Apna’s Agentic AI Platform  

  

**Role Overview**  

  

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer (Backend)** who can design and build **high\-scale, low\-latency systems** for our AI and voice platform. The ideal candidate will have strong backend engineering fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and curiosity about **Voice AI, WebRTC, and SIP\-based integrations**.  

  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Design and develop **scalable microservices** and backend systems that power real\-time AI and voice workflows.
* Own **end\-to\-end system design** — from architecture, APIs, and data models to deployment and monitoring.
* Optimize systems for **performance, concurrency, and fault tolerance** at high scale.
* Implement **best practices for observability, testing, and resilience** (Datadog, Sentry, etc.).
* Collaborate with product and AI teams to evolve the platform’s **multi\-agent orchestration and automation layer**.

  

**Requirements** **Must\-Have Skills**

  

* 4–6 years of backend development experience in **Python** or **Java**.
* Strong grasp of **system design, concurrency, and distributed systems**.
* Experience building **scalable, high\-availability APIs or streaming systems**.
* Familiarity with **WebRTC, SIP, RTP**, or other real\-time communication protocols.
* Experience with **cloud environments (GCP/AWS)** and **containerized deployments (Kubernetes, Docker)**.
* Sound understanding of **databases (MongoDB, Redis, Postgres)** and message queues (Kafka, Pub/Sub).

**Good to Have**

  

* Exposure to **Voice AI, Speech Processing, or AI Agent frameworks**.
* Experience integrating **LLMs, vector DBs**, or real\-time **AI inference systems**.
* Prior work on **AI\-driven or telephony\-driven platforms** at scale.

  

**Benefits** **Why Join Us**

  

* Work on **India’s largest Voice AI and Agentic Automation platform**, shaping how enterprises interact with AI.
* Collaborate with a world\-class team building **scalable real\-time systems** that push latency and reliability limits.
* Opportunity to grow into **architecture, infra, or AI platform leadership roles** as Blue Machines scales globally.

title: Senior Backend Engineer – AI-Native Care Orchestration Platform
description:
**Role** 
 : Senior Backend Engineer – AI\-Native Care Orchestration Platform
 



**Location** 
 : Pune (Remote with 4\-hour overlap with Eastern Time Zone)
 



**Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



  





**About Azodha** 




 Healthcare is moving out of hospitals—into homes, virtual care, and distributed models. The technology to run this shift doesn't really exist yet. Azodha is solving that. We sit on top of existing systems and coordinate what actually makes care delivery work—people, workflows, logistics, and data—in real time. The result is a single system that replaces fragmented tools and manual coordination. We're not another point solution. We're building the operating layer for decentralized care.
 



  





**What this role is really about** 




 You'll be building backend systems used directly by clinicians and care teams—where scheduling, coordination, and data exchange need to work reliably across fragmented systems. This isn't just about writing clean code. You'll own features end\-to\-end, make real infrastructure decisions, and work closely with the founder/CEO to shape both the product and the engineering culture.
 



 If you're someone who takes pride in delivery, cares about production reliability, and wants to see the direct impact of your work on how care is delivered—this will feel like the right scope.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 




**Backend systems that hold up in the real world** 



* Design, develop, and scale backend services using Node.js and TypeScript
* Build REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints powering web and mobile applications
* Model and manage data using PostgreSQL, Prisma, and TypeORM
* Work with event\-driven architectures for coordination, notifications, and integrations



**Data that drives real\-time decisions** 



* Design and implement data pipelines using tools like Airbyte, dbt, and Apache Airflow / AWS Glue
* Design and optimize data warehousing solutions
* Enable systems to react in real time—not just report



**Systems that don't get to go down** 



* Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS, EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda
* Own CI/CD pipelines, observability, and production reliability
* Participate in on\-call rotations to ensure platform stability
* Build for environments where failures have real\-world consequences



**AI as part of the system (not a side feature)** 



* Contribute to AI\-led workflows—automation, orchestration, and data flows
* Stay current with backend and AI trends, and bring new thinking to the team



  





**Collaboration \& craft** 



* Conduct code reviews and drive engineering best practices
* Mentor junior developers with constructive, grounded technical feedback
* Work closely with product, QA, frontend, and integrations teams
* Own features from initial planning through delivery and maintenance



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on backend experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Strong experience with AWS services (ECS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and infrastructure management
* Proven experience with data pipeline tools—Airbyte, dbt, Apache Airflow, or AWS Glue
* Strong proficiency in SQL, data warehousing, and relational databases (PostgreSQL)
* Experience with ORMs like Prisma or Sequelize
* Comfortable working with event\-driven architectures and message queuing systems
* Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
* Strong track record of end\-to\-end ownership of product features
* Ability to reason about systems holistically, not just individual services
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; comfortable working async across time zones



  





**Preferred (good to have, not blockers)** 



* Experience with IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation
* Container orchestration experience with Kubernetes / Docker
* Exposure to disaster recovery and backup strategies in AWS
* Experience with GCP or Azure
* Exposure to healthcare data (HL7 / FHIR) or regulated environments
* Contributions to open\-source backend projects



  





**What you'll influence** 



* Backend architecture and data infrastructure across the platform
* Engineering standards, code quality, and delivery practices
* How AI is woven into real production workflows
* The way care delivery scales in decentralized, distributed environments



  





**Why this is worth your time** 



* The problems are real, messy, and unsolved
* The systems you build directly impact clinicians and patients
* You'll have genuine ownership—not a narrow slice of a large org
* You'll work closely with founders and shape product direction from the ground up
* You'll grow fast in a team that values depth and delivery over process



  





**If you're looking for:** 
 A well\-defined ticket queue in a large org → this isn't it Stability over impact → also not it

description:
**Job Description**

 We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.
   

  





 You will work with engineers, product managers, architects, security specialists and business stakeholders to improve Customer Identity and Access Management capabilities across Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.
   

  





 This is a long\-term strategic role with strong ownership. Over time, there will be opportunities to take broader technical leadership responsibilities within the team.
   

  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO**




 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.
   

  





 Key responsibilities include:
   

  




* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop and improve customer identity journeys, including registration, sign\-in, password reset, account recovery, multi\-factor authentication and social login.
* Integrate backend services with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID and other customer identity platforms.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and token\-based security.
* Build reliable APIs and integrations for customer profile, consent, newsletter and related customer capabilities.
* Protect customer and personal data through secure design, access controls, privacy\-aware data handling and appropriate operational controls.
* Design services for scalability, reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Improve observability through effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and alerts.
* Own services across the full lifecycle, including automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Investigate technical issues and production incidents, identify root causes and implement long\-term improvements.
* Collaborate with security, architecture, product and engineering teams to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Review code, support engineering standards, mentor colleagues and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs clearly.
* Contribute to the future evolution of the CIAM landscape, including the adoption of new identity platforms such as Strivacity.



**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**




 The CRONUS Platform Team is part of Portfolio Brands Tech and supports the digital commerce platform used by Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. The team owns shared platform capabilities that help the brands deliver stable, secure and reliable customer experiences.
   

  





 The Platform Team works across five capability areas:
   

  




* **Backend Engineering:** 
 Shared backend services and system\-to\-system integration services.
* **Site Reliability Engineering:** 
 Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.
* **Automation:** 
 Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.
* **Operations:** 
 Incident management, problem management and platform stability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** 
 Security engineering, audits and compliance.



 You will work mainly within Backend Engineering and the Identity module, while collaborating closely with SRE, operations, automation, security and other product teams. The team values end\-to\-end ownership, open communication, shared learning and practical solutions that improve customer experience and business reliability.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering and customer identity experience, along with a collaborative and ownership\-driven mindset.
   

  




* **Overall Experience:** 
 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** 
 Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** 
 Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** 
 Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.
* **Azure B2C:** 
 Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** 
 Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** 
 Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** 
 Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** 
 Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** 
 Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** 
 Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** 
 Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.



**Nice to Have**



* Experience with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus or similar technologies.
* Experience migrating between customer identity platforms or modernizing an existing CIAM solution.
* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.
* Experience working with customer consent, preference or newsletter capabilities.
* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.



**And people who are**



* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
* Curious and adaptable as technologies and identity platforms evolve.



**WHO WE ARE** 
**​**




 H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





 Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**

 At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​
   

  





 We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. title: SDE III Backend Engineer — Simulation / DES
description:
**Own core simulation engine work: the tick loop, task allocation, traffic and collision resolution, and the boundary where third\-party algorithm plugins hook into the simulation.**
**What You'll Do**
* Build and extend the discrete\-event simulation core: tick scheduling, robot state machines, task generation, and traffic or path deconfliction.
* Implement and optimize simulation algorithms — task allocation heuristics, multi\-agent path planning such as SIPP\-A\* — for correctness and performance at 400\+ agent scale.
* Own parts of the plugin boundary: calling into sandboxed third\-party algorithm modules from the simulation tick loop within a strict per\-tick latency budget.
* Work on the in\-memory map and graph representation the simulator uses for pathfinding and spatial queries.
* Write high\-quality, tested Rust in an async runtime (Tokio), with close attention to allocation patterns and tick\-time predictability.


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\-8 years of backend or systems engineering experience, with meaningful production Rust experience (2\+ years preferred).
* Experience with async Rust (Tokio or equivalent) and building systems with strict per\-operation latency budgets.
* Solid grounding in discrete\-event simulation concepts, multi\-agent systems, or game/robotics simulation — tick loops, state machines, deterministic replay.
* Comfort with algorithmic work: graph algorithms, pathfinding (A\*, Dijkstra, or similar), or scheduling and allocation problems.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with WebAssembly runtimes (Wasmtime, Wasmer, Extism) or sandboxing untrusted code.
* Familiarity with warehouse automation, robotics, AGV/AMR fleet management, or traffic simulation.
* Direct experience with SIPP, A\*, or other real\-time multi\-agent path planning algorithms.

**Job Description**  

We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on **Senior Software Engineer** to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.


You will work with engineers, product managers, architects, security specialists and business stakeholders to improve Customer Identity and Access Management capabilities across Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.


This is a long\-term strategic role with strong ownership. Over time, there will be opportunities to take broader technical leadership responsibilities within the team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.


Key responsibilities include:

* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop and improve customer identity journeys, including registration, sign\-in, password reset, account recovery, multi\-factor authentication and social login.
* Integrate backend services with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID and other customer identity platforms.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and token\-based security.
* Build reliable APIs and integrations for customer profile, consent, newsletter and related customer capabilities.
* Protect customer and personal data through secure design, access controls, privacy\-aware data handling and appropriate operational controls.
* Design services for scalability, reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Improve observability through effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and alerts.
* Own services across the full lifecycle, including automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Investigate technical issues and production incidents, identify root causes and implement long\-term improvements.
* Collaborate with security, architecture, product and engineering teams to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Review code, support engineering standards, mentor colleagues and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs clearly.
* Contribute to the future evolution of the CIAM landscape, including the adoption of new identity platforms such as Strivacity.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**


The CRONUS Platform Team is part of Portfolio Brands Tech and supports the digital commerce platform used by Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. The team owns shared platform capabilities that help the brands deliver stable, secure and reliable customer experiences.


The Platform Team works across five capability areas:

* **Backend Engineering:** Shared backend services and system\-to\-system integration services.
* **Site Reliability Engineering:** Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.
* **Automation:** Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.
* **Operations:** Incident management, problem management and platform stability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Security engineering, audits and compliance.


You will work mainly within Backend Engineering and the Identity module, while collaborating closely with SRE, operations, automation, security and other product teams. The team values end\-to\-end ownership, open communication, shared learning and practical solutions that improve customer experience and business reliability.

**WHO YOU ARE**


We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering and customer identity experience, along with a collaborative and ownership\-driven mindset.

* **Overall Experience:** 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.
* **Azure B2C:** Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus or similar technologies.
* Experience migrating between customer identity platforms or modernizing an existing CIAM solution.
* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.
* Experience working with customer consent, preference or newsletter capabilities.
* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.

**And people who are**

* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
* Curious and adaptable as technologies and identity platforms evolve.

H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.


Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines

Office**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  

  

DESCRIPTION:  

Join Thermo Fisher Scientific, the world leader in serving science, as a Staff Engineer, Software to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and architectural guidance while developing innovative software solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Working in a supportive, multi\-functional environment, you will design and implement sophisticated solutions across our product portfolio, from cloud platforms to scientific instrumentation. You will support the growth of other engineers, drive adoption of best practices, and help shape the technical direction of critical projects. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies while contributing to groundbreaking scientific discoveries.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a highly experienced **Lead Java Engineer** with 12–15 years of software development experience and strong expertise in designing and developing scalable, secure, and high\-performance backend systems.


The ideal candidate should have deep hands\-on experience with **Java, Spring Boot, REST API development, database design, and backend integration**. The candidate will be responsible for designing robust backend solutions, developing enterprise\-grade services, integrating with internal and external systems, and providing technical leadership to engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and services using **Java and Spring Boot**.

* Identify and resolve complex application, API, database, and integration\-related issues.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to software engineering and secure coding standards.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, technical leads, product owners, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and other stakeholders.
* Participate in technical design discussions, solution reviews, estimation, and implementation planning.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to backend developers.
* Drive improvements in automated testing, build processes, CI/CD, deployment, and observability practices.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **12–15 years of overall software development experience**, with significant experience in backend application development.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in **Java** and object\-oriented programming.
* Strong experience with **Spring Boot** and the broader Spring ecosystem.
* Strong experience in designing and developing **RESTful APIs and backend services**.
* Good understanding of API design principles, HTTP standards, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Strong experience in **database design, data modeling, normalization, and performance optimization**.
* Experience with relational databases such as **Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent technologies**.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and database query optimization.
* Experience with ORM and persistence frameworks such as **Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, or equivalent technologies**.
* Strong understanding of backend integration patterns and enterprise application integration.
* Experience integrating applications with internal and external services through REST APIs, messaging, or other integration mechanisms.
* Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading, asynchronous processing, and transaction management.
* Experience developing modular, reusable, and maintainable backend components.
* Strong understanding of application security and secure API development.
* Familiarity with unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience with source control systems such as **Git**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices**.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working on **large\-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems**.
* Experience with **microservices\-based applications**.
* Knowledge of messaging technologies such as **Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS, or equivalent solutions**.
* Experience with caching technologies such as Redis or similar platforms.
* Experience with API documentation tools such as OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of logging, monitoring, tracing, and observability practices.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, or equivalent technologies.
* Exposure to event\-driven systems and asynchronous integration patterns.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum software development environments.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to translate business and system requirements into robust backend solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and influence solution decisions.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross\-functional teams.
* Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex backend, database, and integration issues.
* Strong focus on software quality, reliability, and engineering excellence.

**Education**


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline**.

title: Software Development Engineer II, TFS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


If you are looking for high impact, high growth opportunity with interesting engineering challenges in a fast\-paced environment, this is the role for you. We have a number of untapped high impact engineering and business opportunities with high criticality for Amazon. And have the opportunity to work on the leading technologies like AI/ML, Gen\-AI, RAG and various AWS systems.
  

  

What will you own?  

You will work across a suite of products that drive complex business and engineering logic for managing financial accounting for \~$100B annual spend. These solutions leverage various AWS technologies and AI capabilities to solve large\-scale complex problems. The systems demand non\-trivial engineering, requiring deep business understanding and strong technical acumen. You will collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to identify opportunities for improving accuracy, expanding the solution across multiple geographies, and defining the technical roadmap while influencing solutions and tech decisions across teams.
  

  

Who we are?  

We, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) are responsible for building technologies that support financial aspects for Amazon transportation. Amazon’s transportation systems get millions of packages to customers worldwide faster and cheaper while providing world\-class customer experience – from checkout to shipment tracking to delivery. Our software systems include services that handle tens of thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted for. With rapid expansion into new geographies, innovations in supply chain, delivery models and customer experience, increasingly complex transportation network, ever\-expanding selection of products and growing number of shipments worldwide, we have an opportunity to build software that scales not only with volume but also with the business models. We leverage advanced technologies including big data, Gen\-AI, machine learning, real time analytics and high volume, low latency, high availability services.  

  

TFS is 100\+ tech team across eight different platforms. We deal with problems of scale. Billions of dollars of spend is automated through our platforms and pipelines. We are a growing org and we are looking to ramp up our team across all engineering roles. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with our global product teams and customers across the world and other tech teams in the organization as we raise the bar in delivering innovation.  

Our engineering team is completely based out of India, and we build global solutions.  

  

We have a large product and tech roadmap and are significantly ramping our tech team to meet the next level of product requirements for Trans Finance.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* The Engineer in this job is expected to make the design (High level and Low level) decisions, own end to end (depth) for specific set of features while having breadth on rest of the features and provide technical guidance for the Junior members in the team.
* Design and implement scalable solutions using Scala or Java, and AWS services
* Mentor team members and collaborate across functions to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive continuous improvement through code quality, testing, and technical debt reduction
* Provide hands\-on development for complex features while maintaining engineering excellence.

  

A day in the life  

Please reach out to avinayam@ for any further details.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Associate Technical Lead, HPC Software
description:

 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**

Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non\-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

* Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future\-proof and scalable.
* In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks
* Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
* Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
* Excellent communication, inter\-personnel skills and team co\-ordination skills
* Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments
* Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan

 Minimum 5 to 12 years of experience in Software Development \- Strong academics in BE / B Tech / MTech / MCA / MS (CS/IT)

You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and maintenance of Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) firmware for hyperscale server platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with platform firmware, hardware, validation, and customer engineering teams to develop platform management capabilities, enable new server platforms, troubleshoot complex system issues, and enhance the reliability and security of large\-scale datacenter deployments.
   

  

 This is a highly technical role where your contributions directly impact server manageability, firmware quality, platform security, and customer success.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

* Manage complex tasks across competing projects and schedules.
* Driving firmware quality, performance optimization, and platform reliability improvements
* Document firmware architecture, design decisions, debug methodologies, and customer solutions
* Stay current with emerging firmware technologies, new industry standards and specifications


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* 2\+ years of BMC development experience
* Strong programming skills in C\+\+ and Python
* Extensive experience in BMC development
* Hands on experience with OpenBMC services such as GPIO monitoring, Entity Manager, IPMI, bmcweb (Redfish)

* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Self\-starter capable of driving solutions independently and delivering results in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline
* 2\+ years of BMC Development experience
* Knowledge on Kernel/driver level development \& debugging
* Knowledge on Robot framework, Shell scripting
* Good zest for learning and adapting to changing requirements
* Experience working directly with OEMs, ODMs, silicon vendors, or hyperscale customers


**What This Role Is Not**
 This is not a maintenance or integration\-only role.
   

  

 You'll be working on the core firmware that enables platform management, monitoring, telemetry, and remote operations for hyperscale datacenter servers deployed at scale across cloud environments.

 Chennai , India
   

  

 Full\-Time

 India

Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry.

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high\-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
   

  

 The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud\-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data\-intensive solutions for regulated or asset\-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long\-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest\-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map\-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer\-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high\-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome\-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service\-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer\-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI\-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.


**First 6\-12 Months**
 The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer\-facing teams to confirm the highest\-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
   

  

 Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest\-value Unify Energy capabilities.

title: Test Lead
description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid Test Lead role for a global payer focused organization involves owning end to end testing strategy and execution for complex web services and API solutions using Agile methodologies. The Test Lead will coordinate test planning design execution and defect management across SQL based backends and payer domain workflows ensuring high quality releases that enhance member and provider experiences while supporting business growth.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Lead comprehensive test planning activities for payer domain applications by defining clear test objectives scope timelines and resource needs to ensure reliable delivery of high quality features in a hybrid work model.
  
Oversee design of detailed test scenarios and test cases for web services testing and API testing by translating business and technical requirements into robust validation steps that cover functional integration and end to end workflows.
  
Provide direction on using Postman SoapUI and Rest API tools to create execute and maintain automated and manual test suites that validate request response structures status codes and data integrity across environments.
  
Drive execution of API and web services tests with strong SQL based data validation by querying relational databases to confirm data consistency transaction accuracy and proper handling of payer specific rules.
  
Coordinate defect identification triage and retesting by working closely with developers business analysts and product owners to prioritize issues that have the highest impact on member and provider journeys.
  
Guide Agile testing ceremonies such as backlog refinement sprint planning daily standups and sprint reviews by providing risk based testing insights and aligning test efforts with sprint goals and release milestones.
  
Ensure test assets including test cases test data and API collections are structured reusable and well documented to support ongoing regression testing and smooth onboarding of new team members.
  
Collaborate with architecture and development teams to review service contracts payload structures and error handling approaches so that test coverage anticipates edge cases and performance constraints in payer systems.
  
Monitor test progress and quality metrics by preparing concise reports on test execution status defect trends and readiness indicators that support informed release decisions by stakeholders.
  
Implement and refine test processes that improve efficiency and reliability by introducing practical best practices in Agile testing environment usage and data management tailored to payer program needs.
  
Support production readiness and post release validation activities by planning smoke tests health checks and targeted API validations that reduce risk of defects impacting claims processing and customer service.
  
Mentor team members on best practices for API testing SQL validation and web services tools usage by providing constructive feedback and sharing practical examples from payer domain scenarios.
  
Coordinate with cross functional teams in English for both written and spoken communication by ensuring clear documentation issue descriptions and test evidence that facilitate quick understanding and resolution.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Display strong experience in Agile methodologies by applying iterative delivery continuous feedback and collaborative planning techniques throughout the testing lifecycle.
  
Exhibit deep hands on expertise in web services testing and API testing using Postman SoapUI and Rest API tools to validate complex service integrations.
  
Demonstrate advanced SQL skills through the ability to design and execute queries that verify transactional accuracy data transformations and audit trails in payer systems.
  
Bring proven payer domain knowledge by understanding claims flows eligibility checks benefits determination and regulatory constraints relevant to health plan operations.
  
Show capability to work effectively in a hybrid model and day shift by managing time collaboration and coordination across onsite and remote activities without requiring travel.
  
Communicate clearly in English for read write and speak capabilities by producing well structured test documentation and engaging constructively with global stakeholders.
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications include ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst or Certified Agile Tester and any recognized API testing or SQL professional credential.

* Leverage AI\-powered development tools and automation to improve development productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery.
* Explore and adopt relevant AI capabilities and engineering tools that can solve practical software development and operational challenges.



  





**REQUIREMENTS:**




**Role:** 
 Senior Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) – final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials, and interview outcomes
 



**Experience:** 
 5 – 9 Years
 



**Education:** 
 Preferred – B.Tech/B.E/M.Tech/M.E/MCA/M.S
 



**Technology Stack:** 




**(A) Core Engineering:** 




 Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event\-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI\-Powered Development Tooling
 



**(B) Good/Nice to Have:** 




 ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL

description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
