**About Level AI**
 Level AI is a Series C conversational intelligence company headquartered in Mountain View, CA, backed by top\-tier VCs and Silicon Valley operators. We help enterprise contact centers understand every customer conversation — using speech AI, NLP/NLU, and retrieval systems to turn millions of unstructured interactions into decisions businesses can act on.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 We're at the scaling inflection point. The systems that carried us from Series A to Series C won't carry us to the next stage, and we need someone to own that transition — not just build inside it.
   

  

 This is a
 **Principal** 
 role: you'll set technical direction for backend and ML infrastructure across multiple teams, make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and the standards you set by example. You'll report to the VP of
 **Engineering** 
 and partner directly with our ML, Product, and Infrastructure leads across both sites.
   

  

 You'll work alongside engineers from Amazon, Google, and Meta who chose to build here because the problems are unsolved and the ownership is real.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the architecture for real\-time data processing at scale. Design and evolve distributed messaging systems that handle high\-throughput streaming workloads with strict latency requirements.
* Build the ML platform that lets us ship models faster. Define and execute the technical roadmap for training and serving infrastructure as our models grow in size, complexity, and inference cost.
* Scale our GPU infrastructure. Own capacity planning, scheduling, and utilization across training and inference fleets — deciding what runs where, how we handle burst demand, and how we keep spend tied to actual throughput rather than idle reservations.
* Scale inference. Drive down latency and cost per request as model complexity and traffic grow: batching and routing strategies, quantization and compilation, autoscaling, and caching — without degrading output quality.
* Make reliability a property of the system, not a heroic effort. Drive uptime, observability, and incident response for serving systems that enterprise customers depend on in production.
* Turn ambiguous business problems into executable technical plans. Partner with Product and GTM to scope large cross\-functional initiatives, then break them into work other teams can run with.
* Multiply the team. Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and shape the engineering practices that outlast any single project.
* Bring the outside in. Evaluate emerging tools and techniques with judgment — adopt what earns its complexity, skip what doesn't.


 What success looks like in your first year
   

  

* 90 days: You've mapped our critical paths and failure modes, shipped a meaningful improvement to a serving or pipeline bottleneck, and earned trust across both sites.
* 6 months: You own a published technical roadmap for \[messaging / ML infra], with at least one major migration or redesign underway. GPU utilization and inference cost per request are measured, and trending the right way.
* 12 months: Our infrastructure scales predictably with customer growth, inference cost stays flat or falls as volume rises, on\-call load is down, and other engineers are making better architectural decisions because of standards you established.


 What you'll bring
   

  

* \[10]\+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with a track record of owning architecture and design at scale — not just implementing it.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with large\-scale databases, high\-throughput messaging systems, and real\-time job queues.
* Proven ability to navigate large, complex codebases and reason clearly about architectural tradeoffs in systems you didn't build.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and driving technical decisions through influence rather than authority.
* Strong written communication — you'll be making technical cases to engineers in two time zones and business cases to executives.
* BTech/MTech/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent. At this level we weight track record well above pedigree.


 Bonus points for
   

  

* Production experience with our stack: Django, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud.
* Hands\-on experience scaling GPU infrastructure and model inference in production — capacity planning, scheduling and utilization, autoscaling, and latency/cost optimization under real traffic.
* Depth in specific inference tooling — vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Ray Serve, or equivalents — and experience benchmarking tradeoffs between them.
* Experience scaling a platform through a comparable growth stage (Series C → D, or equivalent), especially at a global product company's India site.
* Background in speech, NLP, or information retrieval systems.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Health coverage for you, your spouse, children, and parents.
* \[home\-office and connectivity allowance / annual learning budget / parental leave — trim to what's accurate].
* Real ownership over systems used by enterprises worldwide, with the autonomy to decide how they're built.

**About Level AI**
 Level AI is a Series C conversational intelligence company headquartered in Mountain View, CA, backed by top\-tier VCs and Silicon Valley operators. We help enterprise contact centers understand every customer conversation — using speech AI, NLP/NLU, and retrieval systems to turn millions of unstructured interactions into decisions businesses can act on.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 We're at the scaling inflection point. The systems that carried us from Series A to Series C won't carry us to the next stage, and we need someone to own that transition — not just build inside it.
   

  

 This is a
 **Principal** 
 role: you'll set technical direction for backend and ML infrastructure across multiple teams, make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and the standards you set by example. You'll report to the VP of
 **Engineering** 
 and partner directly with our ML, Product, and Infrastructure leads across both sites.
   

  

 You'll work alongside engineers from Amazon, Google, and Meta who chose to build here because the problems are unsolved and the ownership is real.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the architecture for real\-time data processing at scale. Design and evolve distributed messaging systems that handle high\-throughput streaming workloads with strict latency requirements.
* Build the ML platform that lets us ship models faster. Define and execute the technical roadmap for training and serving infrastructure as our models grow in size, complexity, and inference cost.
* Scale our GPU infrastructure. Own capacity planning, scheduling, and utilization across training and inference fleets — deciding what runs where, how we handle burst demand, and how we keep spend tied to actual throughput rather than idle reservations.
* Scale inference. Drive down latency and cost per request as model complexity and traffic grow: batching and routing strategies, quantization and compilation, autoscaling, and caching — without degrading output quality.
* Make reliability a property of the system, not a heroic effort. Drive uptime, observability, and incident response for serving systems that enterprise customers depend on in production.
* Turn ambiguous business problems into executable technical plans. Partner with Product and GTM to scope large cross\-functional initiatives, then break them into work other teams can run with.
* Multiply the team. Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and shape the engineering practices that outlast any single project.
* Bring the outside in. Evaluate emerging tools and techniques with judgment — adopt what earns its complexity, skip what doesn't.


 What success looks like in your first year
   

  

* 90 days: You've mapped our critical paths and failure modes, shipped a meaningful improvement to a serving or pipeline bottleneck, and earned trust across both sites.
* 6 months: You own a published technical roadmap for \[messaging / ML infra], with at least one major migration or redesign underway. GPU utilization and inference cost per request are measured, and trending the right way.
* 12 months: Our infrastructure scales predictably with customer growth, inference cost stays flat or falls as volume rises, on\-call load is down, and other engineers are making better architectural decisions because of standards you established.


 What you'll bring
   

  

* \[10]\+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with a track record of owning architecture and design at scale — not just implementing it.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with large\-scale databases, high\-throughput messaging systems, and real\-time job queues.
* Proven ability to navigate large, complex codebases and reason clearly about architectural tradeoffs in systems you didn't build.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and driving technical decisions through influence rather than authority.
* Strong written communication — you'll be making technical cases to engineers in two time zones and business cases to executives.
* BTech/MTech/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent. At this level we weight track record well above pedigree.


 Bonus points for
   

  

* Production experience with our stack: Django, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud.
* Hands\-on experience scaling GPU infrastructure and model inference in production — capacity planning, scheduling and utilization, autoscaling, and latency/cost optimization under real traffic.
* Depth in specific inference tooling — vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Ray Serve, or equivalents — and experience benchmarking tradeoffs between them.
* Experience scaling a platform through a comparable growth stage (Series C → D, or equivalent), especially at a global product company's India site.
* Background in speech, NLP, or information retrieval systems.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Health coverage for you, your spouse, children, and parents.
* \[home\-office and connectivity allowance / annual learning budget / parental leave — trim to what's accurate].
* Real ownership over systems used by enterprises worldwide, with the autonomy to decide how they're built.

* Drive iterations on credit policy and improve credit decision systems.
* Collaborate with product, credit/finance, compliance, support and analytics teams.


**Why you're a great fit**

* Demonstrated experience working in AWS\-native environments, using tools like DynamoDB, Athena and Lambda.

### **We believe in**


* **Innovate:** Build our tech stack with purpose\-driven engineers to craft robust, scalable products that power economic growth.
* **Design for the future:** Lay the foundation of technology that connects businesses, enabling seamless growth and transformation.
* **Engineer the Core:** Create resilient, and secure software systems that form the backbone of our mission to drive global prosperity.

* **CI/CD \& Automation:** Maintain robust CI/CD pipelines and drive continuous test automation to minimize turnaround time for new releases.
* **Research \& Distillation:** Actively research state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models (e.g., Qwen3, Mistral) and apply Knowledge Distillation to create smaller, faster proprietary models.

* **Code Quality and Best Practices:** Ensure that code adheres to best practices, including clean code principles, testing, and documentation.
* **Build Agentic Systems:** Implement multi\-agent workflows using LangGraph to solve complex, multi\-step user queries.
* **Optimize for Scale:** Implement Quantization and vLLM/SGLang strategies to reduce inference costs and latency in production.

title: Lead Engineer - Backend (Data Platform)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Backend / Data Platform to provide technical leadership for backend and data-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify AB Tasty. This is a hands-on technical leadership role , not an engineering management position. You will continue to design systems and write production code , while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams. You will work across Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP , solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low-latency serving, and reporting. A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers. 
The Engineering Landscape Our production data platform includes: ClickHouse - self-hosted and ClickHouse Cloud for high-volume analytics and SaaS reporting BigQuery - large-scale analytics and data processing Bigtable - low-latency NoSQL serving Redis - caching, queues, and distributed coordination Kafka - high-volume real-time event streaming GCP - GCS, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, IAM, Secret Manager, GKE and VMs Java - Spring Boot and JVM-based backend services Apache Beam / Dataflow - distributed event and batch processing Go - adjacent SQL and reporting services Alongside the existing platform, we are building capabilities around: Warehouse-native experiment computation in customer Snowflake/BigQuery environments Cross-platform visitor profiles and identity First-party cohorts and saved audiences Unified metrics across internal and customer warehouses Converging Wingify and AB Tasty analytics onto a common data foundation 
What Youll Do Architecture System Design Own the technical architecture and design of significant backend/data-platform workstreams. Design distributed systems for high-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low-latency serving . Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost . Evaluate trade-offs across ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and other technologies based on workload characteristics. Drive designs that can evolve as the Wingify and AB Tasty platforms converge. Hands-on Engineering Remain hands-on with Java and production backend code . Build and evolve backend services, query engines, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems. Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks. Solve difficult production problems involving slow queries, data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure . Work with Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, GCS, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, and Redis at production scale. Own critical systems through design, implementation, deployment, observability, and operation . Technical Leadership Set technical direction for a platform area or major engineering workstream . Break ambiguous product and platform requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans. Review architecture and designs from other engineers and challenge assumptions constructively. Establish engineering practices around reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and maintainability . Mentor SSE-1/SSE-2 engineers and help them grow their system-design and production-engineering capabilities. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams. Influence architecture beyond your immediate projects without requiring formal people-management authority. 
What Were Looking For 6+ years of hands-on backend/software engineering experience , with substantial experience building distributed or data-intensive systems. Demonstrated ownership of architecture and system design for production systems at meaningful scale. Strong hands-on Java experience, including modern Java and JVM backend systems. Strong experience designing systems around analytical databases, data warehouses, and/or large-scale non-relational stores . Deep understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, query execution, caching, concurrency, and performance optimisation . Strong SQL and analytical-querying experience. Experience designing and operating streaming/event-driven architectures , ideally using Kafka or equivalent technologies. Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale. Strong cloud engineering experience; GCP is preferred. Experience operating production systems with clear SLOs, observability, failure handling, and performance requirements . Strong debugging ability across applications, distributed systems, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure. Experience mentoring senior engineers, reviewing technical designs, and influencing architecture . Ability to balance long-term platform architecture with pragmatic delivery. 
Nice to Have Deep production experience with ClickHouse , including schema design, MergeTree engines, partitioning, sorting keys, query optimisation, replication, and performance tuning. BigQuery and Bigtable at significant production scale. Apache Beam / Dataflow . Snowflake or warehouse-native compute architectures. Go , Vert.x, or other high-performance backend technologies. Experience handling billions of events and/or TB-PB scale analytical datasets . Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity resolution, cohorts, or behavioural analytics. Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
Core Skills Java System Design Distributed Systems Data Platform ClickHouse SQL BigQuery Bigtable Kafka Redis GCP Pub/Sub Dataflow ETL Microservices Technical Leadership

title: Sr.Backend Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, distributed systems, microservices, and AWS cloud technologies. The engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, scaling, and supporting highly available backend services and APIs for customer-facing applications. The role requires strong ownership of backend architecture, application performance, production reliability, security, observability, and cloud-native engineering practices. Experience with React frontend development and/or Java/Spring Boot is beneficial but not mandatory. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and TypeScript. Build reliable, secure, and highly available microservice-based and distributed applications. Design and implement efficient data models and access patterns using Amazon DynamoDB. Build cloud-native and event-driven backend solutions using AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch. Develop asynchronous processing workflows, background jobs, integrations, and messaging-based architectures. Define backend architecture, service boundaries, API contracts, data flows, and relationships between distributed components. Troubleshoot and resolve complex customer-facing and production issues across backend services and cloud infrastructure. Proactively identify and address issues related to performance, scalability, stability, security, availability, and extensibility. Participate actively in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews. Ensure backend services meet defined standards for performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and quality. Write automated unit, integration, API, and service-level tests. Monitor and troubleshoot production applications using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. Maintain high availability and demonstrate strong ownership of customer trust and production reliability. Support and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, containerization, and deployment processes. Collaborate with product managers, quality engineers, architects, and globally distributed engineering teams. Work in an Agile/Scrum development environment. Take end-to-end ownership of backend features throughout the complete software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through deployment and production support. Mentor engineers and contribute to backend engineering standards, development practices, and architectural guidelines. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 7-9 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years of strong backend development experience. Strong hands-on programming experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, backend services, and microservice-based applications. Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented principles, software design patterns, and architectural principles. Experience designing scalable and maintainable distributed backend systems. Hands-on experience with Amazon DynamoDB, including: Partition key and sort key design Global and local secondary indexes Query and access-pattern-based data modelling Performance and scalability considerations Strong experience developing cloud-native applications using AWS services such as: ECS / Lambda / S3 / SQS / API Gateway / CloudWatch Experience building asynchronous, queue-based, and event-driven processing workflows. Experience developing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available applications. Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, or equivalent backend testing frameworks. Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD platforms. Experience using Git-based source-control and development workflows. Strong understanding of application monitoring, debugging, observability, incident troubleshooting, and production-support practices. Good understanding of API security, authentication/authorization, error handling, resiliency, and backend performance optimization. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 
 Skills 
 
 Primary Skills 
 Must-have Node.js / TypeScript and JavaScript Backend application development RESTful APIs and microservices Distributed systems and service-oriented architecture AWS ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch Amazon DynamoDB Event-driven and asynchronous application design Docker CI/CD pipelines Unit and integration testing Production troubleshooting and application observability Backend performance, scalability, security, and reliability 
 
 Secondary Skills 
 Java and Spring Boot React HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript frontend development MySQL or PostgreSQL Redis or Amazon ElastiCache AWS Step Functions, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, and EC2 Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation Kubernetes NestJS or Express.js OpenTelemetry, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar observability tools Experience with messaging, event streaming, or distributed workflow platforms

description:

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.
   

  

 Your Role \& Mission
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast\-growing company, working on a cross\-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an
 **AI\-native** 
 role. We're not looking for someone who
 *also*

 *with* 
 it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure\-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone.

You'll interface daily with design, front\-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross\-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas.
   

  

 Daily Adventures \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
* Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de\-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
* Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure\-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
* Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
* Scope and reshape under\-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
* Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
* Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up\-level the team
* Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
* Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
* Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* AI\-native engineers. You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure\-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast\-moving toolset.
* Comfort in unfamiliar code. You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de\-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
* Architectural ownership \& operational readiness. You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
* Ownership start to finish. Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
* Collaboration you can trust. You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with.
* Product judgment. You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec.
* Growth \& learning. You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work.
* Proactivity. You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You can operate without a fully\-specified problem and bring structure to it.
* Organization \& planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
* Strong communication. Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3\-4 years in senior positions, building large\-scale applications with right observability.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design
* Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure\-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
* Experience developing distributed web applications
* Write code that is comprehensible, well\-structured, and highly performant
* Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
* Experience using and designing RESTful services

description:
**About Company:**

It is focused on reducing the burden of musculoskeletal conditions, which affects about 25% of the world's population. Their 1st product, KIMIA Recover, a continuous monitoring device for the knee joint, has obtained CE marking and HSA approval and booked revenues from large implant companies and hospitals. It has recently won the Innomatch grant by the Temasek Foundation (one of the 6 among 256 companies across 32 countries), and is currently deployed in some of the largest public hospitals in Singapore. KIMIA Recover is a comprehensive recovery management solution that provides a reduction in the number of hospital visits and complications. The product was also the National Winner and International Top 20 of the prestigious James Dyson Award 2020 and has gained traction with major public hospitals and orthopaedic clinics. Their digital therapy platform, consisting of KIMIA Assess and KIMIA Move products, uses artificial intelligence technology for digital MSK assessment and therapy. **Ideal Candidate:**

title: Software Development Engineer II, Direct Fulfilment
description:
**Description**
 Join a talented team of software engineers and technical leaders dedicated to reaching the next billion customers. This role offers the opportunity to work on high\-impact, complex challenges as we scale our systems to support new and rapidly growing India and emerging marketplaces. As a software engineer on the team, you will be responsible for the technical design and implementation of solutions that enable our Direct Fulfillment (DF) model. DF allows vendors to ship products directly to customers on behalf of Amazon. This requires building systems that can reliably work end\-to\-end for emerging and global marketplaces and enable seamless customer experiences. If you're excited to grow your skills while helping us scale the world's most customer\-centric retail technology, we'd love to hear from you!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a technical leader to drive the
   

  

* Designing and developing highly reliable, scalable, and distributed systems.
* Delivering quality features on\-time and execution against project plans and delivery commitments.
* Working with team members to manage the day\-to\-day development activities, participate in designs, design review, code review, implementation, and operational excellence.
* Engaging and working with customers and dependencies to ensure the quality delivery.
* Mentoring other engineers
* Maintaining current technical knowledge to support rapidly changing technology, always on a look out for new technologies and work with the team in bringing in new technologies.
* Launch products to India as well as world\-wide marketplaces


**About The Team**
 Direct Fulfillment (DF), known in the industry as "dropship," is a fulfillment model that allows vendors to ship orders directly to the Customer. The offer is branded as 'Ships and Sold by Amazon' and the customer service experience is the same as items sold from Amazon Fulfillment centers, such that the customer does not know the difference. DF was launched in India (IN) on Oct 2018\. Our vision: “provide customers with widest possible retail selection while maintaining a superior experience for vendors and cost structure for Amazon”.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of professional software engineering \& best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Lead Member of Technical Staff- Performance Suite
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.


We are looking for **Lead** **Member of Technical Staff** to join our Clinicals test team within our Bangalore R\&D division. Your job will be to design script which will enable establish front end \& backend performance benchmarks for the products and services offered for Clinicals. Help us reach our goal of becoming the healthcare backbone by enhancing our cloud based EHR solution and leveraging the network effect of 85,400\+ providers. Apply your technical skills towards delivering a quality product to customers and allowing doctors to be doctors so that they can spend more time doing what they do best: provide patient care.

*But enough about us, let’s talk about you.”.*


You are Technologists with zeal to solve complex problems, growth mindset, fast learners who are willing to work in fast paced environment with total accountability.


Our athena Clinicals automation team is looking forward to establishing front end / backend performance benchmarks for clinicals workflows which shall enable resolve performance bottlenecks which enable build confidence on quality and enables doctors’ workflows that is used by over 100,000 healthcare providers daily. We build quality practices which interface and make interactions between these providers and the electronic health record as seamless as possible, and elevates what the doctor needs to see, when they need to see it. This team is innovative, passionate, and driven by our mission to help make an impact.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and execute performance test scripts using tool such as JMeter/ K6\.
* Analyse test results and identify performance bottlenecks, scalability issues, and reliability problems.
* Profile performance bottlenecks by using profiling tools and identify root cause.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand performance requirements and translate them into effective performance test scenarios.
* Provide recommendations for performance improvements based on test results and analysis.
* Monitor system performance during load tests to identify performance degradation and potential optimizations.
* Create performance testing reports and documentation for stakeholders and management.
* Participate in architectural and design reviews to provide performance\-related insights and recommendations.
* Stay updated with the latest performance testing tools, techniques, and best practices.
* Work closely with developers, QA engineers, and infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.

**Typical Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* Proficiency in performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6\.
* Strong understanding of performance testing methodologies, processes, and best practices.
* Efficient in using AI tools like Claude / Codex and designing skills which enable E2E performance test script design
* Hands on experience with profiling tools like Datadog, JVisual VM, GC analysis, AWR report analysis, heap dump and thread dump analysis to identify performance bottlenecks.
* Familiarity with SQL or Oracle queries
* Basic understanding of C\#, Java or any programming language.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

***What we can do for you:***

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*

*We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*

*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

*Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers*

* Develop scalable, highly available applications, APIs, and services using technologies such as Marko, React, Node.js, Java, and Scala.

Our team takes a world view of payments for all of Amazon and builds highly customized and seamless payment experiences for our global customers. This focus on geography and customer requires working on different technologies \& back\-end systems in order to meet the needs of our customers. Our back\-end systems are always available and guarantee that our customer’s orders are never lost and always processed even when downstream services are down.  

Our team is highly motivated and in need of a engineer who can take the technical reigns of the team and steer them in the direction of our vision.

title: Senior Backend Engineer II
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

### **Your Role \& Mission**



As a Senior Backend Engineer at Apollo, you'll be a critical part of a fast\-growing company, working on a cross\-functional team to build highly scalable systems and set the bar for how we engineer. The way we build has changed: this is an **AI\-native** role. We're not looking for someone who *also* uses AI, we're looking for someone who thinks *with* it, forms their own hypotheses, pressure\-tests what AI produces, catches its errors, and design more robustly than they could alone.



You'll work in an open, collaborative environment, give and receive hands\-on mentorship, and have real opportunities to grow. You'll interface daily with design, front\-end, analytics, product, and teams beyond Engineering. You enjoy working cross\-functionally to solve hard problems and make an impact. You strive for quality, are obsessed with improving it, automation, monitoring, squashing the bugs that sneak through and you're always investigating performance improvements and better ideas.


### **Daily Adventures \& Responsibilities**


* Design and implement highly scalable, highly available backend services with proper monitoring and alerting in place
* Ramp quickly into large, unfamiliar codebases, de\-risk your changes, understand blast radius, and ship with confidence
* Use AI as a core part of your workflow: generate and pressure\-test approaches, verify and catch AI's mistakes, and stand behind the quality of the code you ship with it
* Drive the full lifecycle of software development: product requirements, architecture, solution design, development, quality assurance, and maintenance, ownership doesn't end at deploy
* Scope and reshape under\-specified problems, and write clear design docs that satisfy real product needs
* Partner closely with PMs: translate product intent into technical decisions, surface the technical realities they need to make good calls, and push back on the spec when reality changes the answer
* Mentor others on best practices and effectively share knowledge to up\-level the team
* Communicate progress clearly to the product lead, engineering manager, and other stakeholders
* Introduce new technologies and ideas when they earn their place
* Give and receive technical and behavioral feedback; engage in scrum ceremonies, team culture, and collaborate with the team.

### **What We're Looking For**


* **AI\-native engineers.** You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure\-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast\-moving toolset.
* **Comfort in unfamiliar code.** You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de\-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
* **Architectural ownership \& operational readiness.** You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
* **Ownership start to finish.** Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed
* **Collaboration you can trust.** You let others speak, seek to understand their viewpoints, and are the kind of teammate people want to build with.
* **Product judgment.** You care about the customer outcome, make the technical calls that produce a great product, and know when to challenge a spec.
* **Growth \& learning.** You actively improve your craft, your team, and how you work.
* **Proactivity.** You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** You can operate without a fully\-specified problem and bring structure to it.
* **Organization \& planning.** You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
* **Strong communication.** Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non\-technical audiences.

### **Qualifications**


* Minimum 5\+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3\-4 years in senior positions, building large\-scale applications with right observability.
* Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design
* Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure\-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
* Experience developing distributed web applications
* Write code that is comprehensible, well\-structured, and highly performant
* Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
* Experience using and designing RESTful services


**Must have:** Curiosity, AI\-native engineering judgment, communication skills, problem solving.


**Nice to have:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning



Apollo.io Tech Blog: deep dives into engineering, product design, and company\-culture stories from the Apollo team — behind\-the\-scenes insight into how Apollo builds and scales its B2B sales platform.

### **We are AI Native**



Apollo.io is an AI\-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.


### **Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo**

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.


**About this role:**

This is a hands\-on technical role responsible for guiding the design, development, and execution of test strategies and automation frameworks. This role provides technical expertise to the QA team, mentors test engineers, and collaborates closely with developers, product owners, and project managers to ensure high\-quality product delivery.


**Skills \& Experience**

* Lead the technical implementation of test strategies, frameworks, and automation solutions for web and mobile applications.
* Participate in the recruitment and onboarding of new QA team members.
* Hands\-on experience with UI, API, and DB test automation, including framework design and maintenance.
* Strong expertise in implementing and maintaining automated test solutions to minimize manual testing.
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Gitlab, etc.) to integrate automated testing into build pipelines.
* Solid understanding of Agile, BDD, DevOps, and modern QA methodologies.

**What you will do:**

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


* Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for functional and non\-functional testing (UI, DB, API, performance, etc.).
* Lead the creation and execution of comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts, ensuring alignment with project requirements and quality standards.
* Own the execution and reporting of system, integration, end to end, and regression testing activities.
* Identify, document, and prioritize defects with appropriate severity; collaborate with development teams to resolve issues efficiently. Lead and own defect triage calls with product owner and development team.
* Implement and advocate QA best practices, tools, and metrics within the team.
* Drive the automation strategy for assigned projects, ensuring coverage and efficiency.
* Review and optimize test case management and defect tracking processes (e.g., JIRA).
* Provide clear and concise status updates, including metrics and risk assessments, to project stakeholders.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, and scrum teams to align testing with project goals and customer requirements.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in test automation, integrating new tools and techniques as appropriate.
* Support and coach team members in technical problem\-solving and professional development.

**What you will need**

A strong IT professional with 4–6 years of experience in software testing. The candidate should have excellent technical, analytical, and communication skills, and demonstrate high ownership and accountability.

* Proven experience designing and implementing manual and automated test solutions.

* Strong attention to detail, end\-user quality, and usability.
* Self\-motivated and excellent problem\-solving skills.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


This is a Senior Lead Principal Engineer position responsible for establishing and implementing innovative technology solutions and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to lead complex engineering initiatives across various domains, including **Business Intelligence (BI) tools, Big Data, Agentic AI, and Machine Learning.** We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer with extensive experience building robust, high\-performance, and large\-scale applications. We are constantly evolving our significant software assets and are seeking a leader who is passionate about leveraging diverse technologies to drive technical excellence and innovation.


**Team Background**


The Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions. These tools allow sales, traders, operations staff and risk officers to manage Citi's exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software that provides a complete platform for their users: limit monitoring, exception management, stress testing analysis and escalation workflow capabilities are some key areas of focus.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Provide technical leadership and development oversight to the wider team of Software Engineers/Analysts. Ensure application design adheres to the appropriate architectural and design patterns for **scalable and intelligent systems.**
* Develop key software components personally, and use your code as a teaching tool across the team for patterns and techniques, especially concerning **Agentic AI design and implementation.**
* Host sessions for design and code review at multiple levels of the organization. Improve our engineering standards and process to make the team more capable and efficient, embracing **AI\-assisted development practices, including the use of tools like Git Copilot and Devin AI.**
* Collaborate effectively with a large global team of software engineers, business analysts, dev\-ops and support staff to deliver software solutions for the business.
* Lead the adoption of new technologies where appropriate to solve business problems while adhering to Citi's architectural guidelines, with a strong focus on **Agentic AI and Machine Learning frameworks.**
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level/junior developers and analysts, helping build the overall engineering capabilities of the team, particularly in **AI/ML and intelligent systems development.**
* Appropriately assess risk when decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Ideal background**


* Full\-stack developer with 10\+ years of experience in designing and developing robust, scalable, and maintainable applications applying Object Oriented Design principles.
* Hands\-on experience in Web technologies (HTML, CSS, React JS), REST\-APIs, and Backend using Java/J2EE technologies.
* **Deep experience with Big Data technologies and data platforms capable of handling vast datasets for training, serving, and managing AI models.**
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and deployment/packaging solutions such as Dockers/Kubernetes, OpenShift.
* Experience with Agile software development processes with a strong emphasis on test driven development.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and experience in tools such as JIRA, BlackDuck, SONAR etc.
* Deep understanding of JVM internals such as class loading and memory management.

**Skills**


Extensive experience working with most if not all the technologies listed below:


* Java Core with extensive hands\-on experience with concurrent programming.
* Spring Framework including Core, Integration, Batch, JDBC, Hibernate.
* Distributed Caching frameworks such as Oracle Coherence, Redis or equivalent.
* Cloud computing technologies with practical experience working with containers, microservices and large datasets (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Expertise in **Big Data / Data Lake system architecture that supports enterprise data warehouse, real\-time data processing, and large\-scale data ingestion for AI/ML workloads.**
* Databases \- RDBMS preferably Oracle, NoSQL preferably MongoDB.
* Familiarity with Linux environment including scripting skills.
* SDLC/Dev Ops \- Git/BitBucket, CI/CD pipeline frameworks such as Jenkins, SonarQube, JIRA, any secure coding toolkits.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate and optimize AI\-assisted coding and development tools (e.g., Git Copilot, Devin AI) into team workflows to maximize efficiency and innovation.
* Hands\-on experience with data governance, metadata management, and data lineage platforms to maintain high data quality and auditability for AI systems.
* Ability to evaluate design trade\-offs and document choices effectively.
* Demonstrated capacity to build sophisticated tooling for development and production team use.

**Preferred:**

* Knowledge and experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau and Cognos for data visualization and reporting.
* Experience with Big Data querying tools including Google BigQuery, Starburst, and DuckDB.
* Experience with prominent Machine Learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn, Hugging Face) and their deployment in production.

title: Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge
description:
**Exasol Evergreen Talents Hunt Challenge**

**Location: Chennai, India**  

**Why Exasol? Why Now?**


Exasol is a high\-performance analytics database built for data at scale, for the new AI era. At Exasol, our engineers solve hard problems across distributed systems, performance, reliability and real\-world customer workloads needed for this new AI era.


The new AI era requires creators and builders who enjoy building robust technology and tackling complex technical challenges. We are building an evergreen talent community that enjoys doing so.


Here is an opportunity for you to be part of this evergreen talent community. Yes, it’s not a challenge for a job opening, but more a fodder for the hungry minds, a challenging teaser to the builder of the new AI era, that may lead to new opportunities in Exasol.


**How It Works?**

* Go through the OpenSource Challenge listed below
* Show us how you think, build and solve it
* Enjoy handsome rewards for best solutions
* Get into our Exasol Evergreen talent community.
* As part of Exasol Evergreen talent community, you will be prioritized for roles opening within Exasol. You will also be invited to participate in their meetups, conferences, webinars and any other events. You could be eligible for testing Exasol pre\-releases

**The Challenge \- Welcome to Exasol's Opensource Challenge**

* Pick a public open source project that is not hosted by Exasol
* The project must have at least 100 stars on GitHub
* Make it compatible with or add a feature for Exasol (e.g., by contributing a connector to the upstream project)
* Add automatic integration tests
* The upstream maintainers must accept and merge your contribution
* Make sure you will be able to maintain it
* Present the result


**Example Projects**


The list below is just to show what kind of upstream projects we mean. Participants to not have to pick those. There are hundreds of potential projects out in the world.

* GitHub \- xo/usql: Universal command\-line interface for SQL databases
* GitHub \- dbeaver/cloudbeaver: Cloud Database Manager
* GitHub \- kayak/pypika: PyPika is a python SQL query builder that exposes the full richness of the SQL language using a syntax that reflects the resulting query. PyPika excels at all sorts of SQL queries but is especially useful for data analysis.


**The Dos**

* Integrate with an existing open source project
* Ensure it is getting accepted upstream
* Make it maintainable. This is the most critical point
* Even if you maintain an upstream project, you can participate


**The Donts**

* Don’t start a new open source project just to integrate Exasol
* Maintainability should not require rewriting and more work


**Evaluation**


If someone manages to fulfill all criteria of the challenge, we will do a code and documentation review, to gauge how well that was executed.


Criteria (in descending order of importance):

* Security
* User experience
* Performance
* Maintainability


Winners (multiple categories) will be declared post evaluation and prizes given.


**What’s in it for You**


Completing a challenge gives you the opportunity to connect with Exasol, demonstrate your skills and ability to build new things, and become part of the broader global data community.

**Ready to Launch Your Career with Exasol?**


If you’re hungry to learn, unafraid to fail, and energized by the idea of helping the world’s leading organizations unlock the power of their data — we want to hear from you.


Apply now and be part of Exasol’s next chapter.

**About Exasol**


Take the next step in your career journey. Visit www.exasol.com to explore our current job openings, and follow us on LinkedIn to see what it is like to work at Exasol.


Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in TypeScript and Python, and you will own the Kubernetes deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
  
  

These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user’s shoes before shipping.
  
  

Roles \& Responsibilities
  
  

Building Platform Capabilities
  
  

Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
  
Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
  
Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
  
Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
  
Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow
  
  

Deployment \& Operations
  
  

Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes, writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
  
Ship through GitOps with Flux, so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
  
**Configure the API layer in front of your services:** routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
  
Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
  
Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking
  
  

Working in the Team
  
  

Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
  
Review other people’s code and take review well on your own
  
Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls
  
Qualifications \& Skills
  
  

Must Have
  
  

3–5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
  
Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
  
**Real Kubernetes experience:** you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
  
Hands\-on with Docker and Helm
  
CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
  
Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
  
Working knowledge of relational databases
  
You use AI tools every day, to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
  
Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
  
Fluent in English
  
  

Nice to Have
  
  

API gateway experience such as Kong, a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
  
GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
  
OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
  
Event\-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
  
Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
  
Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
  
GraphQL
  
Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
  
Background in financial services or another regulated industry
  
Mindset
  
  

**We are looking for someone who:**  

Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks "would I want to integrate with this?" before shipping
  
Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
  
Is curious and self\-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**About Gravitee**
 Since 2015, Gravitee has grown into a global force, recognized as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management. What started with four developers challenging the complexities of APIs has evolved into a revolutionary platform powering API and event stream ecosystems worldwide. We drive digital transformation for top enterprises \- from Michelin to Roche to Blue Yonder \- offering unmatched control over APIs and event streams.
   

  

 Now, we are leading the next evolution: AI Agent Management. Our platform brings security and governance to the agentic ecosystem \- with our Agent Gateway for A2A protocol communications, native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, and multi\-agent, multi\-LLM control. We are building the infrastructure that lets enterprises unlock the full potential of AI, securely and at scale.
   

  

 Our rapid growth and leadership in API management are fueled by our team's commitment to excellence and our core values:
   

  

* Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve.
* Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards.
* Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers.


 Join us on this journey. Be part of a team that is redefining what is possible in API management, and shaping the future of digital transformation. The possibilities are endless \- be a part of the revolution!
   

  

 The Role \& Why It Exists
   

  

 As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of a Platform Team dedicated to making Gravitee's products best in class in terms of both product and infrastructure. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers Gravitee's platform, while also supporting our customers with exceptional technical expertise.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, critical role in our organization. The right candidate will enjoy problem solving in a highly specialized and technical way \- from delivering production\-ready Kubernetes\-based environments to investigating complex customer issues.
   

  

 As Gravitee expands into AI Agent Management, the Platform team plays a critical role in ensuring our infrastructure can support AI workloads, agent orchestration, and the demanding performance requirements of real\-time AI gateway operations.
   

  

 What You Will Be Doing
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Participate in delivering Gravitee NextGen Cloud infrastructure, including environments that support AI Gateway and Agent Management workloads
* Deliver production\-ready, Kubernetes\-based, customer\-facing environments \- not just POCs
* Assist the support team to help customers have the best experience possible with our products
* Work with other team members to develop and maintain new infrastructure features
* Share your knowledge (tech and non\-tech) during internal Gravitee TechTalks
* Lead investigation of support tickets and work collaboratively to resolve customer issues
* Create knowledge articles to complete documentation and enable customers to better understand product use cases
* Be innovative within the team to help improve processes and tools, including exploring AI\-driven automation for operations


 AI \& Automation Mindset
   

  

 At Gravitee, We See AI As a Force Multiplier For Engineers, Not a Replacement For Solid Engineering Fundamentals. We Expect You To
   

  

* Be open and proactive in using AI\-assisted tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, troubleshooting aids, automation helpers) to accelerate day\-to\-day work
* Use AI thoughtfully to improve existing processes, reduce manual toil, and increase reliability in operations and support workflows
* Experiment with AI\-driven approaches to problem solving, documentation, and incident analysis, while maintaining a strong critical mindset
* Understand the limits of AI tools and apply engineering judgment to validate, refine, and productionize outcomes
* Contribute ideas on how AI can be safely and effectively integrated into our platform, infrastructure, and internal tooling


 AI at Gravitee is not about shortcuts \- it is about working smarter, faster, and more sustainably at scale.
   

  

**Essential Skills**
 The right candidate will possess at least the following skills:
   

  

* 5\+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management
* Fluency with creating and managing Kubernetes clusters and Helm\-based deployments
* Strong understanding of infrastructure and deployment automation
* Experience with Terraform, Docker, and certificate management (ZeroSSL, Let's Encrypt)
* Experience with continuous delivery tools (Argo Workflows, ArgoCD, Helm Charts)
* Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus)
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning
* Patient, resilient problem\-solver with great attention to detail


**Desired Skills**
 Additionally, these skills are not required but preferable:
   

  

* Experience with API Management or Identity and Access Management platforms
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements and GPU workload orchestration
* Experience supporting AI Gateway or LLM\-serving infrastructure
* Knowledge of networking, service mesh, and traffic management patterns


 Core Values
   

  

 At Gravitee, We Believe Strongly In Living Our Core Values As a Team And As a Company. We Do Not Just Write Them \- We Live Them
   

  

* Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve.
* Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards.
* Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers.


 At Gravitee, You'll Get...
   

  

* Excellent medical coverage to keep your body and mind healthy
* Pension and 401k program options for all locations
* Stock option plan for employees
* 25 days holiday/vacation in addition to in\-country national holidays
* 3 mental health days per year with an allowance toward a mood\-boosting activity of your choice
* Birthday off to celebrate your day
* Professional development allowance to invest in your career growth
* Quarterly outings and annual offsites in exciting locations
* Hybrid culture with options to work from one of our hubs
* Access to cutting\-edge AI development tools and a culture that embraces innovation
* A meaningful, progressive, global company culture that is as fun as it is hardworking
* Endless growth opportunities

* Design, develop, and maintain MxML interfaces for trade booking, market data, static data, payments, and reporting.

* Diagnose, triage, and resolve transaction failures, timeouts, and API disruptions.
* Lead and participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) calls and ensure timely stakeholder communication.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets via Jira, ServiceNow.
* Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders and regulatory bodies (NPCI/RBI) during critical issues.

* Shell scripting

 Monitoring \& Observability Tools
   

  

* Hands\-on expertise with: \- ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
* Grafana, Prometheus

 DevOps \& Cloud
   

  

* Experience with: \- CI/CD pipelines, Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills

* Strong stakeholder communication and coordination
* Focus on reliability, scalability, and performance

* Proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with ownership to resolve production issues under pressure.

title: AI Technical Analyst
description:
**Technology \& AI Analyst – Business Intelligence \& Ratings Advisory** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a
 **Technology \& AI Analyst** 
 to help transform how our Business Intelligence and Ratings Advisory team uses data and technology to generate insights for the P\&C insurance and reinsurance industry.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of
 **insurance, financial analytics, data and emerging technology** 
 . The successful candidate will identify and lead opportunities to apply
 **GenAI, agentic AI, automation and modern data and analytics tools** 
 to improve how we source information, conduct analysis, generate insights and connect those insights to actionable client solutions.
 



 This is not a traditional IT or developer role. We are looking for someone who combines
 **technical capability with business curiosity** 
 , someone who can understand what we do, challenge how it is done today and use technology to fundamentally improve it.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




  




* **Reimagine existing analytical workflows** 
 using GenAI, AI agents, automation and modern analytics, rather than simply automating existing processes.
* Develop tools and workflows that integrate
 **public financial information, regulatory and statutory filings, rating agency data, third\-party databases and internal data** 
 .
* Apply technology to generate differentiated
 **macro, sector and company\-level insights** 
 , identifying emerging trends, risks and opportunities.
* Help connect data and insights to
 **actionable client opportunities and solutions** 
 across reinsurance, capital and ratings advisory.
* Explore new AI and technology capabilities, determine where they can create value and
 **lead implementation from concept through deployment** 
 .
* Build scalable data and analytical capabilities using technologies such as
 **Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure and Databricks** 
 .
* Develop scalable approaches for accessing, analyzing and synthesizing large volumes of
 **structured and unstructured data** 
 .
* Partner with insurance and ratings specialists to translate business questions into effective technology and analytical solutions.
* Help drive
 **adoption of new tools and ways of working** 
 across the team.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Bachelor’s degree** 
 in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics or another relevant field.
* Approximately
 **3\+ years of relevant experience** 
 in data and analytics, AI, technology, financial services or a related field.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency with
 **Python and SQL** 
 , including working with large datasets, data transformation and analytical workflows.
* Experience with
 **Microsoft Azure and Databricks** 
 or comparable cloud\-based data and analytics platforms.
* Experience developing and working with
 **APIs, data pipelines, databases and automated workflows** 
 .
* Practical experience with
 **GenAI and LLMs** 
 , including areas such as prompt engineering, RAG and search, agentic workflows and integrating AI into business processes.
* Ability to work with
 **large, complex and disparate datasets** 
 and translate them into useful analytics and insights.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with an ability to understand financial and business concepts.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with
 **both technical and non\-technical subject\-matter experts** 
 .
* Demonstrated
 **self\-starter mentality** 
 , with the ability to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches and take initiatives from idea through implementation.
* Intellectual curiosity and willingness to develop a strong understanding of the
 **P\&C insurance and reinsurance industry** 
 .



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  





 Experience in
 **insurance/reinsurance** 
 (or broader financial services) is highly desirable. Familiarity with one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:
 


* Insurance financial and statutory reporting, including
 **NAIC, Solvency II and Lloyd’s** 
 data.
* Financial and insurance databases such as
 **S\&P Capital IQ/SNL and AM Best** 
 .
* Rating agency methodologies, financial strength ratings or capital models.
* Financial statement, peer, sector or company\-level analysis.
* Experience applying
 **Azure, Databricks and GenAI capabilities** 
 to financial or insurance datasets.
* Advanced degree, CFA, actuarial qualifications or relevant AI/data certifications are helpful, but not required.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The successful candidate will become the team's
 **technology catalyst** 
 , developing a strong understanding of our business, identifying where emerging technology can materially improve our capabilities and taking ownership of turning those ideas into practical solutions.
 



 We are looking for someone who asks not only
 **“How can we automate this?”** 
 but also
 **“How could technology fundamentally change how we do this, and what new insights could it allow us to deliver?”**

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description: AI Architect – Infrastructure \& Cloud**
**Title** 
 : AI Architect
   

  

**Level** 
 : Senior Manager
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 16\-18 years
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Architect to sit at the intersection of Infrastructure and Artificial Intelligence — someone who can design, build, and operationalize AI/LLM/Agentic solutions that solve real infrastructure problems: capacity planning, incident response, observability, automation, cost optimization, and resiliency engineering. This is not a pure research role — it's an applied engineering \+ architecture role for someone who can code, ship, and integrate AI into production infra workflows.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and deliver AI/ML/LLM\-based solutions embedded into infrastructure operations (ITOps/AIOps, self\-healing systems, predictive capacity, automated RCA)
* Design and build agentic AI workflows (multi\-step, tool\-using agents) for infra automation — ticketing, monitoring, remediation, provisioning
* Evaluate, fine\-tune, and integrate LLMs (open\-source and commercial: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, local/open models) into enterprise infra tooling
* Build RAG pipelines, vector databases, and knowledge\-grounding systems over infra documentation, runbooks, and CMDB data
* Write production\-grade code (Python primarily; scripting in Bash/PowerShell) — this role codes, doesn't just design PPTs
* Integrate AI solutions with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), ITSM tools (ServiceNow), observability stacks (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana), and CI/CD pipelines
* Define and enforce AI governance guardrails — data privacy, model security, hallucination control, cost/token management
* Partner with infra leadership to identify high\-ROI AI use cases and build the roadmap
* Mentor infra engineers on AI\-adjacent skills; act as the internal AI Center of Excellence lead for the infra vertical
* Own POC → pilot → production lifecycle for AI initiatives, including MLOps/LLMOps practices


**Must\-Have Skills**
* 16–18 years in Infrastructure/Cloud engineering or architecture, with the last 5–6 years focused on applied AI/ML/LLM work
* Strong hands\-on coding ability — Python (must), API integration, SDK usage (OpenAI/Anthropic/LangChain/LlamaIndex)
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompting, fine\-tuning, embeddings, RAG, context windows, tokens/cost
