Job Description: QA Senior Engineer

Role Overview

As a QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our web and mobile applications. You will be responsible for designing and executing test cases, identifying and tracking defects, validating API functionality, and collaborating closely with developers, product owners, and business analysts in an Agile environment. While this is primarily a manual testing role, exposure to automation testing is considered an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Analyze business requirements and functional specifications to create effective test scenarios and test cases.

● Perform Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, and Sanity Testing.

● Execute end\-to\-end testing across web and mobile applications.

● Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using Jira.

● Validate REST APIs using Postman.

● Execute SQL queries for data validation and backend testing.

● Collaborate with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and QA team members

throughout the development lifecycle.

● Participate in Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.

● Maintain clear and comprehensive test documentation.

● Functional Testing

● Experience with API Testing using Postman.

● Good knowledge of SQL for database validation.

title: Lead Engineer II – Senior Engineer, Authentication and Authorization IRC302231
description:
**Description**
 We’re building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You’ll own the common auth stack — making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface.
   

  

**Requirements**
 You should have
   

  

 – 5\+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments.
   

  

 – Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well\-tested service code in either.
   

  

 – Deep knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML — not just using libraries but understanding what’s happening underneath.
   

  

 – Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
   

  

 – Familiarity with multi\-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
   

  

 – Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).
   

  

 Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero\-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 – Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2\.0 flows, API key management, and service\-to\-service identity.
   

  

 – Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine\-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar).
   

  

 – Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane — clean APIs, well\-documented contracts, and minimal coupling.
   

  

 – Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers.
   

  

 – Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
   

  

 – Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one\-off implementations.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Data & AI Transformation Lead - Senior Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


At Citi, we value engineering and foster an environment where our best engineers continue to code and grow their careers.


Oasys Financial is a sub\-ledger for Citi’s OTC business and covers global trading books across all asset classes. This system handles millions of trades daily and conduct all sub\-ledger activities and is a critical system for the bank. We are taking up overhauling \& re\-write of this platform.


We invite applications from experienced and well\-rounded senior technologist for a SVP role who can work in a globally distributed team. This role requires strong Technology and Business knowledge of OTC products, trade life cycle and Pnl. The candidate will join a team in the early stages of transformation. Candidate will find spending their time in both coding \& business analysis. There will be regular interfacing with senior stakeholders across the bank. Candidate will be expected to demonstrate an established track record of handling senior stakeholders \& lead such discussions independently.


Candidates are expected to demonstrate strong delivery background in financial industry, preferably in OTC products. We expect depth of knowledge in Java stack. Candidate should be willing to drive re\-architecture and lead by example. Candidate should be able to work in Kubernetes based deployments in both on\-prem and external cloud and deal with variety of build technologies. Candidate will have limited line management responsibilities, intentionally designed to provide focus on coding \& business analysis.


Growth opportunities are excellent and in future candidate will have options of choosing between engineering, business analysis or and management tracks. The team you’ll be working with is distributed across 3 countries.


**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

**Hands\-On Engineering \& Re\-Architecture**
  

* Be an active, hands\-on contributor to the codebase — designing, building, and reviewing new Java microservices that replace legacy components.
* Lead the re\-engineering of the existing Oasys codebase, breaking down monolithic structures and migrating business logic into a modern, event\-driven microservices architecture.
* Establish and enforce application methodologies and standards for program analysis, design, coding, testing, and implementation across the engineering organization.
* Analyze complex business processes, system workflows, and industry standards to define solutions to high\-level problems, particularly in the context of post\-trade processing and financial accounting.
**AI\-Assisted Development \& Change Leadership**
  

* Serve as the organization's champion and change agent for AI\-assisted software development, driving the adoption of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, OpenAI Codex, and Devin across the engineering team.
* Bring deep, practical expertise in prompt engineering and apply it to accelerate development workflows, improve code generation quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.
* Lead by example — demonstrating how AI tooling can be integrated into day\-to\-day development practices to meaningfully improve productivity and code quality.
  

  

**Transformation Execution**
  

* Lead the design and delivery of the new Oasys platform in parallel with the Sybase IQ exit, overseeing the build\-out of high\-throughput data pipelines, distributed data stores, and scalable data processing frameworks.
* Drive the integration of new systems and functions to meet strategic goals, deploy new capabilities, and continuously enhance processes.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of the Oasys system flows and a comprehensive understanding of multiple technology domains to achieve transformation milestones on time and at scale.

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
### **About Hupo**


We are an AI\-native start\-up building sales enablement products in the banking, financial services, and insurance industry; already trusted by **dozens of enterprise customers** (including Fortune 500 companies).

### **Role at a Glance**

**Title:** Staff Platform Engineer  

**Team:** Engineering  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  

**Location:** Singapore, Europe, the US

### **What we do**


We build AI products for the people who sell insurance and banking products across Asia. An advisor can practise a hard client conversation against an AI persona, get a nudge during a live call, or have an AI agent make the first call for them. Our clients are big, regulated, and spread across markets and languages \- which means the interesting problems are latency, reliability, testing things that are not deterministic, security that satisfies a bank, and making an AI sound natural in Thai or Cantonese, not just English.

### **Why this role exists**


Two years ago we had one product. Now we have nine surfaces across seven enterprise clients, and most of them were built by hand, one client at a time. That is how you win early deals, and it worked. It will not keep working. The same things \- tenant configuration, identity, access to models, evaluation \- now exist in several slightly different versions, and every new client costs more engineering than the last.


We want one platform underneath all of it: shared services, configuration per client instead of code per client, and eventually a builder that lets us assemble a new use case instead of engineering it from scratch. This role leads that. You would own the platform core, pull shared capabilities out of products that have to keep shipping while you do it, and set the technical bar for a team of about seventeen engineers across India and Southeast Asia. It is hands\-on. You would write code every week. It is not a management job and it is not an architecture job that ends at a diagram.

### **What you would actually do**

* Build the shared pieces our products use \- configuration, identity and permissions, tenant isolation, model and retrieval access, evaluation \- once, properly.
* Extract them from the existing products without stopping delivery, and get more than one team to adopt what you build. The adoption part is the hard part.
* Make the architecture and migration calls across repositories, from design through to running in production.
* Set standards for ownership, review, testing, security and release, and hold them when a deadline makes it tempting not to \- while helping the team find a way through.
* Give teams a safe way to vary behaviour per client, so nobody needs a fork or an if\-statement with a client's name in it.
* Work with our infrastructure engineers on deployment, CI/CD and observability.
* Make sure every important system has a second owner. Including the ones you build.

### **First three months**

* **Month one:** get to know the codebase and the platform work already under way; agree the migration sequence with the working leads; become second owner of one critical system.
* **Month two:** first shared capability extracted and running in production for one product, with tests, an owner and an adoption plan for the next.
* **Month three:** a second product adopting it or migrating; the next two quarters of platform work written down and agreed; a named second owner for what you have built.

### **What we need from you**

* 8 or more years building production backend systems, and real Staff\-scope experience: architecture across several teams, migrations you led from start to finish, adoption you drove in teams that did not report to you.
* Deep production TypeScript and Node.js. Comfortable in Python, and comfortable reviewing code outside your main language.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS for real: you have designed, tested and operated the controls that stop one client's data reaching another.
* You have taken a monolith apart, or pulled shared services out of one, while it stayed in production \- and you can tell us what you did first, why, and what went wrong.
* Infrastructure judgment: Kubernetes, GCP or AWS, CI/CD, observability. You do not need to run it, but you design for it and you review it.
* Good security and data\-handling instincts, ideally from somewhere regulated.
* You write clearly. This team spans three time zones and most decisions travel in writing.
* You can push back on an unsafe shortcut under pressure and still have the person's trust afterwards.

### **Nice if you have**

* **Time in banking, insurance or another regulated industry; security reviews, SOC 2, or Singapore's OSPAR.**
* **LLM application work \- model gateways, retrieval, prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses, testing non\-deterministic output.**
* **Internal developer platforms or self\-service configuration systems.**
* **Real use of AI coding tools and an honest view of when they help and when they produce plausible code nobody has read.**

**Job Description: Software Development Engineer 2 — Backend******
**What You Will Do**

* Build systems that handle real\-world failure: retries, timeouts, partial failures, duplicate requests and inconsistent external dependencies.
* Work across backend and AI systems, deciding when a problem needs deterministic business logic, retrieval, an LLM or an agent.
* Use AI coding tools as leverage. Claude and Codex write a lot of the first draft here you are accountable for what lands.


**What We Need From You**
* 3\+ years minimum of production Python work that real customers depended on. Django, FastAPI or both.
* Strong software design fundamentals. You apply SOLID and clean architecture in practice: transport, business rules and persistence stay separated, dependencies point inward, and domain code does not know which framework it is running under.
* Test\-driven development. You write the test first when that is the faster route, and your tests describe behaviour rather than implementation.
* Technical design ownership. You can take an ambiguous requirement, identify constraints and trade\-offs, design the system and drive it through implementation.
* Judgment on service boundaries. You can argue for a modular monolith over microservices, and explain what would have to change for the answer to flip.
* Data models you can defend. You read the query plan before the ORM trick, and you have indexed a table that was already large and busy.
* Migrations under load. You understand schema changes against live data, including locks, backfills, rollbacks and running old and new versions of code simultaneously.
* Idempotency and retries. A job that runs twice here can move stock or money. You design accordingly.
* LLM systems built like software, not demos. Experience building agent systems using LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent abstractions, retrieval over a vector store, and integrations with more than one model provider.
* Agent infrastructure. You understand context and memory management, summarisation/compaction for long\-running conversations, structured tool calling, argument validation, retries and graceful behaviour when a tool fails or a model returns nonsense.
* RAG you have taken past the demo. You have worked with chunking, embeddings, retrieval and context assembly, and have measured retrieval quality rather than assuming it works.
* Evaluation\-driven AI development. You can build datasets and evaluation harnesses for retrieval and agent behaviour, compare model or prompt changes, and detect regressions before they reach production.
* Production AI judgment. You understand that LLM output is probabilistic and know where to introduce validation, deterministic business rules, fallbacks or human approval.
* Shipping hygiene. Git, Docker and CI/CD you keep green, and review comments that are specific enough to act on.
* Root\-cause debugging. You can go from a trace or production symptom to the actual cause, and leave behind a regression test.
* Mentorship. You improve the engineers around you through design reviews, code reviews and technical guidance.
* A bachelor''s degree in computer science, or the shipped work that stands in for one.


**BONUS POINTS**
* Evaluation and observability for non\-deterministic systems.
* Natural\-language interfaces over structured data.
* Multi\-modal input handled as a first\-class data problem.
* Vector stores in production — pgvector, Pinecone or Weaviate.
* AWS or Azure at the level of failure modes, reliability and cost, not just deploys.
* Enough JavaScript and CSS to debug across the boundary with the frontend team.
* Security practices and SOC 2 controls.
* Multi\-tenant SaaS at enterprise scale.
* Domain exposure to construction, ERP, procurement or fintech.
* Performance work on large datasets.
* Experience building systems that combine structured business data with unstructured documents.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation.
* High ownership in a YC\-backed company, working on systems the whole product runs on.
* Range in one role — backend architecture, LLM systems, cloud infrastructure and system design.
* The opportunity to build production AI systems that operate on real construction workflows and business data.
* Mentorship from engineering leaders and a culture that values shipping over slideware.
* The opportunity to shape the architecture as RDash scales.

title: Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment
description:
**Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment** 




**About Urban Company** 




 Urban Company is Asia's largest tech\-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background\-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high\-quality, and reliable experience every single time.
 



  





**About the Fulfilment Team** 




 The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:
 



  





 \- Planning \& Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.
 



 \- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real\-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.
 



 \- Allocation \& Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no\-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.
 



 These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real\-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.
 



  





**Job Description: SDE\-2** 




 We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE\-2\) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high\-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real\-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 \- Design and build scalable, high\-performance, fault\-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.
 



 \- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI\-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.
 



 \- Own features end\-to\-end — from ideation and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration across a modern tech stack.
 



 \- Raise the bar on the team's engineering practices: code quality, system architecture, observability, and operational excellence.
 



 \- Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into robust technical solutions.
 



  





**What Are We Looking For?** 




 \- Experience: 2–3 years of experience building large\-scale backend applications or Products.
 



 \-Technical Strength: Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Networks, and Database fundamentals, with a good understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, caching, and scalable architectures.
 



 \- Backend Skills: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Java, Go, or Python). Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and messaging systems like Kafka is a plus; exposure to cloud platforms and production observability is desirable.
 



 \- AI Fluency: Hands\-on experience leveraging AI in day\-to\-day engineering — using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to ship faster, and/or building with LLMs, ML models, or intelligent automation in production systems. Curiosity to apply.
 



 \- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.
 



 \- Mindset: Bias for action, end\-to\-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.
 



 \- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 \- Work on marketplace\-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.
 



 \- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.
 



 \- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first\-principles thinking.

**What We Are Looking For** 




  





 This is a broad, high\-impact role with wide visibility across our operations ecosystem. We know no candidate will check every single box on this list! If you have strong hands\-on experience in OSS/Fault Management, Python/DevOps, and Telecom systems, but are keen to expand your skills into our Salesforce and Atlassian environments, we want to hear from you.
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience in Telecom, NaaS, or ISP environments working with OSS/BSS and Fault Management systems.
* Proven hands\-on experience with open\-source observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenNMS, Alerta, or similar).

* Familiarity with
 **Salesforce Service Cloud** 
 or declarative/programmatic automations.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to team:**

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.


Our team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II for our Tax and Regulatory Platforms. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to build and support the Global Tax Platform and Unified Regulatory Platform for the travel industry.


These highly resilient systems must scale to process Expedia Group's entire business transactions in real time, while adapting to ever\-changing regulations across global markets. They power complete transaction lifecycles from shopping through booking, invoicing, accounting, filing, reporting, and beyond with financial\-grade accuracy and robust audit trails.


This is an opportunity to take a pivotal role in building the travel industry's premier commerce and financial platforms. You will design and implement APIs, data streams, real\-time compute, and data lake storage at scale pushing the boundaries of cloud technologies including Kafka, Kubernetes, gRPC, Apache Spark, and Flink.


**In this role, you will:**

**Core Engineering**

* Work in small, agile teams to design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and resilient services across the Tax and Regulatory Platform
* Build and operate cloud\-native streaming data, real\-time processing, and data lake platforms at scale using Kafka, Kubernetes, Apache Spark, and Flink
* Ensure all software meets the highest standards of performance, security, scalability, and financial\-grade accuracy
* Review pull requests and lead by example on code quality refactoring for readability, extensibility, and testability
* Leverage CI/CD techniques and tools to maximise delivery speed, reliability, and operational confidence
* Embrace change always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today
* Support ever\-changing global regulatory requirements by building adaptable, configurable platform components that reduce time\-to\-compliance in new markets
* Drive observability and reliability across services using DataDog, Splunk, or equivalent tooling ensuring proactive detection and resolution of issues
* Share knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning including AI fluency across the engineering team

**AI \& Intelligent Systems**

* Design and integrate AI\-powered capabilities into regulatory and financial workflows including intelligent document processing, automated compliance checks, and anomaly detection
* Build and maintain RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines connecting internal knowledge sources, regulatory datasets, and transaction data to LLM\-powered services for accurate, context\-aware outputs
* Integrate and manage model inference endpoints into production services, ensuring low latency, high availability, and cost\-efficient serving at scale
* Experiment with and adopt AI developer tooling leveraging tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate engineering velocity across the team
* Apply responsible AI practices in compliance\-sensitive contexts including prompt engineering, hallucination mitigation, output validation, and audit trail requirements
* Collaborate with data science and ML teams to translate model outputs into reliable, production\-grade engineering solutions aligned to regulatory standards.

**Experience \& Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* 3\+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering
* **Java preferred** Experienced software developer with strong system design, problem\-solving, and object\-oriented coding skills
* **AWS, Kubernetes/Containerisation, and Apache Spark/Streaming preferred** Experience developing in cloud environments
* Experience delivering and supporting highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant distributed systems
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams
* Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or Splunk
* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable delivery

**AI Fluency \& Emerging Technologies**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts and how large language models (LLMs) are applied in production engineering contexts
* Hands\-on or working knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns including vector stores, embedding models, and knowledge retrieval pipelines
* Familiarity with model inference, including serving frameworks (e.g. TorchServe, TGI, vLLM) and integrating inference endpoints into production services
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-powered developer tooling — GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar and applying them to accelerate engineering workflows
* Awareness of responsible AI practices prompt engineering, hallucination mitigation, and guardrails in regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments
* Curiosity to explore how AI capabilities can be embedded into regulatory and financial platforms from intelligent document processing to anomaly detection and automated compliance checks
* Passionate about continuous learning including AI fluency and sharing knowledge with the broader team

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

 Master's Degree

 The Snowflake Architect will provide end\-to\-end technical leadership for Snowflake implementations, modernization and migration programs. The role requires strong understanding of legacy data platforms, migration strategies, data modelling, ETL/ELT, performance optimization and cloud architecture. * Strong hands\-on expertise in SQL Server (T\-SQL) and relational database design, with solid experience in data migration and conversion projects.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - NIRA
description:
Join the Tilt team
   

  

 At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile\-first products and machine learning\-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real\-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide
 **,** 
 we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.
   

  

**The Opportunity: Staff Backend Engineer \- NIRA**
*Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)*
 As a Staff Backend Engineer on NIRA, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of a critical domain within our credit platform. You'll lead a complex product area end\-to\-end, from strategy through execution, while working closely with our Principal Engineer, GM, and cross\-functional partners across NIRA, Cashalo, and our US teams.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Own a domain: Lead strategy, design, and delivery for a core part of NIRA's platform.
* Set technical direction: Spot strategic needs and surface risks before they become problems.
* Drive complex initiatives: Take large, high\-stakes projects from design to ship.
* Champion AI\-native engineering: Push adoption of tools like Claude, Cursor, and Augment across the team.
* Mentor engineers: Level up engineers up to Senior, and raise the technical bar in Bangalore.
* Lead incidents: Own SEV1 and lower incident response through to resolution.
* Bridge global teams: Align with Principal Engineering and peers across NIRA, Cashalo, and US teams.
* Influence the roadmap: Shape product direction through technical tradeoffs, not just execution.
* Simplify systems: Cut complexity out of designs before it compounds.


**Why you're a great fit**
* 7\+ years building web APIs, ideally in Java and Spring Boot
* Deep experience with financial systems: state machines, complex lifecycles
* Strong grasp of distributed systems and queue\-based architectures
* Proven track record scaling consumer products at high transaction volume
* End\-to\-end ownership: design, execution, and reporting on your own initiatives
* Comfortable deciding fast with incomplete information
* A mentor who actively raises the bar for engineers around you
* Genuine enthusiasm for AI dev tools, not just tolerance of them
* Bias for simplicity over clever abstractions


**Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.**
**What You'll Get At Tilt**
* Virtual\-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
* Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
* Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
* Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
* Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
* Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


**The Tilt Way**
 We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non\-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the \[virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.
   

  

**You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.**

description:

* A people\-focused company with a healthy work\-life balance and a hybrid way of working.

+ Lambda
+ EC2
+ ECS
+ SNS / SQS
+ IAM
+ DynamoDB
+ CloudFormation
+ CloudWatch
+ API Gateway and REST APIs

* Experience with CI/CD in production environments.
* Strong understanding of DevOps and complete lifecycle responsibility.
* Experience with certificate lifecycle management.
* Practical experience with Agile methodologies, preferably Scrum and/or SAFe.
* Strong understanding of software quality, security, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.


**Architecture \& Technical Leadership**
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical direction for complex systems or critical components.
* Ability to make sound technical decisions and explain technical trade\-offs.
* Experience identifying and managing technical debt, systemic risks, and dependencies.
* Ability to balance technical quality with customer value, cost, delivery, and business impact.
* Experience establishing or promoting engineering standards and best practices.
* Ability to provide technical guidance without unnecessarily prescribing implementation details.


**Collaboration \& Leadership**
* Experience mentoring and developing engineers.
* Strong communication and technical influencing skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, architecture, and business functions.
* Experience working in cross\-functional and distributed teams.
* Comfortable leading technical initiatives and facilitating technical discussions.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to focus on both individual delivery and team\-level outcomes.


**Personal Qualities**
* Curious and continuously interested in technology and improvement.
* Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.
* Pragmatic and focused on delivering sustainable solutions.
* Comfortable making decisions in complex and changing environments.
* Enjoys mentoring, knowledge sharing, and helping others grow.
* Strong team player who values trust, openness, and collaboration.

**Nice to Have**

* Spring / Spring Boot
* Maven
* Linux / Unix
* Experience with security concepts and best practices.
* Cloud or Kubernetes certifications.
* Experience with large\-scale distributed systems.
* Experience driving technical improvement initiatives across multiple teams.
* Experience working in international or globally distributed organizations.


**To Join Our Journey**
 WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted territory. We are curious, believe in collaboration, and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you become part of a highly competent and warm\-hearted team of people from all over the world.
   

  

**Way of Working**
 The work location for this role is our office in
 **central Bangalore, India** 
 . At WirelessCar, we believe in a hybrid work setup, with opportunities to work both from home and from the office.
   

  

**Recruitment Process**
 Apply now and join our journey!
   

  

**Note Before You Apply**
* Our company language is English, so please submit your application in English.
* A cover letter is not required. Instead, you'll answer a few questions to help us better understand your experience, interests, and ambitions.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer – Cloud & DevOps
description:
**WirelessCar’s Journey**


WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting\-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

  

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer – Cloud \& Backend** to join our cross\-functional DevOps team.


In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and operate **cloud\-native, microservice\-based solutions** end\-to\-end. You will provide technical leadership for complex systems and critical components, contribute to architecture and technical direction, and take ownership of the quality, reliability, and sustainability of the services you help build.


You will work with modern technologies including **Java, AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, and CI/CD**, while collaborating closely with developers, architects, Product Owners, and other stakeholders.


Beyond individual delivery, you will help shape engineering practices, reduce technical debt and systemic risk, mentor engineers, and contribute to the long\-term technical evolution of our systems and platform.

#### **Here’s what you’ll focus on**

* Design, build, deploy, and operate **cloud\-native, microservice\-based solutions** end\-to\-end.
* Lead architecture and technical direction for **complex systems and critical components**.
* Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, secure, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Own delivery outcomes including **quality, reliability, performance, and sustainability**.
* Drive continuous improvement of systems, services, and engineering practices.
* Define, promote, and uphold **engineering standards, security practices, operational excellence, and quality**.
* Identify, prioritize, and reduce **technical debt and systemic risks** across services and teams.
* Make technical decisions with awareness of **customer value, cost, business impact, and operational considerations**.
* Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.
* Mentor and support engineers through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, and daily collaboration.
* Lead technical initiatives and improvements when needed.
* Collaborate in cross\-functional Agile teams to clarify **system context, dependencies, risks, and the bigger picture**.
* Take responsibility across the complete **DevOps lifecycle**, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root\-cause analysis and long\-term improvements.
* Contribute to engineering culture and support the wider organization with **deep technical expertise**.

#### **We Offer You**

* A people\-focused company with a healthy work\-life balance and a hybrid way of working.
* A flat organizational culture built on trust, openness, and autonomy.
* The opportunity to work with modern technologies and connected mobility solutions.
* A global workplace with international collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.
* Hands\-on work with **Java, AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, and CI/CD**.
* A strong DevOps culture with complete lifecycle ownership.
* The opportunity to influence technical direction and engineering practices.
* Opportunities to mentor engineers and contribute to the wider engineering community.
* A personal tech fund where you can choose the tools and equipment that support your work and development.

#### **We Believe That You Bring**


You are an experienced software engineer who combines **strong technical expertise with ownership and leadership**. You enjoy solving complex problems, making pragmatic technical decisions, and helping teams build reliable and maintainable solutions.


You are comfortable taking the lead when needed while working collaboratively with engineers, architects, product stakeholders, and customers.

#### **Technical Skills**

* **8–12 years of professional experience** in software engineering, backend development, cloud engineering, or a related field.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Java 11 or higher**.
* Strong experience with **AWS**, including several of the following:


	+ Lambda
	+ EC2
	+ ECS
	+ SNS / SQS
	+ IAM
	+ DynamoDB
	+ CloudFormation
	+ CloudWatch
	+ API Gateway and REST APIs
* Strong experience with **Kubernetes**, including building, deploying, and administering solutions.
* Strong understanding and practical experience with **microservices architecture**.
* Strong experience with **JUnit and Test\-Driven Development (TDD)**.
* Strong experience with **Git**.
* Experience with **CI/CD in production environments**.
* Strong understanding of **DevOps and complete lifecycle responsibility**.
* Experience with **certificate lifecycle management**.
* Practical experience with **Agile methodologies**, preferably Scrum and/or SAFe.
* Strong understanding of software quality, security, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

#### **Architecture \& Technical Leadership**

* Proven experience leading **architecture and technical direction** for complex systems or critical components.
* Ability to make sound technical decisions and explain technical trade\-offs.
* Experience identifying and managing **technical debt, systemic risks, and dependencies**.
* Ability to balance technical quality with **customer value, cost, delivery, and business impact**.
* Experience establishing or promoting engineering standards and best practices.
* Ability to provide technical guidance without unnecessarily prescribing implementation details.

### **Collaboration \& Leadership**

* Experience mentoring and developing engineers.
* Strong communication and technical influencing skills.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon OpenSearch Service - Plugins and Security
description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.



Imagine being a part of a small, agile team where your ideas have the potential to reach millions within a short span of time. Picture working on technologies, where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision\-making process. Envision being able to leverage the resources of a Fortune\-500 company within the atmosphere of a start\-up. AWS OpenSearch team is looking for Software Development Engineers for its Bangalore team who can help build search technologies for customers of all sizes. If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you.



You are highly\-motivated and thrive in an environment where problems are open\-ended. You enjoy engaging in passionate discussions with smart people and letting the best ideas rise to the top. You see your mistakes as learning opportunities and continually look for ways to improve yourself, your team and your products. You understand that not all solutions come easily and don’t shy away from hard work to reach your goals. We are looking for smart, motivated Software Development Engineers who can help take the service to new heights. If you have the skills to building large\-scale and high\-performance services, this is the job for you.



As an Amazon OpenSearch Service engineer, you will:


* Design, develop, and support a world\-class OpenSearch Service that manages thousands of search domains.
* Focus on scalability, performance, service robustness, and cost trade\-offs. (Especially as they pertain to a highly\-virtualized, elastic, cloud\-based environment)
* Apply scientific analysis and mathematical modeling techniques to predict, measure, and evaluate the consequences of designs and the ongoing success of our platform
* Continuously drive to explore, improve, enhance, automate, and optimize distributed systems and tools to best meet evolving business and market needs
* Work alongside a dedicated operations team to develop and support the smooth 24x7 operation of our worldwide service
* Participate in setting a vision and objectives for Amazon OpenSearch Service in alignment with business and market needs
* Invent the future of search instead of just being a bystander
* Mentor other SDEs and advise the leadership team on the technical vision.


About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, Lucene/SOLR or Storm/Samza experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Support returned box analysis from production

* Lead the resolution of network performance issues through strategic coordination across internal teams and provide expert technical support for airline performance and customer escalations to SES’s customer\-facing teams.

Provide strategic guidance to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding and alignment with organizational objectives.

* Rotation of shift every quarter to half year

* System thinking skills for isolating issues within a complex network
* BS degree in Engineering/Computer Science disciplines
* 10\+ years of system level troubleshooting experience working on complex systems
* 5 years of relevant experience in the satellite and/or telecommunications industry
* TCP/IP, Linux/Shell Scripting, Packet Capture/WireShark, Jira, Wiki, Test Director
* JQL, SQL, Python, Java, Go, Git, Jenkins (CI), Spinnaker (CD), AWS OpenSearch
* Tableau, Power BI, Network Analysis
* Excellent Verbal/written communication skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong understanding of capacity and time management
* Flexibility to work occasional weekends or off hours, as emergencies arise
* Proactively seek continuous learning and continuous improvements
* Mentor new members and create personal development goals

* Strong networking background with CCNA/CCNE certifications
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe PI), DevOps and SRE
* Exceptional techno\-commercial business acumen in satellite communication network rollout, influencing strategic decisions and project success.

Financial Services firms are becoming ever more defined by their technology and ability to use it to deliver outstanding customer experiences. Standard Chartered Information Technology \& Operations (ITO) is looking for individuals interested in using innovative new products and modern technologies to deliver world class digital experiences for our clients and customers.


People \& Talent

Risk Management

Governance

Regulatory \& Business Conduct

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

Key stakeholders
  
* Serve as a key contact for business stakeholders regarding digital channel capabilities and constraints.
* Liaise with external vendors and service providers for solution delivery, support, and issue resolution (where applicable).

Skills and Experience
  
  

* Java

* Linux

Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* Experience (6–8\+ years) in product management, business analysis, or project roles within banking or financial services, preferably in digital channels or transaction banking.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**About Us** 




 We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting\-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission\-critical applications.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are hiring a Python Backend Engineer to take ownership of high\-throughput backend services. You will work alongside our front\-end and C\# application teams to build the infrastructure that ingests, processes, and routes real\-time data streams across our platforms.
 



 This role is for someone who enjoys asynchronous Python, complex data\-flow problems, and the discipline of building production systems that need to run reliably under sustained load.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Data Ingestion \& Processing: Design backend services that handle continuous, high\-frequency data streams and telemetry from multiple sources, including raw and binary protocols over TCP/UDP.
* API \& Service Development: Build robust, scalable REST and WebSocket services using FastAPI, with proper schema validation, error handling, and observability built in from the start.
* Event\-Driven Architecture: Implement and operate pub/sub messaging systems to enable reliable data distribution across microservices.
* Database Design \& Optimization: Model and query relational and time\-series stores efficiently — raw events, derived state, and aggregated roll\-ups — with attention to write throughput and query latency.
* System Integration: Collaborate with hardware/embedded, front\-end, and C\# teams to define clean contracts and ensure reliable data flow across system boundaries.
* Engineering Discipline: Write tested, reviewed, and documented code; participate in design discussions; contribute to deployment, monitoring, and operational practices.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Experience: 3\-4 years of professional backend software engineering experience, primarily in Python.
* Asynchronous Python: Strong working knowledge of asyncio and concurrent programming patterns for high\-throughput I/O.
* API Frameworks: Production experience with FastAPI (or comparable async frameworks such as Starlette, aiohttp, or Sanic) and pydantic\-based schema validation.
* Message Brokers: Hands\-on experience with at least one event streaming or message broker platform — Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or equivalent.
* Databases: Proficient with PostgreSQL and capable of writing optimized SQL; comfortable with schema design, indexing, and query profiling.
* Time\-Series Data: Working familiarity with time\-series databases (e.g., TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, QuestDB) and the trade\-offs of heavy\-write workloads.
* Networking: Solid grasp of TCP/UDP, WebSockets, and HTTP/REST; able to debug at the protocol level when needed.
* Platform \& Tooling: Comfortable on Linux, Git\-based workflows.
* Testing \& Quality: Demonstrated practice with pytest, unit and integration testing, and CI pipelines.



  





**Good to have** 



* Binary Protocols \& Telemetry: Experience parsing custom binary frames, working with raw telemetry, or interfacing with hardware or IoT data sources.
* Geospatial Data: Familiarity with PostGIS, GeoJSON/KML, or coordinate\-system handling.
* Systems Interoperability: Experience interfacing Python with C/C\+\+ libraries via ctypes, cffi, pybind11, or shared library bindings.
* On\-Premises Deployment: Comfortable building and operating systems in air\-gapped or LAN\-only environments, not exclusively cloud\-managed.
* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, ECE, or a related discipline.



  





**Why join US?** 



* **Culture of Excellence:** 
 We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* **Opportunities for Growth:** 
 We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:** 
 Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* **Innovative Environment:** 
 Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

description:
**About This Job**
**Hartree Partners**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, Telangana, India

 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Oil and Gas
   

  

**Job Description**
 Company Overview:
   

  

 Hartree Partners (Hartree) is a global energy and commodities firm with an international reputation for integrity. Hartree uses decades of experience in the physical and financial energy and commodities markets to assist customers in accessing these markets and navigating their complexities, for maximum revenues at minimum risk. The company provides a wide range of services to a substantial and diversified customer base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.
   

  

 Integrity is the foundation of Hartree’s collaborative culture. Founded in 1997, Hartree is privately held by its management, Oaktree Capital, and other institutional investors. Our diverse and experienced team— comprising close to 5400 employees across more than 50 global offices and 20 business lines, works to deliver deep insight and expertise to enterprise\-level, multinational, and nation\-state clients.
   

  

 In 2025, Hartree Partners acquired ED\&F Man Commodities. Established in 1783, ED\&F Man commodities is an agricultural merchant with 2,800 people in 43 countries. ED\&F Man Commodities trades sugar, coffee, molasses, animal feed and pulses.
   

  

 Hartree Global Services (India) Private Limited (HGSI) reflects Hartree's commitment to create a centre of excellence in India, establishing its Global Capability Centre in Hyderabad to facilitate the company’s strategic growth with particular emphasis on operational excellence and global execution. HGSI endeavours to become the nucleus for Hartree’s global enterprise functions including technology and engineering, accounting and financial reporting, treasury, operations, risk management, compliance, among other areas.
   

  

 Position: Oracle Technical Lead
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Position Type: Full\-time, onsite. No hybrid work option.
   

  

 Direct Reporting: HGSI Local Leadership team, Hyderabad
   

  

 Functional Reporting: Global Head of HR Technology
   

  

**Shift Time (with Flexibility To Support Other Regions)**
 UK Shift : 2 pm to 11 pm IST \[4\.30 am to 13\.30 pm EST/ 9\.30 am to 6\.30 pm UK time]
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The Oracle Technical Lead is responsible for the technical design, integration, security and continuous improvement of the Oracle Fusion HCM platform. The role provides technical leadership to ensure Oracle HCM is secure, scalable and aligned with global business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.
   

  

 Working closely with the HR, IT, Payroll, vendors and implementation partners, the Oracle Technical Lead supports the Global HR Technology strategy, implements the Global HR Data Governance Framework and delivers secure, reliable and innovative HR technology solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Technical Leadership
   

  

 Provide technical leadership across the Oracle Fusion HCM platform.Define and maintain technical standards, solution architecture and development best practices.Support the Global Head of HR Technology in delivering the Global HR Technology strategy and technology roadmap.Mentor team members and drive continuous improvement through innovation and technical excellence.
   

  

 HR Data Governance \& Technology Governance
   

  

 Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Global HR Data Governance Framework.Ensure Oracle HCM technical solutions comply with global data standards, governance policies, security requirements and enterprise architecture principles.Design and maintain technical controls that support data quality, system integrity and regulatory compliance.Support governance forums, vendor reviews and audit activities by providing technical expertise and recommendations.
   

  

 Integrations \& Technical Development
   

  

 Design, develop and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, SOAP services, HDL and HCM Extracts.Develop and maintain technical solutions, including Fast Formula, BI Publisher reports and integration components.Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise integrations to ensure reliable system performance.Identify opportunities to automate business processes and improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 Security \& Environment Management
   

  

 Administer Oracle HCM security, including roles, security profiles, user provisioning and access controls.Manage environment refreshes, configuration migrations and deployment activities.Maintain system availability, performance and security across all Oracle HCM environments.Ensure compliance with organisational security standards and technical governance controls.
   

  

 Data Migration \& Technical Support
   

  

 Lead data migration activities, including extraction, transformation, validation and HDL loading.Provide technical support for complex system, integration and production issues.Perform root cause analysis and coordinate with Oracle Support and implementation partners to resolve technical incidents.Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles and support procedures.
   

  

 Projects \& Release Management
   

  

 Lead the technical workstream for Oracle implementations, enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.Support solution design, technical testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment and post\-go\-live activities.Manage Oracle Quarterly Releases, including technical impact assessments and regression testing.Ensure technical deliverables are completed in accordance with governance standards and project timelines.
   

  

 Documentation, Vendor \& Compliance
   

  

 Maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, configuration records and support procedures.Collaborate with Oracle, managed service providers and implementation partners to deliver high\-quality technical services.Ensure compliance with governance, audit, security and data privacy requirements.Support internal and external audits by providing technical evidence and documentation.
   

  

 Requirements: education, competencies \& skills
   

  

 Must have about 12\-15 years of experience in similar role Strong Oracle HCM technical toolkit (HDL, Fast Formula, Extracts, APIs) Technical Leadership – to be addedExperience with middleware tools (e.g. OIC) Understanding of HR data models Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills Experience working in global environments

**About Us**
 At Southwest Airlines, we believe that flying should feel like freedom. For over 50 years, we’ve been connecting people to what matters most with low fares, legendary hospitality, and a heart for service. Our culture is built on the principles of fun, friendliness, and family, making us one of the most admired workplaces in the world.

**Job Summary**
* As a Manager Technology – Redshift, you'll lead the AWS Redshift Platform team, driving technical strategy, platform reliability, scalability, cost optimization, and stakeholder management for the enterprise and departmental Redshift environments.
* In this role, you'll provide People\-focused leadership to a high\-performing Engineering Team while driving the delivery of scalable, secure, and reliable cloud\-based data solutions built on modern AWS technologies and DevOps practices.

The organization is data\-driven, and Technology manages how data is collected, stored, and exposed across the enterprise using modern cloud architectures, tooling with a DevOps mindset.

**Model the Southwest Way**
* Guide and lead team members using SWA talent management practices to coach, develop, and engage employees
* Adhere to Company values and competencies to foster a culture of inclusion, recognition, and support of a safe work environment

**Responsibilities**

* Participate fully in organizational processes and initiatives, i.e. performance management, interviewing, budgeting, training, etc.
* Lead the resolution of organization, team and individual issues, making appropriate decision
* Develop and execute strategies and processes to improve performance and the value of products and services provided
* Lead cross\-functional Teams to deliver solutions and services to meet enterprise needs

* Deliver technology solutions using best practices to achieve maximum Team productivity while delivering high quality products
* Stay abreast of emerging trends, processes, and solutions related to assigned responsibilities
* Build strong, collaborative relationships and credibility while influencing and driving change across respective Business and Technology Teams

* Provides technical leadership in Redshift architecture, SQL performance tuning, AWS cloud services, infrastructure automation, and platform reliability, security, and governance.
* Stakeholder management – translates business needs into platform capabilities, manages expectations across data consumers (analytics, ML, finance, compliance), and communicates platform value, priorities and risks to executive audiences.
* Drives strategy and prioritization – roadmap planning aligned to business priorities, balancing platform stability against new feature delivery, and managing technical debt deliberately.
* Champions Lakehouse architecture and the broader AWS data ecosystem (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, S3, Step Functions).
* Drives FinOps discipline and cost efficiency across AWS Redshift, and owns capacity/cost management for the Redshift platform.
* Establishes and maintains observability, reliability, and an SRE\-driven operating model for the Redshift platform.
* Accountable for delivering a reliable, scalable, and business\-ready Redshift platform through collaboration with architecture, governance, security, and engineering teams.
* Drive AI\-enabled transformation across the Redshift platform by identifying and implementing automation opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, accelerate delivery timelines, and generate measurable cost savings.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Knowledge of software development practices, concepts, methodologies, tools and trends

* Skilled in excellent partnering, negotiation and communication in order to facilitate interactions with business Customers and technology teams
* Ability to provide tactical leadership for Team(s)
* Ability to use appropriate motivation and influence techniques to achieve desired Team results
* Ability to set and manage stakeholder expectations
* Ability to deliver quality projects on time and within budget
* Ability to manage projects using the organization's project management methodology


**Education**

**Experience**
* Demonstrated experience in directly or indirectly leading team(s)
* Fully functioning, broad knowledge in:
+ Business and/or Information Technology environment
+ Leading teams and providing work direction
+ 8\-12 years relevant work\-related / leadership experience
+ AWS Redshift – Platform ownership, architecture, and roadmap accountability. Deep expertise in Amazon Redshift including Serverless, Spectrum, Data Sharing, Workload Management (WLM), Concurrency Scaling, and performance optimization.
+ AWS Cloud – Core AWS services as S3, IAM Identity Center, Athena, Lake Formation, and Lakehouse architecture patterns.
+ Lakehouse Architecture – 3–5 years – AWS core services and Lakehouse architecture patterns
+ Observability / SRE – Reliability and SRE\-oriented thought process for the Redshift platform

**Why Join Citi?**

We secure and facilitate the global financial system. The platforms you unify will protect trillions of dollars in daily transactions from financial crime and regulatory risk.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high\-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
   

  

 WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
   

  

 Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
   

  

 Technologists on this team research, design, code, test, and deploy solutions that enable the firm’s front\-office quant teams to make effective use of the our framework. Our environment is relaxed yet intellectually driven, and we seek people who think in code, enjoy solving complex engineering problems, and are motivated by working closely with like\-minded researchers, engineers, and business stakeholders. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, solution delivery, and quant research enablement. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with researchers, embedded technology teams, and platform stakeholders to build scalable tools, APIs, services, and workflows that improve adoption and support the continued evolution of the firm’s ecosystem. We are looking for a hands\-on technologist who enjoys building robust systems, working closely with users, and solving intellectually challenging problems. The ideal candidate is practical, curious, collaborative, and motivated by delivering tools and platforms that help researchers and investment professionals work more effectively.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Participate in the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of solutions
* Build and maintain APIs, services, tools, and platform components that enable seamless integration with front\-office quant workflows.
* Interface with users of the platform to understand their use cases and help them make effective use of available tools and services.
* Work closely with researchers and technology teams to translate business and research needs into practical engineering solutions.
* Contribute to scalable platform capabilities, including workflow tooling, metadata management, distributed storage, and integration services.
* Research best practices and propose feature specifications and enhancements for the platform roadmap.
* Develop and maintain tools that complement the core platform offering and improve usability, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with firmwide engineering standards.
* Produce clear documentation, user guides, and technical materials to support adoption and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with global teams in an open, intellectually curious, and delivery\-focused environment.


**What You’ll Bring**
* University degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong English communication skills and experience working in a global environment.
* Expertise in software lifecycle management methodologies and tools, including Git and JIRA.
* Strong programming expertise in at least one of the following: Python, Go, C, or C\+\+.
* Strong working knowledge of UNIX/Linux.
* Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production\-quality software systems.
* Ability to work directly with technical and non\-technical users to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Knowledge of the design and development of large\-scale distributed systems, distributed storage platforms, workflow platforms, or data\-intensive systems.
* Experience building APIs, backend services, platform tooling, or developer enablement solutions.
* Familiarity with quant research workflows, investment technology platforms, data pipelines, or front\-office systems.
* Exposure to CI/CD, observability, containerization, orchestration, or cloud\-native development practices.
* Interest in open architecture, graph\-based frameworks, metadata\-driven systems, and extensible platform design.

The policy also describes legal and contractual limitations on these rights. The specific rights and obligations of individuals living and working in different areas may vary by jurisdiction.
