title: Principal Architect / Technical Lead — Supply Chain & Logistics Platforms
description:
* Location:Noida / Gurgaon
* Employment Type: Full\-Time
* Department: Core Engineering \& Architecture
* Experience Range: 7\-10 Years


**About The Company \& Engineering Culture**
 At the intersection of global commerce, heavy manufacturing, and fast\-paced retail lies the backbone of the modern economy:
 **The Supply Chain** 
 . We are a high\-growth Supply Chain Technology SaaS enterprise building next\-generation cloud platforms that digitize, orchestrate, and optimize end\-to\-end logistics, warehouse operations, and inventory networks for global enterprises.
   

  

 Our engineering culture values radical ownership, high\-throughput systems design, rigorous code craftsmanship, and deep data\-driven problem solving. We handle massive data ingestion pipelines, real\-time tracking streams for millions of active shipments, and complex combinatorial optimization algorithms that run under strict latency SLAs. If you are passionate about building distributed, resilient systems that move real\-world goods at scale, this is your arena.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a visionary, hands\-on
 **Principal Architect / Technical Lead** 
 to steer the technical roadmap, architectural integrity, and scalability of our core Supply Chain Execution and Network Orchestration platforms. In this leadership role, you will bridge high\-level business strategy with deep, low\-level technical execution.
   

  

 You will lead a high\-performing cluster of software engineering squads, mentor senior engineers, define architectural standards across microservices, and design fault\-tolerant systems capable of weathering peak enterprise traffic spikes without performance degradation. You will collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and operations research engineers to bring complex optimization models and real\-time tracking engines into production.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Architectural Ownership1\. System Architecture \& High\-Scale Distributed Design
   

  

* Vision \& Blueprinting: Lead the architectural design and evolution of our core multi\-tenant SaaS platform, ensuring high availability, zero\-downtime deployments, horizontal scalability, and low latency across global regions.
* Microservices \& Event\-Driven Orchestration: Architect robust, decoupled microservices for Order Management Systems (OMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Transport Management Systems (TMS) leveraging event\-driven messaging patterns.
* Resiliency \& Fault Tolerance: Design robust disaster recovery protocols, circuit breakers, rate limiters, and self\-healing mechanisms to ensure continuous operational uptime for mission\-critical enterprise supply chains.
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship
* Engineering Standards: Establish, evangelize, and enforce architectural governance, coding standards, API design principles (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and security best practices across all engineering squads.
* Talent Development: Mentor senior and staff engineers, conduct design reviews, foster a culture of technical innovation, and play a pivotal role in technical hiring and career growth planning.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison between product management, QA, DevOps, and executive stakeholders, translating complex business requirements into clear, phased engineering milestones.
* Performance Optimization \& Data Architecture
* High\-Throughput Data Pipelines: Architect scalable data ingestion layers capable of processing petabytes of telemetry data, IoT sensor feeds, and GPS tracking logs from thousands of active fleet vehicles.
* Database \& Caching Strategies: Drive decisions on polyglot persistence, selecting optimal relational, NoSQL, time\-series, or vector databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, TimescaleDB, Qdrant) based on specific workload access patterns.
* Cost \& Cloud Governance: Implement strict FinOps guidelines to optimize cloud infrastructure expenditure (AWS/GCP) without compromising performance, throughput, or data security.


**Comprehensive Tech Stack \& Technical RequirementsCore Technical Stack**
* Languages: Expert proficiency in Java (Spring Boot / Quarkus) and/or Go (Golang), with working knowledge of Python for data\-heavy or algorithm\-adjacent services.
* Distributed Messaging \& Streaming: Deep expertise in Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Apache Pulsar for high\-throughput event streaming.
* Databases \& Storage: Advanced mastery of PostgreSQL, distributed SQL databases (CockroachDB/Yugabyte), NoSQL stores (MongoDB/Cassandra), and caching mechanisms (Redis/Memcached).
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Hands\-on architecture experience with AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM) or GCP; infrastructure as code via Terraform; container orchestration via Docker and Kubernetes.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, and ELK stack for distributed tracing and application performance monitoring (APM).


**Experience \& Educational Qualifications**
* Experience: 7 to 10 years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with at least 4\+ years acting in a Principal Architect, Lead Architect, or Staff Engineer capacity within product\-based tech companies, high\-scale SaaS enterprises, or logistics/supply\-chain platforms.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline from a premier institution (IITs, NITs, IISc, or top\-tier global universities).
* Domain Exposure: Demonstrated past success in building enterprise B2B SaaS applications, multi\-tenant architectures, or complex domain\-driven design (DDD) systems within supply chain, fintech, or e\-commerce fulfillment domains.


 Competencies \& Behavioral Traits
   

  

* First\-Principles Thinking: Ability to strip away complexity, analyze fundamental constraints of distributed computing, and design elegant, custom solutions when standard off\-the\-shelf patterns fall short.
* Exceptional Communication: Capacity to articulate complex technical trade\-offs clearly to both deeply technical engineers and non\-technical business stakeholders.
* Bias for Action: A hands\-on leader who is not afraid to dive into codebases, debug complex production issues alongside the team, and lead by example.


 What We Offer
   

  

* High\-Impact Scope: Direct influence over the technological backbone of supply chains operating across emerging markets, impacting millions of shipments daily.
* Autonomous Work Culture: A flat, meritocratic engineering environment where bold ideas are encouraged, tested, and shipped rapidly.
* Competitive Remuneration: Industry\-leading salary packages, comprehensive medical benefits, learning stipends, and generous ESOP options that align your growth with company success.


 Professional Interview Process
   

  

* Initial Technical Screening: Deep\-dive discussion on system design principles, past architectural achievements, and cultural fit.
* Machine Design \& Distributed Systems Round: Live collaborative system architecture exercise addressing high\-scale supply chain scenarios.
* Deep\-Dive Code \& Engineering Review: Review of complex code samples, concurrency models, and low\-level design patterns.
* Leadership \& Culture Fit Interview: Interaction with CTO and engineering leadership focusing on roadmap execution, mentorship style, and strategic vision.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) \- Senior, Tax Technology Services
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought\-after career option.
   

  

 At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

 We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
   

  

 Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
   

  

 You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter\-personal skills to build the required relationships.
   

  

 Key responsibilities \-
   

  

 ü Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
   

  

 ü Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
   

  

 ü Code Python is a plus.
   

  

 ü Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API\-calls and MCP\- servers is key.
   

  

 ü Build end\-to\-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
   

  

 ü Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
   

  

 ü Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
   

  

 ü Implement Fiori\-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
   

  

 ü Integrate with SAP and non\-SAP systems using SAP\-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
   

  

 ü Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
   

  

 ü Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in\-app/extensibility, key\-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean\-core approach where applicable).
   

  

 ü Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
   

  

 ü Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root\-cause analysis
   

  

**Qualification And Experience Required \-**
 ü Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 ü 2\-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
   

  

 ü Hands\-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
   

  

 ü SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
   

  

 ü SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
   

  

 ü Strong hands\-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
   

  

 ü Proven delivery experience with:
   

  

 ü RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
   

  

 ü CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
   

  

 ü OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
   

  

 ü Strong understanding of HANA\-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT\-in\-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
   

  

 ü Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
   

  

 ü Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).
   

  

**ü Preferred / Nice To Have**
 ü SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
   

  

**Preferred \-**
 ü BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
   

  

 ü Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.
   

  

 How you’ll grow
   

  

 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\- based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state\-of\-the\-art, world\-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. \[1] Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
   

  

 Deloitte supports your progression through a well\-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent post graduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
   

  

 Deloitte’s culture
   

  

 Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. \[2] Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
   

  

 Corporate citizenship
   

  

 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. \[3] Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.
   

  

 References

* http://www2\.deloitte.com/ui/en/pages/careers/articles/life\-at\-deloitte\-benefits\-and\-rewards.html

title: Technical Lead – AI, SaaS, ERP & Business Automation
description:
**Technical Lead – AI, SaaS, ERP \& Business Automation**

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 7–12\+ years preferred  
**Company:** Plus UAE Group / Vortexen Dynamics

About the Role

We are looking for a **hands\-on Technical Lead / Senior Product Engineer** to take long\-term ownership of our business technology platforms.

This is not a conventional IT Manager role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to websites, basic ERP configuration, prompt engineering or no\-code automation.

We want someone who has spent several years helping build and improve a real business product such as a:

**CRM, ERP, SaaS platform, customer portal, service\-management platform, workflow system, B2B platform or multi\-module business application.**

The ideal candidate has grown within a company from developer/senior developer into a **Technical Lead or similar leadership position**, while continuing to remain technically hands\-on.

Strong preference will be given to candidates who have demonstrated **long\-term ownership and career progression within the same company/product**, rather than frequent job changes.

What You Will Own

You will lead the continued development of digital platforms serving our businesses in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Architecting and developing scalable SaaS and business applications
* Customer portals and admin platforms
* CRM, leads, enquiries, opportunities and sales workflows
* Client onboarding and service\-request management
* ERP/business\-process integrations
* Quotation, invoicing, payment and subscription workflows
* Role\-based access and approval systems
* Dashboards, management reporting and analytics
* REST APIs, webhooks and third\-party integrations
* WhatsApp, email and communication automation
* AI\-powered lead qualification and sales workflows
* AI agents, LLM integrations, RAG and intelligent document processing
* Workflow automation using tools such as n8n, Make or similar platforms
* Database and backend architecture
* Cloud deployment, security, backup and monitoring
* Code reviews and technical standards
* Managing and mentoring junior/mid\-level developers
* Translating management requirements into working products
* Taking features from requirement → architecture → development → testing → deployment → continuous improvement

What We Are Looking For

You should have approximately **7–12\+ years of software\-development experience**, with strong hands\-on experience building business applications.

We strongly prefer candidates who have:

**4\+ years of meaningful ownership within one company or product environment.**

You should be able to demonstrate experience with several of the following:

**SaaS / Product Development**  
Multi\-tenant SaaS, CRM, ERP, workflow platforms, customer portals, admin systems, subscription platforms or similar business applications.

**Backend**  
Python, FastAPI, Django, Node.js, NestJS, Laravel or comparable technologies.

**Frontend**  
React, Next.js, Angular, Vue or equivalent modern frameworks.

**Database**  
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or similar technologies.

**AI**  
OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or other LLM APIs; AI agents; RAG; embeddings; document extraction; structured outputs and AI\-enabled workflows.

**Automation**  
n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate or custom API/webhook\-based workflow automation.

**Integrations**  
CRM/ERP integrations, payment gateways, WhatsApp, email, Google services and external APIs.

**Cloud / DevOps**  
AWS, Azure or GCP; Docker; Git; CI/CD; monitoring and production deployments.

Experience with **Odoo, ERPNext, Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot or similar ERP/CRM platforms** is valuable but not mandatory.

Leadership Requirement

This position requires more than coding.

You must be comfortable:

Understanding business requirements directly from management, challenging weak requirements, designing the technical solution, allocating work to developers, reviewing code, solving production issues and taking responsibility for delivery.

You should be capable of leading approximately **3–8 developers** as the technology function grows.

At the same time, you must remain technically hands\-on.

Who Should NOT Apply

This role is unlikely to be suitable if your experience is primarily:

WordPress/web design, basic IT support, digital marketing, prompt engineering alone, Zapier\-only automation, ERP administration without development experience, project management without coding, or managing developers without personally building production systems.

We are specifically looking for a **product builder and technical leader**.

What We Will Ask During the Interview

Candidates shortlisted for this role will be asked to demonstrate a **real software product they personally helped build**.

Be prepared to explain:

Architecture, database design, APIs, authentication, permissions, workflows, cloud deployment, security, scalability, integrations and your personal contribution.

Shortlisted candidates may also receive a practical architecture exercise based on a real business SaaS platform.

First 90\-Day Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

Audit our existing applications and integrations, create a clear technical architecture and improvement roadmap, stabilize critical systems, deploy meaningful business automations, introduce AI into selected workflows, improve development standards and begin taking full ownership of our technology roadmap.

The Candidate We Want

We are especially interested in someone who can say:

**“I spent several years helping build one business product, understood how the company operated, grew into leadership, managed developers, solved real customer problems and continuously improved the platform.”**

That experience is more important to us than having worked for a famous multinational company.

**Location preference:** Kochi / Ernakulam / Kerala.

Candidates from elsewhere in Kerala who can work from Kochi or follow an agreed hybrid structure may also apply.

**Compensation:** Competitive and based on demonstrated technical ability, product ownership and leadership experience.

Work Location: In person

title: Senior / Lead Platform Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
   

  

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**About Cogentiq I2C**
 Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI platform for invoice\-to\-cash operations, spanning Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Credit Risk, and Invoice Management. The platform runs on a four\-tier architecture: a Next.js application layer, FastAPI services, the Cogentiq APA agentic orchestration layer, and a data estate built on Azure Databricks and PostgreSQL. Deployments land in client Azure tenancies against live ERP data (Dynamics 365, SAP), which means deployment engineering is a first\-class discipline, not an afterthought to development.
   

  

**Why this role, now**
 The platform has crossed from being built to being deployed. Collections is entering pilot with enterprise clients, and the deployment machinery is real: Databricks Asset Bundles with one\-click, script\-based deployment; auto\-loader ingestion running historical and incremental loads into a common data model; versioned bundles and wheel\-file packages delivered through Git and Azure Artifactory; and a quick\-start standard under which a newcomer must be able to stand up the full data platform by running one setup script. This role carries that machinery into client environments and makes it hold under client governance, client data, and client timelines. It owns everything between our release artefacts and a running, observable, correctly governed installation; candidates who want to work on agent behaviour and LLM integration should apply to the AI FDE track instead.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the deployment architecture of client installations from environment readiness through hypercare: bundle strategy, environment topology (Dev, QA, production; per\-client catalogs), release sequencing, and sign\-off that the installation meets the validation standard.
* Navigate Unity Catalog and platform governance Client and internal IT control catalog and metastore provisioning, storage decisions, and access models. You will assess what their governance model means for our setup scripts, negotiate provisioning paths, and know when a shared\-infrastructure convenience creates an SOW, NDA, or data\-isolation problem that must be escalated rather than worked around.
* Set and enforce the platform engineering standards: idempotent, rerunnable deployments; fail\-fast error handling with no silent except\-and\-continue paths; environment\-variable\-driven parameterisation with a single point of change per client value; and configuration conventions that hold across Databricks today and Fabric tomorrow.
* Own the shared utilities architecture: interface\-function contracts and factory\-pattern abstractions across Databricks, Fabric, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and storage back ends, packaged as versioned wheel files through Azure Artifactory, so swapping a client's platform is a configuration change, not a rewrite.
* Make the hard ingestion calls: auto\-loader versus custom conflict\-driven ingestion when the client will not provision Databricks, checkpoint and reprocessing strategy, retry and alerting design per pipeline, and writeback reliability to the application database.
* Run incident command during deployment and hypercare. When a deployment breaks in a client environment, you run the incident: triage across the data estate, the application database, and upstream ERP feeds; communicate honestly with the client; and land the fix and the post\-incident correction to the playbook.
* Own the deployment playbook as a product. The quick\-start guides, validation suites, and synthetic data configurations you leave behind must make the next deployment cheaper. The bar is that a newcomer deploys the platform from your playbook with one setup script.
* Coach junior Platform FDEs, reviewing their work against the standards you set and growing them toward deployment ownership.


**What You Need**
* 6 or more years in data platform or deployment engineering, with at least two years deploying into environments you did not control (client tenancies, regulated environments, or equivalent).
* Deep Azure Databricks: Asset Bundles, workflows, Unity Catalog and metastore governance, cluster and library management, service\-principal automation, and the CLI.
* Strong Python and SQL, with the judgement to review pipeline code for idempotency, failure behaviour, and configuration hygiene, not just correctness.
* PostgreSQL in production: schema evolution, write reliability, connection behaviour under load.
* CI/CD for data platforms: Git\-based release flows, semantic versioning, artefact repositories, and backward compatibility across component versions.
* Domain literacy in order\-to\-cash and accounts receivable data: invoices, receipts, remittances, customer masters, and ERP AR structures in Dynamics 365 or SAP. You cannot validate a deployment whose data you do not understand.
* Client\-facing composure: you will be the technical face of the deployment to client IT and finance stakeholders.
* Nice to have: Microsoft Fabric, observability design (OpenTelemetry, Application Insights), and experience taking a data product through pilots at multiple clients in parallel.


**Success in the first year**
* Two client deployments taken from environment readiness through hypercare, each validated against the standard suite and signed off on schedule.
* A deployment playbook that demonstrably reduced the cost of the deployment that followed it, measured in elapsed time from access granted to validated installation.
* Platform standards (idempotency, fail\-fast, parameterisation) adopted across the data engineering codebase, evidenced in review practice, not just documentation.
* At least one governance or infrastructure negotiation with client IT resolved without escalation to leadership.


 If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
   

  

 Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
 *Introduce Yourself* 
 in the top\-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) \- Senior, Tax Technology Services
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought\-after career option.
   

  

 At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

 We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
   

  

 Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
   

  

 You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter\-personal skills to build the required relationships.
   

  

 Key responsibilities \-
   

  

 ü Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
   

  

 ü Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
   

  

 ü Code Python is a plus.
   

  

 ü Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API\-calls and MCP\- servers is key.
   

  

 ü Build end\-to\-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
   

  

 ü Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
   

  

 ü Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
   

  

 ü Implement Fiori\-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
   

  

 ü Integrate with SAP and non\-SAP systems using SAP\-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
   

  

 ü Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
   

  

 ü Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in\-app/extensibility, key\-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean\-core approach where applicable).
   

  

 ü Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
   

  

 ü Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root\-cause analysis
   

  

**Qualification And Experience Required \-**
 ü Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 ü 2\-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
   

  

 ü Hands\-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
   

  

 ü SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
   

  

 ü SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
   

  

 ü Strong hands\-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
   

  

 ü Proven delivery experience with:
   

  

 ü RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
   

  

 ü CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
   

  

 ü OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
   

  

 ü Strong understanding of HANA\-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT\-in\-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
   

  

 ü Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
   

  

 ü Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).
   

  

**ü Preferred / Nice To Have**
 ü SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
   

  

**Preferred \-**
 ü BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
   

  

 ü Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.
   

  

 How you’ll grow
   

  

 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. title: Lead implementation engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 Qualys is seeking an experienced Lead Implementation Engineer to join our Global Implementation organization.
   

  

 This is a highly technical, customer\-facing role responsible for leading the successful deployment, integration, and adoption of Qualys Enterprise Cybersecurity solutions across complex enterprise environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on implementation engineer with proven experience deploying enterprise cloud\-based Saa S security platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong customer engagement skills and is responsible for driving customers from technical discovery through successful production deployment.
   

  

 As a Lead Implementation Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical owner during implementation engagements, collaborating with customers, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Technical Support to deliver successful business outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed with approximately 75% focus on technical deployment, engineering, troubleshooting, and integrations, and 25% focus on implementation consulting, technical discovery, and customer advisory.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Technical Deployment \& Engineering
   

  

 Lead end\-to\-end deployment and implementation of Qualys cybersecurity solutions for enterprise customers. Serve as the primary technical owner throughout the customer implementation lifecycle. Configure, deploy, validate, optimize, and troubleshoot complex product deployments across enterprise environments. Design and implement integrations with customer infrastructure, cloud platforms, identity providers, enterprise applications, and security technologies. Troubleshoot complex deployment, networking, operating system, authentication, API, cloud, and integration challenges. Develop automation and deployment workflows using APIs and scripting to improve implementation efficiency and customer outcomes. Collaborate closely with Product Engineering and Technical Support to investigate product issues, validate fixes, and resolve customer escalations. Perform root cause analysis for implementation challenges and recommend scalable technical solutions. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) across assigned Qualys product portfolios. Mentor implementation engineers and contribute to implementation standards, best practices, and continuous process improvements.
   

  

 Customer Implementation \& Consulting
   

  

 Conduct technical discovery workshops to understand customer environments, security architecture, business requirements, and deployment objectives. Translate customer requirements into implementation strategies and deployment plans. Guide enterprise customers through implementation milestones, production readiness, and operational best practices. Deliver implementation documentation, technical knowledge transfer, and deployment recommendations. Build trusted relationships with customer Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and IT Operations teams. Partner with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure successful customer adoption.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 8\+ years of experience implementing enterprise cloud\-based Saa S solutions. Proven experience leading enterprise customer implementations from technical discovery through production deployment. Strong customer\-facing experience working with enterprise IT and Security organizations. Hands\-on experience integrating enterprise platforms using REST APIs. Experience using scripting languages such as Python, Power Shell, Bash, or similar to automate deployments, integrations, operational workflows, or troubleshooting tasks. Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to independently lead multiple enterprise implementation engagements. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

**Preferred Experience**
 Candidates with implementation experience in one or more of the following solution domains are highly preferred:
   

  

 Vulnerability \& Exposure Management Patch Management Policy Compliance Endpoint Security / EDR Cloud Security (CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP) Container Security Web Application Security External Attack Surface Management Asset Management Identity \& Access Management Security Information \& Event Management (SIEM)
   

  

**Technical Skills**
 Candidates are not expected to possess expertise in every technology listed below. Successful candidates should demonstrate strong competency across multiple areas depending on their background and implementation experience.
   

  

**Experience In Several Of The Following Areas Is Preferred**
 Windows and Linux administration Enterprise networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Routing, Firewalls, VPNs, Proxy Servers, Load Balancers) Public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) Identity and authentication technologies (Active Directory, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, Open ID Connect) REST APIs and API\-based integrations Scripting and automation using Python, Power Shell, Bash, or similar languages Virtualization and container technologies (VMware, Docker, Kubernetes) Enterprise integrations such as ITSM, SIEM, or Identity platforms Enterprise security architecture and deployment best practices
   

  

**Preferred Industry Background**
 Experience implementing enterprise cybersecurity or cloud\-native Saa S solutions within customer environments is highly preferred. Candidates from organizations specializing in vulnerability management, cloud security, endpoint security, exposure management, identity security, or enterprise security platforms will be well suited for this role.

title: Software Engineer (Backend + AI Native)
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform, the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to an audience of \~250 million Bengalis worldwide. We're part of the wider SVF ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Role :**




 We are looking for engineers (backend heavy \+ AI Native) to join our tech team based in Kolkata. This role sits at the core of revenue infrastructure — covering payment orchestration, subscription lifecycle, and high\-scale backend systems.
 



  





 You won’t maintain systems. You’ll design, ship, and scale them. Every deployment impacts millions of users and real revenue.
 



  





**Please note :**

 This would be an onsite role from Kolkata
 




  





**What You’ll Own \+ Key Responsibilities :** 



* Own end\-to\-end technical decisions — API contracts, data models, service boundaries, and integration patterns — across a live, high\-traffic streaming platform.
* Think architecturally first: identify the right abstraction, lead the trade\-off conversation, and document decisions that the broader team can reason about and build on.
* Use AI\-native development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as your default workflow — not as shortcuts, but as force multipliers where you own the output and know when to override.
* Lead technical design reviews for new capabilities, surfacing risks, edge cases, and cross\-system dependencies before a single line gets committed.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues across backend systems — trace root causes, write clean fixes, and prevent recurrence through deliberate design choices.
* Partner closely with product, growth, content, and data teams to translate fast\-moving business requirements into robust, maintainable backend solutions.
* Contribute to hoichoi Cortex — our central data aggregation and intelligence layer — by designing clean API contracts and data flows that connect content signals, user behaviour, and business metrics.
* Evaluate and integrate third\-party services, LLM APIs, and external tools — making deliberate build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-compose decisions with clear justifications.
* Review code that a future\-you would be proud to maintain: readable, testable, and defensible.



  





**If you have :** 



* 2–4\+ years of backend engineering experience with production ownership — at least one system that real users depend on and you were responsible for.
* Strong fundamentals in at least one backend language and comfort reasoning about system design, data modelling, and API contracts.
* Ability to read a system, understand its constraints, and make architectural recommendations — not just execute tickets handed down to you.
* Experience working in a fast\-moving product team where requirements change mid\-sprint and priorities shift without warning.
* Default user of AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) on real shipped features — with at least one concrete example where AI generated significant code that you evaluated, debugged, or chose to override.
* Comfort with ambiguity: you can move without complete information and know when to decide independently versus when to ask.



  





**And (or) also have :** 



* Familiarity with streaming or media tech: CDNs, adaptive bitrate, DRM, or video processing pipelines.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures, message queues (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ), or distributed microservices.
* Prior work on data pipelines, analytics integrations, or internal developer tooling.
* Exposure to LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or AI\-augmented product features shipped to real users.



  





**Candidates must have an active GitHub or portfolio for skill evaluation.** 




  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.
 



  





 Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'
 



  





 When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt\-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

title: Software Engineer -Backend
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr, our vision is a world where all businesses are powered by embedded payments. Modulr enables businesses, from SMEs to Enterprise, initially across the UK and Europe to efficiently pay\-in, collect and disburse funds instantly via a range of payment schemes, accounts, and card products.
   

  

 We have created an industry\-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. Our Vertical Solutions targets a growing range of industry verticals which directly connect their IT platforms to our APIs and webhooks. We solve complex payment problems for hundreds of clients in a range of industries, including Travel, Lending, Wage Advance, and Investment \& Wealth.
   

  

 We are deeply integrated into the payment eco\-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
   

  

 Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
   

  

 Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Team**
 At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in
   

  

 the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on
   

  

 a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross\-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead.
   

  

**Summary**
 In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr’s event\-driven payments platform. You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle—from shaping technical approaches to delivering production\-grade software—within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Specific duties
   

  

**Engineering \& Architecture**
* Design and develop backend services using Java (17\+) or similar OO languages.
* Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event\-driven components in a cloud\-native environment.
* Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability.
* Design clean, well\-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts.
* Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling.


 Distributed Systems \& Reliability
   

  

* Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability.
* Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services.
* Build systems with strong observability—logs, metrics, tracing—ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly.


**Quality \& Testing**
* Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber.
* Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team.
* Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long\-term technical health.


 DevOps, Cloud \& Tooling
   

  

* Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services).
* Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices.
* Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture.


 Collaboration \& Delivery
   

  

* Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery.
* Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems.
* Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on.


**About You**
 You’re an engineer who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system\-level problems. You bring:
   

  

* 4\+ years expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java.
* Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience building and operating microservices in production.
* Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load.
* Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team\-first mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement.
* Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality work.
* A growth mindset—you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow.
* A self\-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it’s also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

 **founders, frontend, product, and QA teams**

 **hands on role**

**What You’ll Do** 

 • Develop and maintain backend services using
 **C\# and .NET** 




 • Build and maintain
 **RESTful Web APIs** 
 using

 • Work with QA to investigate issues and verify fixes
 



 • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable backend code
   




**What We’re Looking For** 

 •
 **0\.5–3 years of experience** 
 in backend development
 



 • Strong fundamentals in
 **C\# and .NET** 




 • Hands on experience with
 **ASP.NET Core** 




 • Experience building
 **Web APIs / REST APIs** 




 • Practical experience with
 **Entity Framework Core** 




 • Working knowledge of
 **MySQL and SQL** 




 • Experience using
 **Postman** 
 for API testing and debugging
 



 • Good understanding of
 **object oriented programming and backend development principles** 




 • Understanding of API
 **validation, error handling, authentication, and security fundamentals** 




 • Good debugging and problem solving skills
 



 • Working knowledge of
 **Git and version control** 




 • Ability to work independently and collaborate with frontend, QA, and product teams
   




**Good to Have**

 **JWT authentication**

 **database indexing and query optimization**

 **caching, background services, or asynchronous processing**

 **consumer applications or reward based products**

**How can an API be made reliable, maintainable, and easy for the frontend to consume?** 




 We value people who take ownership, investigate problems properly, and are comfortable working in an

 Typesider is an

Are you passionate about building scalable, resilient systems in the fast\-moving world of FinTech?

You’ll work with a modern tech stack — including Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS Lambda, and a wide range of AWS services — and collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable, high\-performance systems.


If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, this could be a great fit.

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the **UK \& India,** helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. description:
Salesforce Data Cloud and Data 360 Consultant
 



  





**Location: Chennai** 




  





**Employment type:** 




 Experience: 4\+ years in data engineering, analytics or CRM delivery, including 2\+ years of practical Salesforce data\-platform implementation or closely related customer data platform
 



 work.
 



**About Teceze** 




 Teceze is an IT services company supporting clients across Digital Workplace Services, Cloud and Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Staff Augmentation and Global Procurement Services. This role contributes to client Salesforce consulting and delivery, working with business stakeholders and technical teams to implement, improve and support enterprise applications.
 



**Role purpose** 




 Teceze is seeking a Salesforce Data Cloud and Data 360 Consultant to implement trusted customer data foundations for client analytics, segmentation and AI use cases. You will connect data sources, establish useful customer profiles and help business teams activate data responsibly. Hands\-on data delivery and reconciliation are central to this role.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Run data discovery sessions to establish use cases, source ownership, refresh needs, consent requirements and the business definition of a customer.
* Configure source connections and ingestion pipelines for Salesforce and external systems, choosing appropriate batch or streaming approaches.
* Map source fields into data models; implement transformations, standardisation and quality checks that preserve meaning and traceability.
* Design identity resolution and reconciliation rules, investigating false matches, duplicate profiles and records that fail to resolve.
* Build calculated insights, SQL analyses and audience segments with documented logic, expected counts and business\-owner validation.
* Configure data activation into approved sales, service and marketing destinations; verify field mappings, eligibility rules and successful delivery.
* Support Agentforce grounding and retrieval use cases with appropriate source selection, permissions and tests of data relevance and freshness.
* Implement access restrictions, consent controls, retention requirements and data lineage in collaboration with client governance teams.
* Monitor ingestion errors, processing latency, consumption and capacity; recommend optimisations against agreed budgets and service expectations.
* Prepare test evidence, release documentation and operating runbooks; train client teams to interpret results and investigate routine data issues.



**Required skills and experience** 



* Hands\-on delivery experience with Salesforce Data Cloud or Data 360, or comparable customer data platform experience with demonstrable Salesforce capability.
* Strong SQL, data modelling, transformation and reconciliation skills, including investigation of missing, duplicated or inconsistent records.
* Understanding of customer identity matching, unified profiles, segmentation and activation across business applications.
* Experience with APIs, connectors and data pipelines, including error handling, incremental loads and source\-system dependencies.
* Ability to turn a business use case into a testable data design and explain data limitations to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Practical understanding of permission models, data minimisation, consent and the operational consequences of poor data quality.



  





**Key deliverables** 




 Source\-to\-target mappings, data models, identity\-resolution rules, segment definitions, reconciliation evidence, activation configurations and support runbooks.
 



 Measures of success
 


* Data completeness, freshness and matching quality meet the thresholds agreed with source owners and business stakeholders.
* Activated segments and insights reconcile to approved test cases and reach the intended destinations with appropriate access controls.
* Consumption, failures and processing delays are visible, explained and managed within agreed operating expectations.

title: Software Technical Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on Software Tech Lead to own the architecture and lead development of real\-time, data\-intensive systems across several projects — backend services and visualisation\-heavy frontends.
 



 You'll set technical direction, own architectural decisions, review designs and code, and mentor the engineers around you — while still building the hard parts yourself. Your leverage comes from the quality of your technical judgement and how much you raise the level of the people you work with.
 



  





**About Us** 




 We build mission\-critical software for the defence and aerospace sectors. Our teams bring together software engineers, RF and electronics specialists, and domain experts to deliver turnkey solutions for problems with no off\-the\-shelf answer, across tactical radios, radar systems, and applied research.
 



 Much of our work sits around the systems that produce signal and sensor data — building the software that generates, validates, analyses, and visualises that data at scale. The common thread is volume under time pressure, and interfaces that let operators and analysts act on what they are seeing immediately.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**System design \& architecture** 



* Own the architecture end to end — services, data flow, storage, and the backend/frontend contract.
* Design real\-time pipelines that hold up as data volume, concurrent sources, and complexity grow.
* Make and document the consequential calls: service boundaries, streaming versus batch, data modelling, where to spend the latency budget.



**Hands\-on engineering** 



* Build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of sensor and signal data at low latency.
* Implement the data\-processing and analytics logic that turns raw data into real\-time insight.
* Work with event streaming (Kafka) and caching / inter\-service communication (Redis).
* Build and optimise data\-heavy frontend features — dashboards, charts, live visualisations — including state management and performance work for large datasets and live updates.



**Technical leadership \& mentorship** 



* Set technical direction and bring the team along with the reasoning behind it.
* Review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability — using review as a teaching mechanism, not a gate.
* Mentor engineers through hard problems, and raise the bar on testing, instrumentation, and the practices that keep a real\-time system debuggable under pressure.



**Delivery \& collaboration** 



* Break requirements into workstreams and sequence them by priority, risk, and technical dependency.
* Run sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives, keeping the team unblocked and the plan honest.
* Work with data scientists, electronics engineers, and UI/UX to turn requirements into designs.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must\-haves
 


* **Full\-stack depth, currently hands\-on.** 
 You're building across backend and frontend today, with real depth in distributed systems, high\-throughput processing, and SQL or equivalent.
* **System design at scale.** 
 You've shipped systems where architecture was the deciding factor, and can walk us through the tradeoffs you weighed.
* **Full\-lifecycle ownership.** 
 You've taken multiple projects from requirements through design, build, release, and maintenance.
* **Technical leadership.** 
 A team's technical direction has run through you — via design review, mentorship, and credibility rather than reporting lines.
* **Languages.** 
 Hands\-on in one or more of C\+\+, C\# or Python, plus familiarity with React or Angular. We work across projects with different stacks, so breadth counts.
* **Core stack.** 
 Production experience with event streaming and caching in a real\-time pipeline (Kafka and Redis, or equivalents), and with data\-intensive frontends.
* **Experience.** 
 Bachelor's in Computer Science, Electronics, or equivalent practical experience, plus 6\+ years including substantial real\-time or data\-intensive work.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to defence, aerospace, or another mission\-critical regulated domain.
* Familiarity with sensor or signal\-data concepts — enough to hold a productive conversation with our electronics engineers.
* Experience with time\-series data stores, or binary / columnar formats for moving large datasets efficiently.
* Experience introducing an architectural change into a live system without a rewrite.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* **Problems that resist easy answers.** 
 Real\-time constraints, large\-scale sensor data, and operational reliability requirements — on systems that get used.
* **Architectural ownership from day one.** 
 Real design authority, not a role where the important decisions were made elsewhere.
* **Depth alongside domain experts.** 
 You'll work directly with electronics and RF engineers, and pick up domain context that's hard to come by elsewhere.

 Xpedeon is an integrated purpose\-built ERP Suite contributing to digital transformation in the construction and engineering industry across the globe.
 



  





 Backed by more than two decades of industry experience, Xpedeon has been helping businesses to scale up efficiency, increase profitability, and maximize margins in today’s dynamic business environment. Our integrated solution stack addresses the unique requirements and challenges of building contractors, civil engineering contractors, specialist contractors, and housebuilders by simplifying their business systems with our powerful, comprehensive suite.
 



  





 More than 30,000 users have gained quantum leaps in productivity and control, improving their operational efficiency and growing their bottom line with Xpedeon.
 



  





**Job Description: AI Systems Engineer (Chatbots)** 




 Team: Product Engineering — AI Platform
 



 Reports to: Engineering Lead
 



 Level: Mid–Senior (see notes at bottom)
 



**About the role** 




 We're building an agentic AI system that turns natural\-language questions into accurate, governed answers over structured business data. This isn't a thin wrapper around a chat API — it's a multi\-stage pipeline with retrieval, guardrails, and session state, and we need someone who can design and build that scaffolding, not just prompt a model well. You'll work on the reliability, safety, and scalability of an AI agent used in production by real customers.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Design and build multi\-step agent pipelines that combine LLM calls with deterministic logic — retrieval, validation, and business rules — rather than relying on a single prompt to do everything.
* Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG): embedding\-based search, ranking, and context assembly that stays within token/latency budgets as the underlying knowledge base grows.
* Build safeguards around model output — validating, sanitizing, and constraining what the AI is allowed to do or return before it reaches a user or a downstream system.
* Design for ambiguity: detect when a user's request is underspecified and decide whether to ask a clarifying question, apply a documented default, or refuse — rather than having the system silently guess.
* Own session and conversation state so multi\-turn interactions stay coherent across follow\-up questions.
* Write automated regression tests for AI\-driven behavior, including "golden" test sets that catch quality regressions a human might not notice by eyeballing a few responses.
* Extend the system to new use cases/domains through configuration rather than one\-off code, so growth doesn't multiply maintenance burden.
* Collaborate with frontend, data, and product stakeholders to ground the system in real business rules and correct data access boundaries.
* Instrument and monitor the pipeline in production — latency, cost, failure modes, and answer quality over time.



**Required qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python (or a comparable backend language).
* Hands\-on experience building applications on top of large language models — not just calling a chat API, but designing multi\-step logic, structured outputs, and validation around it.
* Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation or vector/embedding\-based search.
* Strong SQL skills and comfort reasoning about data access, correctness, and security boundaries.
* Solid testing practices — unit testing, mocking external dependencies, and building regression suites for systems with non\-deterministic components.
* Experience designing clean interfaces/contracts between components in a service or pipeline, so systems stay maintainable as they grow.
* Clear written communication — comfortable documenting assumptions and design decisions rather than guessing silently on ambiguous requirements.



**Preferred qualifications** 



* Experience with a major LLM provider platform (Google Vertex AI/Gemini, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Anthropic).
* Experience building a natural\-language\-to\-SQL or natural\-language\-to\-structured\-query system specifically.
* Familiarity with cloud deployment (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker).
* Experience with session/cache stores (e.g., Redis) for stateful, multi\-turn systems.
* Frontend familiarity (React/Next.js/TypeScript) sufficient to collaborate across the stack.
* Domain experience in financial, ERP, or B2B analytics data.



**What we're explicitly not looking for** 



* Deep ML research or model\-training expertise — this role is about building robust systems around a foundation model API, not training models.
* Pure prompt\-engineering/no\-code AI experience without underlying software engineering skill.


- 


**Success in the first 90 days** 



* Ship at least one end\-to\-end pipeline component (retrieval, validation, or state management) into production use.
* Contribute a test suite that catches a real quality or safety regression before it reaches users.
* Help onboard a new use case/data domain into the system, proving it can extend without a full rewrite.



  





**Seniority notes** 



* Mid\-level: owns individual pipeline components under an established architecture.
* Senior/lead: additionally owns architectural decisions as the system scales to new domains, sets testing/quality standards, and represents the AI platform in cross\-team design discussions.

title: Tech S And T - AI Integration Engineer Senior - GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Designation AI Integration Engineer**
**Job Description**
* Build end‑to‑end AI/ML pipelines (training → evaluation → deployment) using MLflow/Kubeflow/Databricks/Weights \& Biases with experiment tracking and model registries.
* Develop models with Python using PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit‑learn, and Hugging Face Transformers, package as reproducible services.
* Implement LLM/RAG systems with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel and vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, Chroma) for semantic retrieval and grounding.
* Fine‑tune and optimize models using PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA, DeepSpeed/Accelerate, distillation, and quantization; export/optimize via ONNX Runtime/TorchScript/TensorRT.
* Engineer scalable model serving with KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve, NVIDIA Triton, supporting A/B, canary, shadow deployments.
* Build evaluation harnesses (offline/online) with Ragas, TruLens, Promptfoo, golden datasets, and regression gates integrated into CI/CD.
* Construct feature stores (e.g., Feast) and data contracts (Protobuf/Avro/Pydantic); enforce data quality with Great Expectations/Deequ.
* Orchestrate event‑driven pipelines with Airflow/Prefect/Dagster; streaming/messaging via Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS and schema registries.
* Design Python microservices using FastAPI/gRPC; integrate with downstream systems via REST/GraphQL; write robust automation in Python/Bash/PowerShell and SQL for data ops.
* Use notebooks (Jupyter) and packaging (Poetry/pip/conda) with virtualenvs, environment locking, and artifacts suitable for promotion across stages.
* Apply testing \& quality: pytest, unit/integration/e2e tests, property‑based (hypothesis), linters/formatters (ruff/flake8, black), type checks (mypy/pyright), pre‑commit.
* Deliver IaC with Terraform/Pulumi; manage config via Helm/Kustomize; implement GitOps with Argo CD/Flux on managed/self‑hosted Kubernetes.
* Build secure CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins/Azure DevOps) for app/data/ML artifacts, artifact promotion, provenance, and automated rollbacks.
* Embed DevSecOps: SAST/DAST/IAST (Snyk/Checkmarx/SonarQube), container \& IaC scanning (Trivy), dependency hygiene (Dependabot/Renovate), SBOM (Syft/CycloneDX).
* Enforce policy‑as‑code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno), image signing/verification (Sigstore/cosign), supply‑chain standards (SLSA, in‑toto).
* Manage secrets/KMS with Vault and native managers; adopt short‑lived workload identities, mTLS, and least‑privilege RBAC/ABAC in clusters and pipelines.
* Implement AI safety \& governance: prompt‑injection defenses, output filtering, PII redaction, guardrails (Guardrails.ai/NeMo Guardrails/Presidio), policy checks.
* Monitor model/data drift, bias, and performance with Evidently/WhyLabs/Arize/Fiddler; unify telemetry via OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, Jaeger.
* Optimize compute/GPU: CUDA/cuDNN/NCCL, HPA/VPA/KEDA, efficient batching, caching, concurrency control; track cost and latency SLOs.
* Implement progressive delivery for services/models (blue/green, canary, shadow) using Argo Rollouts/Flagger with instant rollback and health checks.
* Operate API gateways and service mesh (Kong/NGINX/Envoy, Istio/Linkerd) for rate limiting, mTLS, authN/Z, and zero‑trust patterns.
* Ensure privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP/ISO 27001\): data minimization, masking/tokenization, DLP, lineage (OpenLineage/Marquez), model cards/data sheets.
* Collaborate with security, data, and platform teams to publish golden paths, templates, and reference implementations for repeatable AI delivery.
* Contribute to code/design reviews and SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs/error budgets), on‑call readiness, incident response, and blameless post‑mortems.


**Desired Profile**
* Looking for a DevSecOps \& AI Engineer with 4–7 years of hands‑on experience in cloud platforms, automation, and AI/ML engineering workflows.
* Strong expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and modern CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Proficient in Python with experience in FastAPI, ML libraries (PyTorch/TensorFlow), and scripting using Bash or PowerShell for automation.
* Solid experience in DevSecOps practices including SAST/DAST, container/IaC scanning, secrets scanning, SBOM, and policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Hands‑on exposure to MLOps and AI integration using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights \& Biases, KServe, Seldon Core, or BentoML.
* Experience building or integrating RAG/LLM pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, or vector databases (Pinecone/FAISS/Weaviate).
* Strong cloud fundamentals across AWS/Azure/GCP with ability to architect secure, automated infrastructure via IaC and GitOps (Argo CD/Flux).
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/Loki) for application and model performance.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem‑solving, and system debugging skills with a collaborative, engineering‑first mindset.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to work cross‑functionally with Data, AI/ML, DevOps, Security, and Platform Engineering teams.


**Experience 4 To 7 Years**
**Education B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science**
**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and IaC for automated cloud and platform provisioning.
* Kubernetes, Docker/Podman, Helm, and Kustomize for container orchestration and packaging.
* CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficient in Python (FastAPI, ML/LLM libraries) and scripting with Bash/PowerShell.
* DevSecOps tooling: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, and secret scanning.
* MLOps platforms: MLflow, Kubeflow, W\&B, Azure ML, Vertex AI for model lifecycle management.
* Model serving frameworks: KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve for scalable inference.
* RAG/LLM integration: LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma).
* Monitoring \& observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger.
* GitOps tools (Argo CD, Flux), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet), and serverless functions.
