title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 
**Role** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer (AWS)
 **Function** 
 Engineering \& Cloud Infrastructure
 **Reporting to** 
 CTO
 **Location** 
 Remote (India)
 **About XED** 
 XED is a premier global executive education organization established in 2015, committed to empowering senior leaders across the Middle East, Far East, LATAM, and South Asia. We collaborate exclusively with Ivy League universities to design and deliver high\-impact online and hybrid programs in strategy, leadership, entrepreneurship, innovation, digital, and finance. With a focus on immersive learning and technology, XED has empowered over 15,000 senior leaders from Fortune 500 companies and global brands.
 *XED is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of gender, background, age, or belief.* 
*Website: www.xedinstitute.org* 
**Role Purpose** 
 XED is launching Athena, our compute\-intensive, AI\-powered platform \- built to handle thousands of concurrent users. This hands\-on individual\-contributor role owns the AWS infrastructure end to end — designing, building, and operating it — with a focus on rapid scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, security, and cost efficiency.Athena delivers its AI capabilities through managed third\-party APIs (LLM and embeddings via hosted APIs; real\-time voice and avatar via third\-party providers) rather than self\-hosted models. The core engineering challenge is therefore orchestrating expensive, rate\-limited, latency\-sensitive third\-party services at high concurrency.The ideal candidate is a senior engineer (5\+ years) who can both architect and operate production AWS infrastructure, available to join within two weeks, in a fully remote environment.
 **Detailed Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and operate end\-to\-end AWS infrastructure (compute, networking, storage, databases, security) for Athena and XED's wider product suite.
* Architect for rapid scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance: multi\-AZ deployments, auto\-scaling, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery.
* Orchestrate high\-concurrency integration with rate\-limited, real\-time third\-party APIs : queuing, backpressure, connection pooling, retries, circuit breakers, and fallbacks.
* Build resilient real\-time media streaming infrastructure (WebSocket / WebRTC, low\-latency edges, media relays) to serve voice and avatar sessions at scale.
* Implement and own infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) for reproducible, reviewable, auditable provisioning.
* Extend and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines) enabling safe, frequent, low\-risk deployments.
* Establish end\-to\-end observability (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting); lead incident response and post\-incident hardening.
* Own security and compliance posture: IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and encryption, supporting XED's GDPR data\-processor obligations.
* Drive cost efficiency across both AWS spend and third\-party API usage: right\-sizing, savings plans, and per\-session / per\-call cost instrumentation and controls.
* Manage core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, ECS/EKS, CloudFront, Route 53\) alongside Athena's stack (Node.js/Next.js, MongoDB, Qdrant).
* Conduct architecture reviews and security audits; track AWS and relevant tooling updates and recommend improvements to leadership.


**Educational Qualification \& Certifications** 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
 **AWS certifications are preferred, not mandatory.** 
 Demonstrated experience scaling and operating production systems outweighs certification. The most relevant credentials are the
 **AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (DOP\-C02\)** 
 and
 **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP\-C02\)** 
 ; the Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA\-C03\) and Security – Specialty (SCS\-C02\) are also valued.
 **Experience** 
 5\+ years of hands\-on experience both designing and operating AWS cloud infrastructure in production. The ideal candidate will have personally scaled a production system to thousands of concurrent users and operated latency\-sensitive, API\-dependent services in production. Strong infrastructure\-as\-code, containerisation, CI/CD, and observability practice is expected. Prior experience in a fully remote engineering team is preferred.
 ***Early joiners strongly preferred — candidates available to start within two weeks will be prioritised.***
**Professional Growth \& Career Advancement** 
 This role offers a compelling opportunity to architect and own the cloud backbone of a globally operating executive education platform at its defining launch\-and\-scale moment. High performers who demonstrate measurable impact on infrastructure reliability, cost efficiency, and engineering velocity may be considered for senior or lead roles within the Engineering function at XED.

title: Principle Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job \*Role Overview \* We are seeking a Principal Engineer who sets technical direction by example. An architect who still writes code, reviews code, and makes the engineers around them better. This is not a role for someone who has moved away from the keyboard. It is a role for an engineer who has shipped production systems at scale, knows the million small details that separate a demo from a product customers depend on. You will set architectural direction across our products and platforms. You will partner with our existing engineers, challenge their thinking, and ensure the systems we build are the best\-architected they can be — simple, modular, resilient, and built to evolve. You will spend real time in code reviews, in design documents, and at the keyboard yourself. And you will invest heavily in the engineers around you: the strength of the team you grow is the truest measure of your success in this role. You understand that AI has fundamentally changed the job of a Principal Engineer — for the better. The best practitioners today ship more, review more, prototype more, and mentor more because they treat AI as an amplifier, not a threat. You will bring that mindset to DeepRunner, and you will help the rest of the engineering organization get better at it. \*What You’ll Do \* Set architectural direction across our products and platforms. Drive the decisions that matter: service boundaries, data models, API contracts, and the shape of the systems we will still be living with in three years. Write code. Ship code. Review code. Your tenure here will be measured in commits and architecture decisions, not slide decks. Raise the bar on code reviews. Every review is a teaching moment. Define the standards, enforce them, and explain the “why” so they stick. Mentor and grow the engineers around you. Develop your peers and your juniors into stronger engineers. This is a core responsibility of the role, not a side activity. Ship production software with full production responsibility: edge cases, failure modes, backwards compatibility, migrations, observability hooks. Always insist on the highest standards spanning architecture, development, deployment, operational excellence. Use AI in your daily work the way a modern Principal Engineer should: to prototype faster, review more code, explore more alternatives, and multiply your own reach. Qualifications Required 10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering with a clear track record of shipping production enterprise systems that customers depend on. Exemplary practitioner: still writes production\-quality code, still does code reviews, and takes pride in it. Strong architectural judgment. Can design systems that are simple, modular, and resilient. Can spot over\-engineering and under\-engineering with equal confidence. Can explain trade\-offs in plain language. Proven history of mentoring and developing other engineers — not just shipping personal work. Concrete examples of engineers whose growth you meaningfully accelerated. Deep grasp of the “million details” of shipping production software: edge cases, failure modes, backwards compatibility, migrations, zero\-downtime changes. Active engagement with open source. Meaningful contributions to OSS projects, not just consumption. OSS is how great engineers learn from and teach each other, and we want that culture in\-house. Excellent written and spoken communication. Clarity is a core engineering skill at DeepRunner, not a soft skill. Preferred Startup experience. Comfortable working closely with distributed teams across geographies and time zones. We believe AI should empower human workers by handling repetitive tasks so people can focus on strategic thinking, creativity, and complex problem\-solving. We are a fast\-growing startup with teams across Silicon Valley, Athens, and Delhi. Our culture is rooted in \#Day1 and \#OneTeam principles. We offer: Competitive salary, equity options, and benefits Opportunities for professional growth and development A dynamic and supportive work environment To learn more about DeepRunner AI and our vision, visit https://www.deeprunner.ai

* Design Python microservices using FastAPI/gRPC; integrate with downstream systems via REST/GraphQL; write robust automation in Python/Bash/PowerShell and SQL for data ops.
* Use notebooks (Jupyter) and packaging (Poetry/pip/conda) with virtualenvs, environment locking, and artifacts suitable for promotion across stages.
* Apply testing \& quality: pytest, unit/integration/e2e tests, property‑based (hypothesis), linters/formatters (ruff/flake8, black), type checks (mypy/pyright), pre‑commit.
* Deliver IaC with Terraform/Pulumi; manage config via Helm/Kustomize; implement GitOps with Argo CD/Flux on managed/self‑hosted Kubernetes.

* Embed DevSecOps: SAST/DAST/IAST (Snyk/Checkmarx/SonarQube), container \& IaC scanning (Trivy), dependency hygiene (Dependabot/Renovate), SBOM (Syft/CycloneDX).

* Implement AI safety \& governance: prompt‑injection defenses, output filtering, PII redaction, guardrails (Guardrails.ai/NeMo Guardrails/Presidio), policy checks.
* Monitor model/data drift, bias, and performance with Evidently/WhyLabs/Arize/Fiddler; unify telemetry via OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, Jaeger.
* Optimize compute/GPU: CUDA/cuDNN/NCCL, HPA/VPA/KEDA, efficient batching, caching, concurrency control; track cost and latency SLOs.
* Implement progressive delivery for services/models (blue/green, canary, shadow) using Argo Rollouts/Flagger with instant rollback and health checks.
* Operate API gateways and service mesh (Kong/NGINX/Envoy, Istio/Linkerd) for rate limiting, mTLS, authN/Z, and zero‑trust patterns.
* Ensure privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA/DPDP/ISO 27001\): data minimization, masking/tokenization, DLP, lineage (OpenLineage/Marquez), model cards/data sheets.

* Contribute to code/design reviews and SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs/error budgets), on‑call readiness, incident response, and blameless post‑mortems.

**Experience 4 To 7 Years**

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Job description:

**The role**

You'll take over day\-to\-day backend ownership from our founding engineer, who is shifting to product. The core of the job is building: new API servers and data models across our platform — some already in flight, more planned — on Python and Azure. You'll also maintain and extend our production multi\-agent system (Python/LangGraph fronting a healthcare data warehouse): it's largely built, and needs incremental improvement, monitoring, and steady hands. You'll carry the backend through a major go\-live this fall, working directly with the founders and our external web\-app development partner.

**What you'll do**

* Design and build new API services and data models — greenfield development is the bulk of the role, picking up in\-flight work and starting planned services from scratch.
* Maintain and extend the production LangGraph multi\-agent backend: incremental capabilities, tool integrations, monitoring, and reliability.
* Design and build multi\-tenant access control: per\-organization data isolation, credential architecture, JWT/OIDC auth flows (Auth0\).
* Run the backend's Azure footprint day to day: managed identities, Key Vault, CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion (dev → UAT → prod).
* Handle healthcare data responsibly — PHI\-aware design is part of the job.
* Work async with a founder\-led team and an external dev shop; write decisions down.

**What we're looking for**

* 5–8 years of backend engineering with deep, current Python.
* A track record of designing and shipping API services and data models from scratch — not just extending existing systems.
* You've worked with LLM agent systems in production — LangGraph preferred, or comparable frameworks with real users behind them.
* Production Azure experience: identity, secrets, app hosting, pipelines.
* Strong SQL (SQL Server and/or Postgres) and multi\-tenant data\-access design.
* Auth fundamentals: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT.
* Self\-directed — you'll often be the only engineer on the problem.
* Bonus: US healthcare data (claims, CMS programs), HIPAA experience, Terraform.

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

**About The Team And The Role**
 Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be on the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose\-driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive work environment, join eBay — a company you can be proud to be with.
   

  

 eBay’s Ads teams build the production systems that help buyers discover relevant inventory and help sellers grow their businesses. These systems span multiple applied ML domains, including sponsored search, item recommendations, seller guidance experiences, ranking, retrieval, personalization, and GenAI\-powered capabilities.
   

  

 As a Backend Engineer, ML Systems you will help build the platforms, services, APIs, data pipelines, and MLOps capabilities that bring cutting edge AI models into production at eBay scale. You will engineer the data pipelines that feed our models, build the infrastructure to train and serve them, and develop the APIs that deliver personalized experiences to millions of users. You will work at the intersection of machine learning and software engineering, solving complex challenges in system design and the operationalization of the latest Generative AI technologies. You will partner closely with Applied Researchers, Product Managers, and Engineering teams to turn prototypes into robust, scalable, low\-latency systems for millions of customers.
   

  

 This is a shared hiring role across Ads teams. Final team placement will be determined after offers based on each candidate’s experience, strengths, and fit with the needs of Ads Recommendations, Ads Search, and Ads Guidance.
   

  

**What You Will Accomplish**
* Design, build, and operate scalable backend and ML systems supporting sponsored experiences, ranking, retrieval, and personalization.
* Develop and own the MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD), training, validation, and monitoring of all production\-grade models.
* Engineer robust data pipelines using big data technologies to process vast datasets for model training and feature engineering.
* Implement and optimize both traditional ML models and state\-of\-the\-art Generative AI models (including LLMs) for low\-latency serving and high\-throughput environments.
* Collaborate closely with Applied Researchers to translate novel algorithms and research prototypes into hardened, production\-ready code.
* Monitor system performance, identify and resolve production issues, and continuously improve the reliability and efficiency of our ML services.


**What You Will Bring**
* BS in Computer Science or related area with 4\+ years of relevant work experience in ML / AI / Data Engineering.
* Experience in production engineering practices and software development in an OO language (Scala, Java, Python, etc.).
* Extensive experience in big data distributed processing frameworks, e.g. Apache Hadoop, Spark, Flink.
* Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch from a production perspective.
* Proven ability to build and manage CI/CD pipelines for ML models, including proficiency with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with using cloud services, big data pipelines and databases, e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure.
* Proven ability to design and build scalable, distributed systems and expose their functionality through well\-designed RESTful or gRPC APIs.


**Links To Some Of Our Previous Work**
* How eBay Created a Language Model With Three Billion Item Titles
* Complementary Item Recommendations at eBay Scale
* Transforming Fashion Discovery in E\-Commerce through Theme\-Based Categorization with GenAI
* Scroll into the Future: How eBay’s Multi\-Arm Bandits Elevate Product Recommendations Through Dynamic Pagination
* Improving eBay’s Fashion Fitment Using Size Signals From Search Queries

 eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. description:
**The Opportunity**
 The Content Platform team builds the shared systems that help Hinge Health create, manage, enrich, localize, publish, search, and deliver content across treatment experiences. The platform supports assets such as video, audio, images, captions, and text used by applications including Phoenix, Carehub, and onboarding experiences.
   

  

 The team is extending the platform to make media and content workflows more scalable, observable, and self\-service. This includes automated enrichment, localization, quality validation, asset lifecycle management, and AI\-assisted content generation for exercise therapy and other treatment experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Staff Software Engineer** 
 to provide technical leadership for the next generation of media and AI content pipelines. You will work across service boundaries to turn complex content operations into reliable, reusable platform capabilities.
   

  

 You will design and ship systems that coordinate media processing, AI\-generated audio and video assets, captions, localization, publishing, and quality control. You will help shape the platform architecture, make difficult trade\-offs explicit, and build mechanisms that allow partner teams and content creators to move faster with less operational risk.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.

* Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

**Hinge Health Hybrid Model**
 We believe that remote work and in\-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.
   

  

**This is a Bengaluru\-based role** 
 that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
   

  

* Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).
* Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am \- 6pm PT).


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
* 10\+ years of non\-internship full time professional software development experience

* Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph
* Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.
* Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A platform\-as\-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes.
* Strong backend and distributed\-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure\-mode analysis.
* Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling.

 At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1\.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI\-powered human\-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting\-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post\-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence\-based care.
   

  

 As the preferred partner to 50\+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company headquartered is in San Francisco California. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com.

We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Position: AI/ML Backend Developer (Gen AI,API, Agentic AI & RAG, Python)
Experience: 4-7 years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: 12:00 PM-9:00 PM
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Mumbai
Employment Type: Full Time
 Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.
 We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Backend Developer with equal focus on software development to join our dynamic technology team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in developing and deploying APIs, microservices, Gen AI models, and managing backend systems and integrations. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our technology by integrating cutting-edge AI/ML techniques into scalable backend solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based applications, Agentic workflows using LangGraph, and autonomous Agentic AI systems.
 Your future duties and responsibilities
• Develop, optimize, and maintain backend services for AI/ML applications.
• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based applications for intelligent data retrieval and response generation.
• Implement and deploy Gen AI and embedding models to production environments.
• Monitor and improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of existing AI/ML services.
• Design and implement robust data pipelines, RAG pipelines, Agentic Solutions using Langgraph, Langchain etc. and data processing workflows.
• Identify and solve performance bottlenecks and optimize AI/ML algorithms for production.
• Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement improvements.
• Design, build, and orchestrate multi-agent architectures, tool-calling mechanisms, and autonomous agent workflows for complex problem-solving
 Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must to have Skills:
 Minimum of 4 years of experience developing backend systems, specifically in Gen AI and AI/ML contexts.
• Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying Agentic AI systems and multi-agent workflows in production environments.
• Deep understanding of agentic concepts, including function calling/tool execution, dynamic task decomposition, multi-agent orchestration (especially using LangGraph), and persistent state management.
• Proven experience in deploying machine learning models and RAG-based AI applications in production.

 4+ years of professional software development experience building production-grade backend systems, ideally SaaS products or enterprise integration platforms, not just prototypes. Strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, and SQL against PostgreSQL. Solid grounding in software architecture, API design, error handling/logging, and production troubleshooting. Working knowledge of core procurement objects and flows (suppliers, requisitions, purchase orders, invoices, receipts) sufficient to reason about integration behavior. Experience troubleshooting integration failures using logs, API payloads, and database records. Experience with Git-based workflows: pull requests, branching, and code review. Ability to read and troubleshoot CI/CD pipeline failures. Hands-on AWS experience, including containerized deployments (ECS or equivalent, with underlying Docker knowledge), CloudWatch, and S3. Experience supporting customer-facing implementations or integrations, and distinguishing customer-specific configuration issues from product-level defects. Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to produce clear defect write-ups, technical specs, and runbooks.  About the Role We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in serverless architectures to design, build, and maintain our core cloud services. In this role, you will take ownership of our backend ecosystem, leveraging Node.js and TypeScript to deploy high-performance, event-driven applications on AWS Lambda. You will play a key role in driving architecture decisions, ensuring type safety, and optimizing our serverless infrastructure for maximum efficiency and scalability. Core Responsibilities 
 * Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices using TypeScript and Node.js. * Architect and deploy production-grade serverless components running on AWS Lambda. * Provision and manage cloud infrastructure as code (IaC) using AWS CDK, SAM, or Serverless Framework. * Build robust, event-driven integrations using API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and EventBridge. * Optimize Lambda function performance, focusing on bundle size reduction, memory tuning, and cold-start mitigation using esbuild or Webpack. * Establish structured logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing across microservices. * Write clean, secure, and type-safe code while maintaining strong unit and integration test coverage. * Lead code reviews, mentor team members, and drive backend engineering best practices. 
 Required Experience & Technical Skills 
 * 5–6 years of professional experience in backend software development. * Extensive production experience building applications with Node.js and modern TypeScript. * Deep hands-on experience architectural mapping and deploying production workloads onto AWS Lambda. * Proficient with modern bundling tools (e.g., esbuild) and configuring strict type-safety via tsconfig.json. * Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging systems, and NoSQL databases (specifically DynamoDB). * Proven track record of managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tooling. * Experience setting up and optimizing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Phone Billing
description:
Job Summary Were looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of Phone Billing, one of the most critical components of HighLevels communication platform. Phone Billing sits at the intersection of product usage, infrastructure, and revenue - it is responsible for accurately metering and monetising usage across LC Phone products, including voice, messages, phone numbers, and other communication services. The scale and criticality of this system make billing correctness non-negotiable. Every communication event can have a financial implication, and a single billing error can impact revenue, customer trust, and financial reconciliation at the same time. The platform processes 100M+ events daily across 15+ services, with billing workflows that need to remain accurate and reliable despite retries, duplicate events, delayed events, provider inconsistencies, partial failures, and continuously evolving pricing models. As a Staff Engineer, youll own the architecture, scalability, reliability, and technical strategy of the Phone Billing platform. Youll solve complex distributed-systems problems around usage metering, rating, charging, idempotency, reconciliation, credits, refunds, adjustments, provider cost tracking, and billing lifecycle management. Youll also drive the architectural evolution required to support significantly higher volumes without compromising financial accuracy or system performance. A key part of the role will be building billing systems that are correct by design - ensuring that every billable event is accounted for exactly once from a business perspective, even when the underlying infrastructure operates with retries, at-least-once delivery, asynchronous processing, and failures. Youll establish robust reconciliation mechanisms between HighLevels internal usage data, provider-level usage, and customer invoices, with strong observability and auditability to quickly identify and resolve discrepancies. Youll work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Finance, and other Staff Engineers to define pricing and billing architecture, while partnering across Phone, WhatsApp, CPaaS, and provider-integration teams. Youll influence technical decisions beyond a single team, establish engineering standards, identify systemic technical debt, and drive long-term improvements in reliability, cost efficiency, data architecture, and operational excellence. The broader Phone Core ecosystem includes CPaaS platform services, Trust Compliance, and phone number provisioning, giving this role significant architectural influence across the communication platform. Your primary focus, however, will be making Phone Billing a highly scalable, financially accurate, resilient, observable, and extensible platform capable of supporting the next 10x growth of HighLevels communication business. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end technical health of Phone Billing - proactively identify architectural bottlenecks, correctness and reliability risks, and technical debt; define and drive the roadmap to improve billing accuracy, reconciliation, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency as the platform scales to 10x its current volume. Drive 1-2 high-impact initiatives end-to-end - take ownership from problem definition and technical discovery through architecture, implementation, rollout, and measurement, ensuring the initiatives deliver measurable improvements to Phone Billing in areas such as accuracy, reliability, scalability, or cost efficiency. Architect for massive scale: Own the high-level architecture and scaling decisions for core Phone platform components, including CPaaS abstractions, provider adapters, and shared messaging/voice APIs that support billions of monthly events. Own Phone Billing end to end: usage metering, rating, reserve/commit lifecycle, idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails for the Phone channels - with zero tolerance for double-charging or lost usage Lead the evolution of Revenue Growth into a configuration-driven, rules-based platform that adapts to new regulatory and carrier requirements without invasive engineering change Work hands-on with technologies like NestJS, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Queuing Systems, Data Warehousing Systems and Service Mesh-based microservices Drive high-concurrency innovation: Lead the design and execution of cross-cutting initiatives to improve reliability, latency, and throughput across time-sensitive APIs and workflows serving millions of businesses. Drive observability and resilience by evolving our monitoring, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana), and incident response strategies - including the financial invariants that must be alerted on, not just the technical ones Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently - while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability Partner with product, infra, security, finance and legal teams to ensure data integrity, access control, and compliance across phone services Develop EM I leaders and senior engineers, build leadership pipeline, succession planning and raise the hiring bar

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Bangalore)
description:
GeneralMind is a Berlin\-based AI startup building an autonomous AI\-powered supply chain automation platform. Backed by Lakestar, Leo Capital, and leading angels with $12M raised in January 2026, we're eliminating manual, inbox\-driven workflows in enterprise supply\-chain operations \- automating Sales Order processing, Purchase Order lifecycle management, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable. We integrate with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and Salesforce, serving companies like a $16B food retailer and an $8\.2B resources company.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**Backend Ownership** 



  

  
* Own the backend end\-to\-end: service architecture, API design, reliability posture, and long\-term technical direction.
  
* Be the person who knows how everything fits together \- and who other engineers come to when they're not sure where something belongs.
  
* Set the bar on code quality, service boundaries, and shared abstractions across the engineering team.
  
* Make foundational decisions with conviction, document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.
  


  


**Python Services \& Production Systems** 



  

  
* Design for failure: retries, timeouts, graceful degradation, and recovery paths built in from the start.
  
* Write code that is easy to operate \- observable, testable, and straightforward to debug at 2am.
  
* Understand the runtime, not just the framework. Know when the problem is the code, the config, or the infrastructure.
  


  


**Workflow Engineering \& Temporal** 



  

  
* Design and build durable workflows using Temporal \- long\-running processes, async coordination, saga patterns.
  
* Own workflow observability: know when a workflow is stuck, degraded, or silently wrong before a customer notices.
  
* Think carefully about idempotency, failure modes, and replay semantics — not just the happy path.
  
* Evolve workflows without breaking running instances; manage versioning with intention.
  


  


**Reliability \& Systems Thinking** 



  

  
* Detect regressions before they become incidents; build the tooling to catch them early.
  
* Own the operational posture of the services you build: alerting, runbooks, on\-call readiness.
  
* Identify structural debt before it compounds; propose refactors that are thoughtful, not just correct.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* **Experience:** 
 6\+ years building and operating backend systems in Python, with clear ownership of production services \- not just feature delivery.
  
* **Python depth:** 
 Non\-negotiable. You make deliberate choices about async vs. sync, framework selection, and performance tradeoffs. You know the language well enough to have opinions.
  
* **Temporal or equivalent:** 
 You've used Temporal (or a comparable workflow engine) in production. You understand durable execution, not just task queues.
  
* **Reliability instinct:** 
 Idempotency, retries, and observability are part of how you design, not afterthoughts.
  
* **End\-to\-end ownership:** 
 You're comfortable being the person who holds the full backend picture. You identify what's broken or missing before you're asked, and you don't leave the system worse than you found it.
  
* **A real spike:** 
 We're a strong team with broad coverage. What we're hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we're currently underinvested in. That might be workflow systems, data infrastructure, AI\-native backend patterns, or deep domain expertise. We don't know exactly what shape it takes \- but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters.

title: Senior Cloud HPC Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
The Opportunity: Can You Build and Command a Cloud Supercomputer?
   

  

 Want to run one of the largest high\-performance computing grids in the financial industry? Are you driven by the challenge of orchestrating trillions of calculations across thousands of cloud cores to price the firm's entire trading book in minutes, not ours? Do you want to build the massive\-scale "valuation engine" that powers Citi's next\-generation risk platform?
   

  

 Citi is seeking a visionary Cloud HPC Engineer to lead the development and operation of our global pricing grid. This is the engine room of our risk system. You will be responsible for deploying, scaling, and optimizing the computational factory that runs our most complex pricing models at an unprecedented scale on public cloud platforms like AWS and GCP.
   

  

 Your Role and Impact:
   

  

 As the lead for the Pricing Engine, you are the master of massive\-scale computation. You will take the sophisticated pricing models developed by our top quants and operationalize them on a colossal grid. Your primary mission is to ensure that millions of trades can be re\-valued against thousands of historical market scenarios with extreme speed, efficiency, and rock\-solid stability.
   

  

 Your impact is at the core of our risk valuation capability. You will architect the system that answers the most fundamental question in risk: "What is it worth, right now, under this scenario?" The performance and reliability of the platform you build will directly determine the firm's ability to manage risk and meet its most critical regulatory obligations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Architect, build, and manage a massive\-scale, distributed compute grid on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) for running financial pricing models.
* Design and implement the orchestration layer responsible for distributing millions of pricing tasks efficiently across hundreds of thousands of CPU/GPU cores.
* Deploy, manage, and version control a diverse library of quantitative pricing models, ensuring they run optimally in a distributed environment.
* Obsessively monitor and optimize the performance, cost, and resource utilization of the cloud grid, driving continuous efficiency improvements.
* Collaborate with quantitative development teams to seamlessly integrate new and updated pricing models into the production grid.
* Engineer the data logistics to ensure that the correct market data, trade data, and model configurations are available for every calculation at runtime.
* Ensure the pricing engine is highly available, resilient, and capable of meeting stringent recovery time objectives.


 What We're Looking For:
   

  

* 8\+ years of professional experience with a proven track record of designing, building, and running applications on massive\-scale compute grids.
* Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with at least one major public cloud provider (AWS or GCP), including their batch processing, container, and serverless offerings.
* Deep expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Engineering Manager - Node.JS
description:
**Job Description: Software Engineering Manager at Anchanto India**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 12 to 20 years (5\+ years in People Management / Engineering Leadership)
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Enterprise B2B SaaS / Global Commerce / Supply Chain Technology
   

  

**Seniority** 
 : Mid to Senior
   

  

**About The Role**
 Anchanto is a global B2B SaaS company powering commerce for brands, retailers, logistics companies and enterprises. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Order Experience Management (OXM) platform Engineering. This role requires a blend of Node.js, Java and AWS expertise,
 **AI\-led engineering practices** 
 , and a sharp focus on system reliability, security, and cost.
   

  

 Anchanto OXM is a mission\-critical e\-commerce operations platform, not a peripheral or support system. Our customers rely on it to realize 100% of their revenue on a daily basis. The platform is used by 300\+ customers brands, retailers, and logistics providers, processes 150M\+ orders annually, and serves thousands of users across operations teams in 12 countries including France, UK, Singapore, Malaysia and UAE. Core functionality includes order orchestration, inventory visibility, marketplace and D2C integrations, fulfilment workflows, and real\-time operational insights.
   

  

**What Will Your Day Look Like?**
* Drive AI\-led engineering execution: Identify opportunities to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging using tools like Claude Code, Copilot, and Cursor; set adoption targets and measure impact on productivity.
* Evolve event\-driven, distributed system architectures: Ensure scalability, fault tolerance, and multi\-tenant isolation across AWS (SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Lambda, ECS/EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis).
* Balance feature delivery, system performance, security, and compute and storage related hyper\-scaler costs.
* Monitor SLOs, latency, and system health; lead incident response and Root Cause Analysis to eliminate recurring issues.
* Grow people: Mentor engineers and tech leads, run 1:1s, drive performance reviews, build career ladders, and retain top talent. You will conduct technical interviews, calibrate levelling, and build a strong engineering bench.
* Partner across business units and countries: Work with Product, Customer Success, and Leadership to translate requirements into scalable systems and measurable outcomes for customers and partners across ecosystem.
* Raise the bar on engineering productivity, DORA metrics, and team execution discipline.
* On day\-to\-day technical execution, while owning overall engineering outcomes.


**Skills And Experience Needed For This Job**
* Strong hands\-on experience: In Node.js backend systems at scale, with a solid grasp of asynchronous processing and high\-throughput architectures.
* Experience building: Distributed, event\-driven systems on AWS, ECS/EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Event Bridge, Aurora/PostgreSQL, S3, API Gateway, Redis/Elastic\-Cache, CloudWatch.
* System design depth: Scale multi\-tenant architecture, idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure handling.
* Track record: Designing and operating systems with high availability (99\.9%\+) and low latency (sub\-200ms P95\).
* Observability and reliability engineering: Metrics, logs, traces (Open Telemetry/Datadog), SLO/SLI, incident management, on\-call discipline.
* CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code: GitHub Actions / CodePipeline, Terraform or AWS CDK.
* Testing discipline: J\-unit tests, integration, contract, and load testing as part of the engineering bar.
* Proven track record: Improving engineering productivity, DORA metrics, and execution discipline.


 How you will build at Anchanto
   

  

* This role sets the tempo for how Anchanto builds. You will define what "good" looks like in an AI\-native engineering org, set the standards the team operates by, and make Anchanto one of the fastest\-building engineering teams in enterprise SaaS.
* You will make Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot the default toolkit across the SDLC, drive adoption, set productivity expectations, and track measurable gains in cycle time, throughput, and code quality.
* You will move the team from ticket\-driven to spec\-driven work, so AI produces the first draft of code, tests, and docs. Engineers, tech leads, and architects then focus on what compounds value: system design, scalability, security, and technical judgment.
* Every hour AI gives back will flow into new functionality, incremental innovation, and faster time\-to\-market, translating productivity gains directly into shipped capabilities that widen Anchanto's lead with enterprise customers.
* You will ship AI\-powered capabilities inside OXM, including intelligent order routing, anomaly detection, demand forecasting, conversational operations, and agentic workflows, at the reliability, security, and cost standards our enterprise customers require.
* Experience operating enterprise systems under SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls, with awareness of GDPR, PII handling, and regional data residency (critical for 12\-country operations).
* Familiarity with secure SDLC practices threat modelling, SAST/DAST, dependency and secret scanning, OWASP Top 10\.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

- Reliability: ≥ 99\.9% uptime for owned services.

 Performance: \< 200ms P95 latency for critical APIs.
 - Predictability: ≥ 85–90% release predictability (planned vs actual).

- Quality: reduction in P1/P2 incidents and MTTR; improving DORA metrics quarter over quarter.

- Scale: systems scaling to high order volumes across multiple regions without cost blowouts.

- People: strong engagement, low regrettable attrition, and a visible growth path for engineers.

 Leadership \& Ownership traits you must have
   

  

* Own delivery, quality, reliability, and cost of assigned product areas end\-to\-end.
* Build and manage teams of 10–20 engineers; drive hiring, onboarding, performance, and retention.
* Mentor engineers and tech leads; build career ladders and a strong internal bench.
* Maintain accountability and ownership within the team; make technical trade\-off calls.
* Partner with Product, Customer Success, and senior stakeholders on roadmap execution.


 Behaviours / Personal Qualities
   

  

* Outcome Ownership: owns delivery, quality, and production outcomes end\-to\-end; ensures results are achieved.
* High Accountability: takes responsibility for failures and drives closure with clear actions, owners, and timelines.
* Execution Discipline: maintains follow\-through on commitments; tracks planned vs actual and corrects deviations early.
* Systems Thinking: considers scale, failure scenarios, dependencies, and impact on performance, reliability, and cost.
* Raising the Bar: sets high standards for code, design, and team performance; actively improves team capability.

title: Software Engineer / Intern - Backend (Java)
description:
Company Description
 

 Simplify Money is building
 **Kuber.AI** 
 — an AI agent that does the financial grunt work Indians hate doing. Filing taxes. Buying digital gold. Running SIPs. The stuff people put off for months and then panic about in July.
 



 Somebody has to write the code underneath that actually moves the money — and answer for it when it doesn't. A rounding error is someone's rupees. A retry that fires twice is a double debit on a real card. A settlement that doesn't reconcile is a call from a partner and a bad week for ops. There is no "we'll fix it in the next sprint" when the number on someone's screen is wrong.
 



 We're a small team in Noida shipping fast to real users with real money on the line. Not a services shop. Not a demo factory. You'll own services end to end, and you'll be the one who picks up the phone when one of them misbehaves.
 



 We're looking for a
 **Backend Engineer** 
 who wants to build things that have to be
 *right* 
 , not just working.
 



  




 What you'll actually do
 * Build and own
 **Java services** 
 behind the product — digital gold, MF, Stocks, buy and sell, SIPs, tax filing flows, subscriptions, rewards and referrals and more
* Write money code that is
 **exact and idempotent** 
 — correct under retries, partial failures, duplicate requests and network timeouts
* Integrate with partners: payment gateways, gold providers, AMCs, stock brokers, tax and KYC APIs. Handle their downtime, their rate limits and their surprises without losing a transaction.
* **Reconcile.** 
 Daily and monthly settlement against partner statements, and chase every break until it has an explanation
* **Support what you ship.** 
 Take the escalation, trace it through the logs, find the actual cause, fix it, and write the few lines that stop it happening again
* Build the observability that makes all of the above possible — structured logs, traces, and alerts that fire before a user notices
* Use the
 **best tools going** 
 . We pay for Claude, Copilot, Cursor and anything else that earns its keep. We expect you to drive them rather than be driven by them.



 You'll work directly with our engineering lead and founders. Your code goes to production, usually within days.
 



  




 What we are looking for
 
**Must have** 



* Strong
 **Java** 
 — you can write, read and debug it without a framework holding your hand
* Working
 **SQL** 
 , and a real understanding of what a transaction, an index and isolation actually do
* Comfort with
 **REST APIs, Git** 
 , and reading a codebase you've never seen before
* At least
 **one project you've built and can defend** 
 end to end. GitHub link required. A college project counts if it's yours and you can explain every decision in it.
* Care about correctness. If you've ever used a float for money, you should know why that was wrong.



  





**Nice to have** 



* **Spring Boot** 
 , or any production framework you've actually shipped with
* **Async and queues** 
 — Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ, or any job runner you've used in anger
* A
 **NoSQL** 
 store you've modelled data in — DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra
* **Docker, CI/CD, AWS or GCP**
* **Observability** 
 — you've actually debugged something using logs, metrics or traces rather than print statements
* Anything you've built that had to be right rather than merely work — payments, ledgers, billing, reconciliation
* Genuine curiosity about how money moves in India — UPI, NPCI rails, settlement cycles



  





**Who this is for** 




 Anyone with
 **0 to 3 years** 
 . We run one process and hire for one job, and where you land depends on what you build for us, not the years on your CV.
 



  





 If you can already own a service — design it, ship it, and debug it live — that's a
 **full\-time** 
 offer. If you're a recent graduate and the fundamentals are there but the production experience isn't yet, you start as a
 **paid intern** 
 on the same team and the same code, and convert on performance. This is our primary hiring pipeline, not a side program.
 



 You apply once. We'll tell you which track you're in before any offer. We care about what you've built, not where you studied.
 



  




 Terms
 * **Location:** 
 On\-site, Noida Sector 63 office
* **Working hours:** 
 Monday to Friday, 10 AM – 7 PM
* **Full\-time:** 
 Both internship and full time available
* **Internship:** 
 Minimum 2 months, extendable up to 6 months by mutual consent. Stipend to cover for basic expenses.
* **Conversion:** 
 Strong interns get converted to full\-time. This is our primary hiring pipeline, not a side program.

title: Application Testing & Business Process Analyst
description:
**Job Summary:**  

  

Support the development, testing, validation, and deployment of service support applications and digital
  

solutions by coordinating with business stakeholders and development teams, performing end\-to\-end
  

functional testing, managing business requirements and master data activities, and creating training and
  

knowledge\-transfer documentation to support successful solution adoption.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

* Execute end\-to\-end functional, integration, regression and user acceptance testing for capabilities

developed under the program.
  

* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, expected results, test data and evidence; record defects with clear

reproduction steps, business impact and supporting screenshots.
  

* Validate business workflows across customer contact, case or service request handling, back\-office

processing, integration, notifications, reporting and user access, as applicable.
  

* Coordinate with service operations, contact center, back\-office, product, regional and IT stakeholders

to clarify requirements, obtain test data and resolve open questions.
  

* Maintain requirements, test status, defect logs, decision logs, action trackers and traceability between

business requirements, developed features and test outcomes.
  

* Perform master data cleansing, validation, maintenance and updates across relevant applications and

tools, ensuring accuracy, consistency, completeness and alignment with approved business rules.
  

* Participate in demonstrations, sprint or release reviews, solution walkthroughs and readiness

discussions; communicate risks, dependencies and unresolved defects promptly.
  

* Prepare and maintain user guides, process documents, standard operating procedures, quick\-reference

guides, FAQs, release notes and knowledge\-transfer materials.
  

* Support training preparation and delivery for business users, super users and support teams, including

demonstrations and post\-training clarification.
  

* Assist with go\-live readiness, cutover validation, user readiness, hypercare tracking and postimplementation issue analysis.
* Identify recurring process gaps, data\-quality issues and improvement opportunities using structured

analysis and user feedback.
  

* Follow applicable information security, data privacy, access\-control, documentation and changegovernance requirements.

Systems \& Domain Exposure
  

* Good working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Redwood user

experience and other Oracle applications is preferred.
  

* Exposure to Genesys Cloud, contact center platforms, CRM or service\-management applications,

workflow tools and back\-office processes is desirable.
  

* Awareness of Agentic AI, conversational AI, automation, workflow orchestration and digital\-assistant

use cases is an advantage.
  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Teams; experience with

reporting or visualization tools is preferred.
  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

* Timely completion of assigned test cycles with complete and reusable test evidence.
* Accurate defect documentation, prioritization support and closure or retest tracking.
* Requirement and test traceability with minimal gaps between business needs and delivered

functionality.
  

* Clear, current and version\-controlled training and knowledge documents before release or handover.
* Effective stakeholder coordination, timely action closure and early escalation of blockers or quality

risks.
  

* Consistent attention to data accuracy, user experience, process controls and operational readiness.

Skills \& Competencies
  

* Strong functional testing, analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand end\-to\-end business processes and translate requirements into practical test

scenarios.
  

* Good written and verbal communication, with confidence to interact with business users, developers

and program stakeholders.
  

* High attention to detail, documentation discipline and ability to manage multiple actions and

dependencies.
  

* Strong interpersonal skills, collaboration, ownership and follow\-through.
* Ability to learn new applications and processes quickly and work in a changing program environment.

Education \& Experience
  

* Graduate in engineering, computer applications, information technology, B.Sc. Information Technology,

telecommunications, business, operations or a related discipline.
  

* Prior experience in application testing, business analysis, process documentation, operations support or

digital\-transformation programs is preferred.
  

* Experience in contact center operations, back\-office management or service operations is an added

advantage.
  

* Experience working with IT development teams, business stakeholders and third\-party partners is

desirable.
  

  

**Work Conditions \& Compliance**  

  

* Fixed\-term contract for 12 months, subject to applicable company terms and conditions.
* May require coordination across functions, locations and time zones based on program needs.
* The role may require flexibility in work schedules and extended support during critical project

deliverables, testing cycles, release activities, and business priorities.
  

* Must maintain confidentiality of business, customer, employee and system information and comply

with applicable security and privacy requirements

description:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering

description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**Proven Characteristics for Success**
* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data\-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action\-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self\-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the Philippines (PH) region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.


**Preferred**
* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.


**Education**
* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self\-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.


**Tii Elements**
* **Curiosity:** 
 Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:** 
 Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:** 
 Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal \& external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self\-Awareness \& Impact:** 
 Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:**

If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

 In 3 years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 You are an engineer who leads projects at the scope of a service or major subsystem. That means : when a problem lands on your desk, it's usually ambiguous. Your job is to turn it into a clear problem statement, design a system to solve it, ship it through to production, and own how it behaves once it's there. You'll work with one or two engineers on most projects, and you'll be the technical person product, ops, and other engineering teams talk to about that domain. You're not a senior individual contributor who only writes code for assigned tickets. You're not a tech lead who's stopped writing code. You're the person between those two \- still hands\-on, but increasingly the one shaping what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve 2 \- 4 complex problems a year end\-to\-end : shape the problem, design the system, ship it, monitor it.
* Design single\-service systems independently. Define API contracts, data models, scale and reliability requirements. Document and review your design with peers before building.
* Turn ambiguity into clarity. Take half\-formed product tasks and partner with PMs to define what's actually being built. Push back when the ask doesn't make sense.
* Stay hands\-on. Write code that goes into production. Drive code reviews. Debug across service boundaries. Refactor when the codebase needs it.
* Mentor 1 \- 2 junior engineers. Be someone's first reviewer. Pair when it helps. Take their growth as your responsibility, not a side activity.
* Be in hiring. Interview candidates regularly. Help shape the interview bar for your function.
* Own outcomes, not output. Track the business or operational metric your work moves. If it doesn't move, that's a problem you own \- not a problem you delivered to.


**What We're Looking For**
* Over 4 years of professional experience in software development, specifically focused on solving large\-scale technical challenges.
* Expert\-level proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Java, GO, Rust, NodeJS etc) with a focus on writing scalable, maintainable, and unit\-tested code.
* Strong command of object\-oriented design, design patterns, and the creation of intuitive class\-level interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading, concurrency, and Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Deep understanding of relational databases (Postgres) and various NoSQL technologies like HBase, Elasticsearch, or Aerospike, Cassandra.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the full software development life cycle on Linux platforms.
* Proven ability to build highly scalable applications that manage complex business logic and massive datasets.
* A proactive, "go\-getter" mindset characterized by high energy and dedication to task ownership.
* Experience thriving in fast\-paced startup environments with a strong sense of commitment and accountability.
* A passionate drive to tackle complex, real\-world problems through innovative engineering.
* You've made and defended technical decisions, picked up problems no one assigned, or built things people use that no one asked for.
* Strong fundamentals in your primary stack \- concurrency, data modeling, debugging across systems, performance work. We're stack\-agnostic for the right person.
* Experience designing systems with explicit attention to scale, reliability, and cost \- not just functional correctness.
* Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to monitor project outcomes and iteratively refine features based on real\-world impact.

* **API Development \& Integration:** Design and implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices to enable seamless communication between front\-end interfaces, back\-end systems, and third\-party tools.
* **Database Management:** Structure, optimize, and maintain relational (SQL), non\-relational (NoSQL) and unstructured databases like SharePoint Lists, Excels, etc. to support high\-throughput, enterprise\-scale applications.


**Data Engineering \& Business Intelligence**


* **ETL \& Data Pipeline Design:** Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT flows to consolidate data from disparate transactional systems, cloud databases, and third\-party APIs.
* **Dashboard \& Analytics Engineering:** Translate business requirements into intuitive, interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive decision\-making.
* **Data Modeling \& Governance:** Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and integrity across relational data models, transactional schemas, and enterprise data marts.


**Enterprise Process Automation**


* **Workflow Automation:** Identify manual operational workflows and design automated end\-to\-end process flows using Microsoft Power Automate and custom scripts.
* **System Integration:** Connect enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, legacy databases, web portals) using cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), and webhooks.


**AI \& Emerging Technology Integration**


* **Generative \& Agentic AI Solutions:** Architect and implement solutions incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and autonomous Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex).
* **AI Tooling \& Prompt Engineering:** Build AI\-driven feature enhancements into enterprise web portals and workflow engines to enhance productivity and user experience.


**Cloud \& DevOps Operations**


* **Cloud Architecture:** Deploy, manage, and scale applications and data infrastructure across major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **CI/CD \& Code Hygiene:** Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, maintain repository hygiene, conduct code reviews, and enforce security and data compliance standards.

### **Qualifications**


**Key Skill Requirements**


**Hands\-on Experience**


* **4 to 8 years** of core hands\-on experience in full\-stack software development, data engineering, and automation solutions.


**Software \& Web Development Stack**


* Proficiency in at least one primary full\-stack development technology suite:
* **MERN / MEAN:** React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
* **Java Stack:** Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC
* **LAMP / Web:** PHP, Apache/Nginx, Linux, MySQL, JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**


* Experience in designing **ETL/ELT processes** using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or SSIS.
* Expert\-level proficiency in **Power BI** (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Security Management, Custom Visuals).
* Proficiency with both **SQL** (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and **NoSQL** (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra) databases.


**Process Automation**


* Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using **Microsoft Power Automate** (Cloud \& Desktop flows).


**Cloud Platforms**


* Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider ( **Azure**, **AWS**, or **GCP**), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.


**Teamwork, Communication \& Execution**


* Collaboration \& Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi\-disciplinary \& multi\-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
* Interpersonal \& Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non\-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
* Action\-Oriented \& Proactive: Highly self\-motivated, action\-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.


**Preferred Experience**


* **Generative \& Agentic AI:**
* Understanding of LLM/SLM fine\-tuning, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
* Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function\-calling protocols.
* **DevOps \& Containerization:** Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
* **Scripting Languages:** Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
* **Agile Delivery:** Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross\-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Communication:** Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualification**


* **Primary Qualification:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc).
* **Certifications (Desirable):**
* **Cloud:** Azure Developer/Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* **Analytics \& Automation:** Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\) or Power Platform App Maker / Developer (PL\-100/PL\-400\).
