title: Backend Developer
description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person

description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person

Engineering Manager (Backend)
description:
**About the Role** 




 To contribute and lead a team of enthusiastic individuals to the building and maintenance of high\-quality software applications and cater superior experience to our customers on a scale.
 



  





 Your primary role will be to build products and services for Airtel’s growth. You will be spending better part of the time in development and writing technical documents. You will solve business problems at scale, work on existing and new repositories, review code, write design documents and help in resolving customer issues. As engineering manager, you will build and mentor engineering teams and deliver on below :
 


1. **Technical Expertise :** 
 Provide guidance on technical and functional aspects of project and take decisions. You will setup and execute best practices in application architecture, development, code reviews, performance, deployment and execution by owning end\-to\-end business deliveries
2. **Innovation and continuous learning :** 
 You will build culture of innovation and continuous improvement in your team. You will encourage and adopt new technology and emerging industry trends and methods for improving efficiency of your team
3. **Communication and Collaboration :** 
 You will facilitate communication within the engineering teams and stakeholders including quality, operations, product and program to ensure alignment for business goals. You will address technical issues in teams and promote positive working environment
4. **Team Management :** 
 Conduct performance review and setup constructive feedback loop for team members along with Engineering Managers. You will be responsible for hiring new members for effectively meeting organizational goals and deadlines
5. **Project Management :** 
 You will be part of overall planning by providing correct estimation and execution of engineering projects and ensure their timely delivery



  





**At Airtel, we use many technologies including:** 



1. Application layer technologies including Tomcat/Nodejs, Netty, Springboot, hibernate, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Apache flink
2. Caching technologies like Redis, Aerospike or Hazelcast
3. Frontend technologies including ReactJs, Angular, Android/IOS
4. Data storage technologies like Oracle, S3, Postgres, Mongodb 5\. Tooling including Git, Command line, Jenkins, Nifi, Airflow, Jmeter, Postman, Gatling, Ngnix/Haproxy, Jira/Confluence, Grafana, K8s



  





**Why Airtel Digital?** 



* Build systems that millions use daily — your code is never invisible.
* Work with cutting\-edge cloud and AI tech in real business scenarios.
* Join a fast, metrics\-driven team where engineers influence product strategy.



  





**Educational Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Computers Engineering or comparable experience.

title: Backend Developer
description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer with 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Node.js and Python to join our engineering team. You will build and maintain server\-side applications, RESTful APIs, database systems, and business logic. You will work closely with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful or GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Python.
* Build server\-side logic and application workflows.
* Develop backend services using Node.js frameworks and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
* Design clean database schemas and write optimized queries.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Develop secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT, OAuth, or similar methods.
* Connect third\-party services such as payment gateways, cloud storage, and messaging platforms.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Implement caching solutions such as Redis when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot bugs and production issues.
* Work with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings, requirement discussions, and effort estimation.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 2\+ years of professional experience in backend development with Node.js and/or Python.
* Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript and ES6\+.
* Good knowledge of Python programming and backend development.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, Async/Await, and the Node.js Event Loop.
* Hands\-on experience with Express.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RESTful API development.
* Experience with middleware, error handling, authentication, and API security.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases.
* Knowledge of database schema design and query optimization.
* Experience with ORM/ODM tools such as Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, or Django ORM.
* Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
* Basic understanding of Docker and Linux.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment processes.
* TypeScript experience is preferred.



  





**Tools and Technologies** 



* Node.js
* Python
* Express.js / NestJS
* FastAPI / Django / Flask
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
* Prisma / TypeORM / Mongoose / Sequelize
* SQLAlchemy / Django ORM
* REST API / GraphQL
* Redis
* JWT / OAuth
* Git / GitHub
* Postman / Insomnia
* Docker
* Linux
* Jest / Mocha / Pytest
* CI/CD pipelines



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of professional backend development experience.
* Experience working on production\-grade Node.js and/or Python applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good understanding of software development practices.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a development team.



  





**What We Expect** 



* Write clean, structured, and maintainable code.
* Take ownership of assigned backend features and tasks.
* Understand requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
* Follow coding standards and development best practices.
* Test your work before delivery.
* Communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders.
* Be willing to learn new technologies and improve your technical skills.
* Take responsibility for resolving issues and delivering tasks within agreed timelines.



  





**Location Requirement** 



* Kerala\-based candidates only

title: Principal Backend and Product Engineer
description:
**About the Company:** 





 Redesign Health
 
 is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next\-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and a team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors drawn from the most consequential healthcare, AI, and software institutions in the world.
 



 Since 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1\.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations and senior leaders around the world. We are headquartered in New York, with offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh.
 



  





**About the Job:** 




 We're hiring a Principal Engineer to own the backend and internal platform layer between Redesign’s infrastructure and its applied AI products. This is the technology that makes our data, tools, and development patterns usable by engineers, agents, and the domain experts building software across the firm.
 



  





 One distinctive feature of Redesign is that every person at the company is, in some meaningful sense, a software engineer. Building for that audience is a new and special craft: the platform has to be powerful enough for senior engineers, legible enough for nontraditional builders, and structured enough for agents to use safely.
 



  





 You will report to a VP of Technology, and join a global technology practice built around senior individual contributors with unusually broad ownership. In this role, you will own a full technical domain between infrastructure and applied AI, and build it around agentic principles.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




 At Redesign, everyone builds. Experienced engineers ship more complexity than ever before, domain experts turn judgment into working systems, and agents participate in the path from idea to production. That changes what backend engineering means. The backend is the shared layer of data, access, tools, and conventions that lets many kinds of builders create safely. This role owns that layer between infrastructure and applied AI.
 


* *Build the backend platform behind Redesign’s operating system.* 
 You will own the APIs, databases, services, resource models, migrations, and access patterns that back our core AI operating system. Your job is to make the primitives behind Redesign’s work easy to discover, safe to extend, and hard to misuse, so applications, agents, and builders can consume trusted data without bespoke plumbing.
* *Define the paradigm for AI\-native development.* 
 You will own the systems and conventions that let agents drive software engineering: agentic coding patterns, harness design, memory management, verification loops, and self\-learning multi\-agent code review. Done well, this unlocks a trusted path from intent to production: if generated code is safe, standards\-compliant, and proven to do what it was meant to do, it can become part of the system without turning human review into a bottleneck.
* *Build for a workforce where everyone creates software.* 
 You will own the developer experience for a builder population that brings together infrastructure engineers, applied AI engineers, and domain experts without formal software backgrounds. You will deeply understand how Redesign functions and build powerful primitives that cut across teams, decisions, and geographies. That means thoughtfully designed tools and interfaces that capture the most important work and workflows, and let the whole firm turn judgment into technology at the speed of thought.



  





**What You'll Need:** 




 We value and actively seek exceptional talent from all backgrounds and experiences, recognizing that excellence takes many forms. The strongest candidates have been selected into high\-talent environments, distinguished themselves within them, earned unusually broad scope or trusted ownership, progressed rapidly, or done work that changed the trajectory of a team, product, company, or field. While every path is different, we believe the most successful candidates for this role will share the following characteristics:
 


* 10\-12\+ years of engineering experience, with meaningful time at staff, principal, or equivalent level at a serious software company. You have anchored the technical work of a small, fast team before, and you have owned backend, data, developer\-platform, or internal\-platform systems that other people built on every day.
* You have shipped production backend systems in Python and/or TypeScript, with ownership of database schemas, migrations, API contracts, authentication, and permissions. You have worked deeply with Postgres or a similar relational database; built authorization or identity layers with scoped access for users, services, and agents; and shipped APIs and data services that multiple teams depended on.
* You have built or operated agent\-facing infrastructure that teams used every day: MCP servers and tools, Claude Code or Cursor conventions, skills or plugin systems, sandboxed execution, code\-review automation, evals, usage and cost controls, and safe defaults. You understand that agents are now first\-class consumers of backend systems.
* You have range across product craft and developer experience. You have built tools, applications, or internal platforms for experienced engineers and for builders without traditional software backgrounds, and you understand that this work is as much about shaping how people encounter the system as it is about creating a technical surface. You have thought deeply about how different kinds of builders climb the AI curve, where they get stuck, and what a great first experience should feel like.
* You are AI\-native. LLMs and agents have rewired how you build. You are proficient with modern agent frameworks (the Anthropic Agent SDK, Lang\* / Deep Agents, or similar) and have shipped production systems on top of them. You have built sophisticated systems on top of coding agents like Claude Code (skills, MCPs, custom harnesses) and have hardly written code by hand in over a year.
* Technology is one of your passions, and you find deep meaning in some other pursuit to which you've devoted your time, thought, and effort: a creative or athletic outlet, a family business, or service.



**Strong plus:** 
 track record as a founder, founding engineer, or 0\-to\-1 product engineering owner inside a small, fast team.
 



**Bonus:** 
 a quantitative degree (or a few) from a strong program; open\-source contributions; published work; or a side project other people have actually used.
 



  





 Who You Are:
 


* A true builder who is always tinkering, experimenting, and looking for the better way. Where others see one\-off app requests, you see the workflows, access patterns, and primitives that could make the next ten requests easier.
* Proud of platform craft. You believe the difference between systems people build on and systems people work around is the quality of the design, and the technical and business judgment behind it.
* A clear writer who believes English is the most important programming language. Your API docs, migration notes, examples, agent instructions, and tool descriptions make the right path obvious to humans and agents.
* Allergic to repeating yourself. If you see the same workaround twice, the third answer is a shared service, MCP tool, template, or platform capability.
* Deeply curious about the business, not just the technology. You can read a deal memo, a fundraising deck, and a research note and create great data models, APIs, and tools around them.
* You design for agents as first\-class users. You think about tools, context, permissions, evals, memory, and failure recovery as product surfaces.
* You have thrived in a group of passionate, talented, diverse, and low\-ego individuals because these kinds of people love working with you.
* You have accomplished something most people haven't: started a company, won an international academic award, shipped a product loved by many, performed music around the world, or overcome difficult circumstances to succeed. You have dedicated your life to excellence in your craft.



  





**How We Work:** 




 Our company values are the standards and norms that shape how we make decisions, build teams, serve patients, and partner with one another. They define what you can expect from us and what we expect from every person who joins our team. We share them openly so candidates can decide whether this way of working will bring out their best.
 


* **Patients are waiting:** 
 Work with the urgency that patients deserve.
* **AI sets the floor:** 
 Nothing short of what AI in expert hands can deliver; taste and judgment own the last mile.
* **Stack the team:** 
 Talent density is our greatest asset; raise the bar with every hire.
* **Trust people, challenge ideas:** 
 Assume good intent; never shy from rigorous debate.
* **Sweat your craft:** 
 Take pride in your work; seek feedback to continuously improve.
* **Go beyond:** 
 Your role, comfort zone, and expectations for what’s possible.
* **Be the partner you want:** 
 High integrity, responsive, and genuinely invested in shared success.
* **No shortcuts:** 
 Patient safety, clinical standards, and partner trust above all.



  





**Compensation and Location:** 




 You will work out of our Bengaluru office on a hybrid schedule, with strong overlap into US Eastern and Pacific hours.. We target world\-class talent and compensate accordingly, with packages containing a mix of cash and fund equity.

title: Principal Engineer - Python Backend [T500-29508]
description:
**1WRK by ANSR** 




**Principal Engineer** 




**Full\-Time \| Experience: 8\-12 Years \| Location: Bangalore/Hybrid** 




**About the Role:** 




 1WRK by ANSR is hiring a Principal Engineer to own the technical direction of critical systems across our platform. This is a senior, hands\-on technical leadership role for an engineer who thinks in an AI\-first way, is comfortable working primarily in Python, and has the depth to make lasting architecture decisions — while mentoring the engineers around them to raise the bar for the whole team.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* **Architecture ownership:** 
 Own the architecture and long\-term technical roadmap for one or more critical systems, making build\-vs\-buy and technology bet decisions with clear reasoning.
* **AI\-first delivery:** 
 Push the team toward an AI\-first way of building software — using AI tools/agents to accelerate the SDLC, and identifying where AI/LLM capabilities belong inside the product itself.
* **Hands\-on engineering:** 
 Stay hands\-on — write production code, review designs and pull requests, and set the technical bar through your own work, not just through documents.
* **Scalable, cost\-aware design:** 
 Design software and modules that are highly optimized for scale and cost, and hold the broader engineering team to the same standard.
* **Secure by design:** 
 Champion secure SDLC practices across the systems you own — threat modeling, secure coding, dependency hygiene, and security reviews as a default, not an afterthought.
* **Technical mentorship:** 
 Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, run design and code reviews, and grow the team's depth in system design, data structures, and Python engineering.
* **Cross\-team influence:** 
 Act as a trusted technical voice across engineering, product, and leadership — surfacing risks, trade\-offs, and options in plain language.
* **Standards \& best practices:** 
 Define and evolve engineering standards for backend design, event\-driven systems, database usage, and AWS deployment across teams.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* 10\-14 years of overall backend/software engineering experience, with a track record of owning architecture for complex, production systems at scale.
* **AI\-first engineering mindset:** 
 You default to using AI tools and agents to accelerate design, coding, testing, and documentation, and you actively look for places to embed AI/LLM capabilities into the systems you build.
* **Backend engineering, Python\-first:** 
 Deep backend engineering skills across any modern stack, with a strong preference and hands\-on depth in Python frameworks (e.g., Django, FastAPI, Flask) — willing and able to work primarily in Python.
* **Data structures \& algorithms:** 
 Rock\-solid command of data structures and algorithms, and the judgment to pick the right one for a given performance and complexity trade\-off.
* **System design:** 
 Proven ability to design large\-scale, distributed systems — service boundaries, data flow, failure modes, and trade\-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.
* **Secure SDLC:** 
 Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices — threat modeling, secure coding standards, dependency and vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and security reviews baked into every stage of delivery.
* **Advanced analytical \& out\-of\-the\-box thinking:** 
 Sharp analytical skills paired with a genuine willingness to challenge conventional approaches and propose creative, non\-obvious solutions to hard problems.
* **Databases:** 
 Fair to strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases — schema design, indexing, query optimization, and choosing the right store for the job.
* **Event\-driven systems:** 
 Experience designing and operating event\-driven architectures — queues, pub/sub, streaming (e.g., SQS/SNS, Kafka, EventBridge) — and reasoning about ordering, idempotency, and failure handling.
* **Scale \& cost optimization:** 
 Ability to design software and modules that are highly optimized for both scale and cost, making deliberate trade\-offs rather than defaulting to the most expensive option.
* **AWS deployment:** 
 Practical, hands\-on experience getting software deployed and running reliably on AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudFormation/Terraform, CI/CD pipelines).
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — clean, testable, well\-documented code, and disciplined use of version control and code review.
* A genuine ownership mindset — you see problems through to resolution, in production, not just to a passing test.
* Debugging and observability instincts — comfortable using logs, metrics, and tracing to root\-cause issues under pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to document decisions clearly and explain trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* A learning mindset — you pick up new tools, frameworks, and AI capabilities quickly and share what you learn.
* Collaboration across functions — comfortable working closely with product, design, and other engineering teams.
* Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction without necessarily having formal people\-management responsibility.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience in SaaS, HR\-tech, or global workforce/EOR platforms.
* Experience building or integrating LLM\-based / agentic features into production systems.
* Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CDK) and platform/DevOps practices.
* Prior experience as a staff/principal engineer, architect, or technical lead.
* Contributions to open\-source projects, technical blogs, or internal engineering standards.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 



* Systems you've architected scale predictably, stay within cost targets, and hold up under real production load.
* Engineers around you write better\-designed, more secure code because of the standards and reviews you set.
* Leadership relies on you as the technical authority for what's possible, at what cost, and with what risk.



  





**Why Join 1WRK by ANSR:** 



* You'll have real ownership of hard technical problems, the room to make lasting architectural decisions, and a direct line to product and business impact.

 Company Description

You will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy, architecture, governance, and evolution of LinkedIn’s Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and related capabilities. You will help establish a scalable platform vision, define standards and operating models, and ensure these products can reliably support teams and workflows across LinkedIn at enterprise scale.
   

  





 Beyond traditional Atlassian administration, you will design and build solutions on top of the platform, including automations, integrations, APIs, workflows, and platform services that connect Atlassian products seamlessly with LinkedIn’s internal systems. You will apply strong engineering principles across reliability, security, performance, identity and access, observability, and platform governance while helping simplify fragmented processes and create scalable, self\-service experiences. You will also help explore how Atlassian, Rovo, and LinkedIn’s internal AI platforms can enable intelligent agents and AI\-first workflows that improve employee productivity and reduce manual work.
   

  





 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Enterprise Engineer to help design the Future of Work at LinkedIn. You will bring deep experience with Jira, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian ecosystem, along with strong expertise in enterprise\-scale platform engineering, automation, integrations, governance, and vendor partnership. You should be excited to operate at the intersection of enterprise platforms, software engineering, AI, automation, and employee productivity, and to build systems and capabilities that deliver measurable impact across LinkedIn.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Responsibilities
   

  




* You will own and evolve LinkedIn’s Atlassian platform strategy, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and related products, with a focus on scalability, reliability, governance, and employee experience.

* You will drive the adoption of AI\-first and agentic experiences, leveraging Atlassian capabilities, Rovo, APIs, and LinkedIn’s internal AI platforms to automate work and improve employee productivity.

* You will create reusable standards, patterns, documentation, and best practices that enable teams across LinkedIn to use Atlassian products effectively and consistently.
* You will work with product managers, program managers and dependent engineering teams to negotiate technical trade\-offs, define service boundaries, and ensure on\-time delivery.
* You will be responsible for operational tasks and on\-call support for the relevant applications and systems.
* You will learn to balance tactical day\-to\-day execution with long\-term technical debt management and strategic component roadmapping.

 Qualifications

 Banking Domain \& Business Architecture

 Cloud \& Enterprise Architecture
   

  

* Architect enterprise\-scale Azure and AWS solutions including landing zones, hybrid cloud, networking, identity, security, governance and cloud operating models.

* Architect secure enterprise GenAI platforms using embeddings, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, semantic search, tool orchestration, multi\-agent systems and enterprise knowledge retrieval.

* Demonstrated experience architecting and implementing banking solutions on Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.

* Practical experience designing secure AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, GenAIOps/LLMOps and enterprise AI governance.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Backend & Infra)
description:
Our backend works. It was built by a small team moving fast, and it now needs to scale from 100 to 1,000 facilities and beyond. It also has to become safe enough to act on its own. Dosing changes, pump sequencing, and setpoints are increasingly executed by software on live plants, which means every action must be observable and every deploy reversible. This role owns that safety rail.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated platform hire, writing Node.js services and the Terraform they run on, and setting the standard for how infrastructure, delivery, and reliability work here.
 



 You'll inherit real systems in production (alert engine, event log, device management, edge\-to\-cloud ingestion) and a clear mandate: make them boring to operate, then make them scale 50x.
 



  





  





  





**Infrastructure and delivery (core):** 




 Our AWS footprint as code — Terraform or CDK, no more click\-ops — with environments that are reproducible and provably identical
 



 CI/CD from commit to production: build, test gates, staged rollout, and rollback
 



 Containers, orchestration, and the deployment story for services and edge components alike
 



 Secrets, IAM, network boundaries, and a cloud bill that is measured and managed line by line
 



  





**Backend services (with the team):** 




 Node.js/TypeScript services and APIs alongside other backend engineers; you review their PRs and they review yours
 



 The edge\-to\-cloud ingestion path: MQTT at fleet scale, buffering, replay, backpressure, and what happens when a plant's link drops for six hours
 



 The alert and event systems that decide what a plant operator sees, and what wakes someone up
 



 The action path: how a recommendation from our intelligence stack becomes a verified, reversible command on a plant, with guardrails at every hop
 



 Contracts between edge, cloud, and our intelligence stack: agreed before build, versioned, enforced
 



 Cloud and edge deployment workflows, including deployment of sensor configuration files across a fleet of edge devices currently managing \~35,000 sensors
 



  





**Reliability and operations:** 




 Observability as a product surface, not an afterthought: metrics, traces, and logs that answer "is the fleet healthy?" immediately
 



 SLOs on the paths that matter, alerts that fire on symptoms rather than noise, and an on\-call rotation you'll help design so it stays humane as the fleet grows
 



 Incident response and blameless postmortems that actually change the code
 



 Load and failure testing against 50x device volume before the contract lands, not after
 



  





**Elevating how we ship:** 




 Test coverage and CI gates on all of our services
 



 Runbooks and architecture notes that let anyone on the team operate what you build
 



 Paved paths: the easy way to add a service should also be the correct way
 



 KPI Expectations
 



  





  





**This role is not for you if:\-** 




 You're looking for a greenfield stack. This is real code with real history, and the job is making it excellent.
 



 You want to stay purely on infrastructure and never touch product code, or purely on product and never be accountable for it in production
 



 You'd rather move fast now and add tests later
 



 You're not curious about how a wastewater plant actually works. You'll be visiting one in your first month.

title: Specialist, Software Technology

KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.

**Job Description**
**Senior AI Backend Engineer**
**Build production AI for the future of financial markets.**
 Join Version 1 to build intelligent products for a leading US\-based financial technology and digital assets business operating across institutional trading, investment management and AI infrastructure.
   

  

 You will engineer the secure, scalable services behind production AI that supports high\-value decisions across trading, risk and portfolio management. Collaborating with an experienced US\-based engineering team, you will build Python APIs, real\-time data integrations and AI\-enabled backend services that solve genuine problems across financial markets. This is AI engineered for measurable business impact.
   

  

 Working with Financial Services, product and engineering stakeholders in the United States, you will translate business requirements into reliable software and connect applications to an established AI platform powered by Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore and SageMaker.

* Work with Python, AWS, LLMs, RAG, embeddings and real\-time data.

* Implement observability across logs, metrics, tracing and alerts, with a focus on operational health and cost efficiency.
* Contribute across data pipelines, infrastructure and frontend touchpoints where needed to deliver features end to end.
* Partner with product, business, full\-stack, data and AI platform teams, and share backend and AI\-integration best practices.

**Essential Experience**
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production\-grade backend services.
* Strong hands\-on Python experience and a solid understanding of software engineering and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience designing and developing secure, scalable REST APIs.
* Experience with relational database design, ideally PostgreSQL.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform, including building and operating production applications.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, reliability engineering, performance tuning and cost optimisation.
* Working knowledge of generative AI and LLM concepts, including RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering and function calling.

* Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, SSO, RBAC and secrets management in production applications.
* Experience within Financial Services, fintech, capital markets, banking or another regulated environment.
* A genuine interest in trading, investment management, digital assets and cryptocurrency.
* Confidence communicating technical recommendations and trade\-offs to engineering and business stakeholders.


**Technology environment**
 Python \| REST APIs \| AWS \| Amazon Bedrock \| SageMaker \| AgentCore \| RAG \| Embeddings \| Kubernetes \| Terraform \| Docker \| PostgreSQL \| Databricks \| CI/CD \| Automated testing \| Observability \| OAuth2/OIDC \| SSO \| RBAC
   

  

 You do not need deep model\-training or agentic\-platform architecture experience. We value strong backend engineering fundamentals, practical AI integration experience and the judgement to build reliable products around an established AI platform.
   

  

**Valuable Additional Experience**
* Capital markets, trading, risk or portfolio management platforms.
* Digital assets, cryptocurrency, blockchain or tokenisation.
* Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, AgentCore or comparable AI services.
* Vector databases such as pgvector and AI\-powered search or retrieval.
* Databricks, Jenkins or real\-time data pipelines.
* Evaluating AI features for accuracy, latency, hallucination handling and graceful degradation.
* Awareness of regulatory and compliance considerations in Financial Services technology.
* Technical leadership or mentoring across engineering teams.


**Additional Information**
**Why Version 1?**
 At Version 1, you will deepen your expertise within our Financial Services practice while building sophisticated AI products for a global organisation operating across trading, investment management and digital assets.
   

  

* Quarterly performance\-related profit share, enabling employees to share in our success.

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and REST/SOAP APIs) to support HR, Payroll, Finance, and downstream business systems, with an emphasis on reliability, observability, and security.
* Serve as the primary technical owner for key Workday integration domains (e.g., HCM, Absence, Banking, Time Tracking, Talent, and Security), ensuring integrations are versioned, documented, and aligned with LiveRamp’s enterprise architecture and data governance standards.
* Partner closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to translate business requirements into technical specifications, sequence diagrams, and test plans, driving clarity on edge cases, SLAs, and operational runbooks.
* Lead the full integration lifecycle—requirements, design, configuration, development, unit testing, system/UAT support, cutover, and hypercare—for Workday feature releases, bi\-annual updates, and project\-based enhancements.
* Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for Workday integrations (including error handling, retries, and data reconciliation), and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes for production issues.
* Maintain and optimize data flows between Workday and other enterprise applications (e.g., identity and access management, ATS, compensation, benefits, and data warehouse platforms), ensuring data quality, timeliness, and consistency.
* Establish and enforce Workday integration development best practices, including code review standards, naming conventions, configuration management, and re\-usable integration patterns.
* Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation (design specs, interface contracts, configuration guides, dependency maps) and provide knowledge transfer to peers, admins, and support teams.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline business processes through Workday automation, calculated fields, condition rules, and integration\-driven workflows, and build business cases for proposed improvements.
* Track and evaluate new Workday integration features and product roadmap changes, assess potential impact to LiveRamp’s ecosystem, and lead experiments or POCs to validate value and feasibility.
* Define and track key success metrics (e.g., integration uptime, incident volume/MTTR, data defect rate, batch processing times, and audit findings) and regularly report progress to stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR, FINs, and business stakeholders on Workday data structures, integration constraints, and downstream impacts to reporting, controls, and compliance.
* Apply AI\-assisted development and troubleshooting tools (e.g., code copilots, log analyzers) to speed up integration design, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high quality.
* Analyze integration telemetry with AI/ML techniques to identify recurring failure patterns, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for smarter alerting and auto\-remediation.


******Your Team Will:******
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Security, and other Business Applications teams to build and maintain the core HR technology foundation that powers the full LiveRamp employee lifecycle—from hire to retire. The team owns the Workday platform roadmap for integrations and is responsible for ensuring data flows are accurate, compliant, and resilient across our global systems landscape.
* You will join a small, highly\-collaborative group of Workday and SaaS application experts who:
* Lead key cross\-functional initiatives such as new country/entity rollouts, M\&A onboarding, org restructuring, and global HR process standardization, ensuring Workday integrations are ready to support business change.
* Provide level 2/3 application and integration support, working closely with our internal help desk and operations teams to triage issues, resolve incidents, and continuously improve the stability and usability of our FIN \& HR technology stack.
* Maintain strong partnerships with vendors and implementation partners, coordinating technical work, managing release impacts, and ensuring external integrations adhere to LiveRamp’s security and privacy requirements.
* Continuously refine our operating model, development standards, and delivery practices (Agile/iterative) so the team can ship high\-quality changes quickly while protecting a mission\-critical production environment.
* Introduce and standardize AI\-enabled practices (log summarization, impact analysis, test generation) that make it easier for the broader team to operate and evolve complex integrations.
* Partner with security, data, and platform teams to safely adopt AI capabilities that improve observability, resilience, and developer productivity in the Workday integrations space.


******About You:******
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations in a production environment, using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and Workday Web Services/REST APIs.
* Demonstrated experience owning end\-to\-end integration flows across at least two domains (e.g., HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Security, or Financials), including requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* You are deeply curious about how systems, data, and business processes fit together, and you naturally dig into payloads, mappings, and logs rather than treating integrations as black boxes.
* You are hungry to learn and a true lifelong learner—you actively seek out new Workday integration features, patterns, and best practices, and you enjoy sharing what you learn with others.
* You are a go\-getter who takes ownership of integrations end\-to\-end, follows through on commitments, and is comfortable driving work forward without needing constant direction.
* You are an experimenter who prototypes, tests, and iterates; you’re comfortable trying new integration patterns or tooling, measuring outcomes, and quickly adjusting based on what you learn.
* You are systems\-minded and enjoy thinking in terms of interfaces, dependencies, and edge cases; you naturally anticipate downstream impacts before changing mappings or schedules in production.
* You are detail\-oriented and disciplined, especially around documentation, testing, monitoring, and change control, and you understand that small integration changes can have big, cross\-system consequences.
* You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to translate between business language and technical behavior so stakeholders understand both the “why” and the “how” of data flows and changes.
* You are calm under pressure and comfortable troubleshooting ambiguous or complex integration issues, methodically working through hypotheses until you find and fix the root cause.
* You are service\-oriented, finding energy in helping HR, Finance, and business partners be successful through reliable integrations, high\-quality data, and thoughtful support.
* Curious about AI and automation and comfortable learning new tools (e.g., copilots, log analyzers, or analytics platforms) to boost your impact even if you haven’t used them formally before.
* Confident in asking questions, running small AI\-assisted experiments (such as log summarization, test generation, or code suggestions), and using data/AI\-generated insights to challenge the status quo and propose better, safer ways of working.


******Preferred Skills:******
* Workday Pro or Workday Integration/HCM/Financials certification(s), or equivalent advanced hands\-on experience with Workday integration tools (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs) across both HCM and Financials domains.
* Experience integrating Workday with identity and access platforms (e.g., Okta / Azure AD), ATS/HR tools, payroll/benefits providers, and finance/data platforms (e.g., ERP, billing/collections, Snowflake or similar data warehouse) in a SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with other SaaS applications commonly integrated with Workday at LiveRamp, including ticketing/ITSM, HR service delivery, performance/engagement, learning, and finance\-adjacent tools (e.g., sourcing, CLM, or billing systems), and how they exchange data with Workday HCM and FINS.
* Experience with modern integration and automation tooling, ideally including an iPaaS/middleware platform such as Workato or SnapLogic, plus basic scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or Shell) to support data pipelines, file transformations, and operational tasks.
* Exposure to both HR lifecycle processes (hire\-to\-retire, org changes, compensation cycles, security/role lifecycle) and finance processes (Source to Pay, Contract to Cash, GL/close), and how these translate into Workday configuration and integrations.
* Prior participation in Workday bi\-annual releases and major projects, including impact analysis on HR and FINS integrations, regression testing of critical interfaces, and rollout of new capabilities with appropriate monitoring.
* Familiarity with SOX, GDPR, and other privacy/security frameworks that impact HR and finance data, and experience designing integration\-level controls, logging, and audit evidence to support compliance across both domains.
* Experience using AI copilots or automation tools in a development or integration context (e.g., generating code snippets, test cases, or documentation) or a strong desire to ramp quickly.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms that leverage AI/ML to detect anomalies or predict incidents across integrations and data flows.

title: Backend Tech Lead
description:
A Backend Tech Lead at Accellor owns the design, delivery, and long\-term health of scalable, distributed backend systems while leading and growing the engineers who build them. This is a hands\-on technical role with real people\-management responsibility: you set technical direction, drive delivery across one or more squads, and actively mentor and unblock the engineers reporting into you. You are equally comfortable in a design review, a 1:1, and a production incident.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Own the architecture for backend services and platforms — microservices boundaries, API contracts, data models, and inter\-service communication patterns.
* Make and document key technical decisions (build vs. buy, sync vs. async, consistency vs. availability trade\-offs) and align teams around them.
* Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, testing strategy, observability, and operational readiness.


 People \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Directly manage, mentor, and grow a team of backend engineers, including running 1:1s, setting goals, giving feedback, and supporting career development.
* Plan, distribute, and track work across the team — breaking down epics, sequencing delivery, and removing blockers so the team ships predictably.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through pairing, code review, and design coaching, raising the bar for the whole team rather than being the single point of delivery.
* Partner with product, architecture, and other engineering leads to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and realistic commitments.


 Delivery \& Engineering Execution
   

  

* Lead by example with hands\-on contribution to high\-impact and complex parts of the codebase.
* Design and operate microservices: service decomposition, API design (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Build event\-driven and asynchronous workflows using message queues and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar).
* Design data persistence and caching strategies across relational and NoSQL stores, with appropriate use of caching layers (Redis/Memcached) for performance and scale.


 Scalability, Reliability \& Security
   

  

* Ensure systems are designed for scale, resilience, and graceful degradation — load balancing, rate limiting, retries, circuit breakers, and idempotency.
* Drive observability across services: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting.
* Enforce backend security best practices: authentication/authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), least\-privilege access, secrets management, and secure handling of data in transit and at rest.
* Own production quality — on\-call leadership, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-through on remediation.


 Collaboration \& Governance
   

  

* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams on CI/CD, containerization, and deployment strategy for backend services.
* Recommend and implement standards for code organization, service ownership, and technical governance across teams.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale.
* Demonstrated experience leading both projects and people — owning end\-to\-end delivery for a team, managing engineers directly, and mentoring juniors. You must be able to point to specific teams you've grown and projects you've driven to delivery.
* Languages \& Frameworks: Deep expertise in at least one major backend stack (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, Go, Python, Node.js, or C\#/.NET) and the ability to work fluently across more than one.
* Distributed Systems \& Microservices: Strong, demonstrable experience designing and operating microservices and distributed systems in production.
* APIs: Hands\-on expertise designing and evolving APIs (REST, gRPC, or GraphQL), including contracts, versioning, and documentation.
* Messaging \& Async: Practical experience with message queues / event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.).
* Data: Strong SQL skills and solid experience with relational databases, plus working knowledge of NoSQL stores and data modeling for scale.
* Caching: Hands\-on experience with caching strategies and tools (Redis, Memcached).
* Containers \& Orchestration: Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Networking: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals — HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, service discovery, and load balancing.
* Version Control \& Practices: Strong Git/GitOps proficiency and a deep commitment to code review, testing, and CI/CD.
* Cloud: Demonstrable experience building backend systems on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


**Preferred**
* Experience with service mesh, API gateways, or platform/internal\-developer\-platform tooling.
* Experience with performance profiling, load testing, and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and partnering closely with DevOps/SRE.
* Exposure to AI\-driven or data\-intensive backend workloads, as Accellor increasingly integrates backend engineering with AI\-powered platform delivery.


**Benefits**
**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centres.
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 Accellor prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:**

title: Senior backend developer
description:
𝗦𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗼𝗿 𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿, 𝗝𝗮𝘃𝗮 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗦𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗕𝗼𝗼𝘁
 



 CredX, Capital Park, Madhapur, Hyderabad \- on site
 



 Fxed plus 0\.5–1\.0% equity, 4 year vest, 1 year cliff
 



 Reports to Founder and CEO
 



  
 



 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻𝘆
 



 CredX is a verification first hiring platform for India. Incorporated in the US, built in Hyderabad, launching this month.
 



 Stack: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Azure, Razorpay.
 



  
 



 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁
 



 You are the backend. Not a backend engineer on a team. The backend.
 



 Every schema, every API contract, every transaction boundary, every architectural tradeoff is yours to make and yours to defend. This seat is built to grow, not stay solo. You are hired to build the foundation, and as CredX scales, this role grows into Head of Engineering / CTO \- hiring and leading the team you once were.
 



  
 



 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗪𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗢𝘄𝗻
 


* Architecture: Own the backend across billing, verification, hiring, users, roles, and admin. Design schemas, indexing strategies, transaction boundaries, and audit trails. Define API contracts before the frontend starts building.
* Billing: Own the full billing lifecycle, including plans, credits, mid cycle changes, proration, renewals, failed payments, and reconciliation. Implement signature verified webhooks, reliable idempotency that holds under retries, and a backend that serves as the single source of truth for customer entitlements. Razorpay will be the primary payment provider, with Stripe as a potential future option.
* Core Systems: Design and implement RBAC across Super Admin, Admin, Hiring Manager, Recruiter, and Applicant roles. Own verification and document processing workflows, authentication and authorization with JWT and Spring Security, and REST APIs with validation and error handling that can withstand real world scenarios.
* Production: Own the entire delivery lifecycle, from design to release. Set up monitoring and alerting, handle incident response, and ensure long term system reliability. When something breaks at 2 AM, you own the resolution and the systems that ensure we know about it before the customer does.



  
 



 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲 𝗡𝗲𝗲𝗱
 


* Java and Spring Boot: 3 to 6 years of experience designing and building production systems from scratch, rather than primarily extending existing systems.
* PostgreSQL: Deep expertise in schema design, query optimization, indexing, and transaction semantics, with the ability to reason about database behavior under concurrency.
* Production Payment Systems: Hands on experience with subscription or credit lifecycles, webhooks, proration, and entitlement enforcement. You should have worked on systems handling real money and understand how to test for correctness under retries, failures, and edge cases rather than focusing only on the happy path.
* System Design: Strong judgment when designing systems. You identify bottlenecks before they become problems, design for failure as the default case, and make deliberate tradeoffs.
* Security and Access Control: Strong experience with JWT, Spring Security, and RBAC architectures that can scale as new roles and permissions are introduced over time.
* Security and Data Handling: Strong fundamentals in encryption at rest and in transit, secure document storage, and audit grade logging. CredX's product is built on verified trust, and the backend is where that trust either holds or breaks.
* AI Tooling: Fluency with AI development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent, using them to increase productivity and ship more effectively rather than as decoration.
* Ownership: Comfortable taking complete ownership of systems and responsibilities without needing someone to continuously assign work.



  
 



 𝗡𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝘃𝗲
 



 Experience with Razorpay Subscriptions or Stripe Billing, Azure deployment and infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, CI/CD pipeline ownership, KYC or document verification workflows, planning API contracts alongside an Angular team, or previous founding team experience.
 



  
 



 𝗡𝗼𝘁 𝗮 𝗳𝗶𝘁 𝗶𝗳
 



 You want an existing architecture to extend, a tech lead to escalate to, or someone else on call. You want remote or hybrid. You are optimising for the highest cash offer, which will not be us.
 



  
 



 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘄𝗲 𝗵𝗶𝗿𝗲
 



 A deep technical conversation with the founder, mostly system design. A walkthrough of something you built where the data model was hard. Then a paid take home, roughly four hours, on a real billing or entitlement problem from our system. Three steps, inside one to two weeks we're hiring for this seat immediately.
 



  
 



 𝗧𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆
 



 Email: connect@credxhire.com, subject “Senior Backend Engineer, your name."
 


* Send your CV, GitHub if you have one, and one paragraph on a schema or architecture decision you made that you would still defend today.
